title.raw: 卷135 志一百十 兵六 水师

sentences.zh: 志一百十

translations.literal: Treatise 110
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 110

sentences.zh: 兵六

translations.literal: Military 6
translations.idiomatic: Military 6

sentences.zh: 水師

translations.literal: Naval Forces
translations.idiomatic: Naval Forces

sentences.zh: 水師有內河、外海之分。

translations.literal: Naval forces had a distinction between inner-river and open-sea [forces].
translations.idiomatic: The navy was divided into inland-river and open-sea branches.

sentences.zh: 初，沿海各省水師，僅為防守海口、緝捕海盜之用，轄境雖在海疆，官制同於內地。

translations.literal: At first, the naval forces of the coastal provinces served only to defend river mouths and pursue pirates at sea; although their jurisdiction was on the maritime frontier, their official system was the same as in the interior.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, the coastal provincial navies existed solely to guard estuaries and hunt pirates; though their posts lay on the maritime frontier, their ranks and regulations matched those of inland garrisons.

sentences.zh: 至光緒間，南北洋鐵艦製成，始別設專官以統率之。

translations.literal: By the Guangxu period, when ironclads for the Northern and Southern Fleets had been completed, dedicated officers were at last separately appointed to command them.
translations.idiomatic: Not until the Guangxu reign, after ironclads for the Northern and Southern Fleets had been built, were separate commanders finally appointed to lead them.

sentences.zh: 其內河水師，天聰十年，自寧古塔征瓦爾喀，以地多島嶼，初造戰船。

translations.literal: As for the inner-river naval forces: in the tenth year of Tiancong, when campaigning from Ningguta against the Warka, because the region had many islands, war vessels were first built.
translations.idiomatic: The inland river navy dates to the tenth year of Tiancong (1626), when troops marching from Ningguta against the Warka first built warships because the country was broken by islands.

sentences.zh: 天命元年，以水師循烏勒簡河征東海薩哈連部落。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianming, the naval forces followed the Ulejian River to campaign against the Eastern Sea Sahaliyan tribes.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianming (1616), the navy advanced up the Ulejian River against the Sahaliyan tribes of the eastern sea.

sentences.zh: 順治初，以京口、杭州水師分防海口。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi, the Jingkou and Hangzhou naval forces were assigned to share defense of the river mouths.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Shunzhi reign, the Jingkou and Hangzhou fleets were posted to guard the estuaries jointly.

sentences.zh: 八年，始於沿江沿海各省，循明代舊制，設提督、總兵、副將、游擊以下各武員，如陸營之制。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, along the Yangzi and coastal provinces, following the old Ming system, regional commanders-in-chief, commanders, deputy commanders, mobile brigadiers, and all military officers below them were established, as in the land camps.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year (1651), the court extended the Ming pattern along the Yangzi and the coast, appointing naval regional commanders, commanders, deputies, and mobile brigadiers down the chain, mirroring the land army.

sentences.zh: 各省設造船廠，定師船修造年限，三年小修，五年大修，十年拆造。

translations.literal: Each province established shipyards; the term for repair and construction of fleet vessels was fixed—minor repair in three years, major repair in five, dismantling and rebuilding in ten.
translations.idiomatic: Provinces opened shipyards and fixed a service cycle for fleet ships: minor refit at three years, major refit at five, and complete rebuild at ten.

sentences.zh: 十年，以水師克舟山，增造戰監，擴充兵額。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, the naval forces captured Zhoushan; more war junks were built and troop quotas expanded.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year (1653), the navy took Zhoushan, added warships, and raised manpower quotas.

sentences.zh: 十四年，增設崇明水師總兵官，調撥江寧、江蘇、安徽各省標兵萬人，分防吳淞江及崇明諸口。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, a Chongming naval commander was added; ten thousand banner troops from Jiangning, Jiangsu, and Anhui were transferred to share defense of the Wusong River and the various Chongming passes.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year (1657), a Chongming naval commander was created, and ten thousand garrison troops from Jiangning, Jiangsu, and Anhui were posted to guard the Wusong River and Chongming's channels.

sentences.zh: 十六年，增設京口左右兩路綠旗水師總兵官。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, left and right route Green Banner naval commanders at Jingkou were added.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year (1659), left- and right-route Green Banner naval commanders were established at Jingkou.

sentences.zh: 十八年，設吉林水師營造斛船及划子船。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, the Jilin naval camp was established to build hu-boats and rowboats.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year (1661), the Jilin naval detachment was set up to build grain barges and skiffs.

sentences.zh: 康熙八年，增設福建水師總兵官。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Kangxi, a Fujian naval commander was added.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Kangxi (1669), a Fujian naval commander was appointed.

sentences.zh: 十四年，改崇明總兵官為水師提督。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, the Chongming commander was changed to naval regional commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year (1675), the Chongming commander was promoted to naval regional commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 十七年，設福建水師提督及參將以下各官。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, the Fujian naval regional commander-in-chief and all officers from regimental commander downward were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year (1678), the Fujian naval regional commander and the full staff from regimental commander down were installed.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，裁京口右路水師，改左路水師為京口總兵官。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, the Jingkou right-route naval force was abolished; the left-route naval force was changed to the Jingkou commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year (1685), the Jingkou right-route navy was abolished and the left route became the sole Jingkou naval command.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，增設南台水師營，置參將以下各官。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, the Nantai naval camp was added, with regimental commanders and all officers below established.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year (1687), the Nantai naval camp was created with regimental commanders and subordinate officers.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，更定修造戰船之制，外海戰船哨船，自新造之年為始，三年後，以次小修大修，更閱三年，或大修，或改造。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, the system for repairing and building war vessels was revised: for open-sea war vessels and patrol boats, counting from the year of new construction, after three years minor and major repairs followed in sequence; after another three years, either major repair or reconstruction.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year (1690), regulations for warship upkeep were revised: open-sea combat and patrol craft, from the year they were launched, underwent minor then major repair at three-year intervals, and after another three years either another major refit or a full rebuild.

sentences.zh: 內江戰船哨船，則小修大修後，更閱三年，仍修治用之。

translations.literal: Inner-river war vessels and patrol boats, after minor and major repair, after another three years were still repaired and kept in use.
translations.idiomatic: Inland war and patrol craft, after minor and major refits, simply entered another three-year cycle of maintenance rather than mandatory rebuilding.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，令督、撫、提、鎮，凡修理戰船銀兩，不得浮冒核減，致船料薄弱。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year, governors-general, governors, regional commanders-in-chief, and commanders were ordered: for all silver used to repair war vessels, there must be no inflated claims or reduced verification, causing weak ship materials.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year (1695), governors and naval commanders were forbidden to pad repair accounts or slash approved funds in ways that left ships poorly built.

sentences.zh: 五十二年，令趕繒等船，於船之首尾，刊捕盜各營鎮船名，以次編列。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year, ganzeng and other vessels were ordered to have carved at bow and stern the names of pirate-suppression camps and command vessels, listed in sequence.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-second year (1713), ganzeng and similar craft were required to inscribe bow and stern with each camp's patrol-ship name in numbered order.

sentences.zh: 五十三年，增設金州水師營于海島內，選諳習水性者充之。

translations.literal: In the fifty-third year, a Jinzhou naval camp was added within the sea islands; those skilled in water were selected to fill it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-third year (1714), a Jinzhou naval detachment was posted among the offshore islands, manned by men proven at sea.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，設松江水師營。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year, the Songjiang naval camp was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-sixth year (1717), the Songjiang naval camp was established.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年，令沿海各督、撫出洋巡視。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongzheng, coastal governors-general and governors were ordered to go to sea on inspection tours.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongzheng (1724), coastal governors were ordered to conduct inspections at sea.

sentences.zh: 其戰船向由地方官修造者，改歸營員修造。

translations.literal: War vessels formerly built by local civil officials were changed to be built by camp officers.
translations.idiomatic: Warship construction, once handled by local civil officials, was transferred to naval camp officers.

sentences.zh: 是年，設乍浦水師營。

translations.literal: That year, the Zhapu naval camp was established.
translations.idiomatic: That same year, the Zhapu naval camp was established.

sentences.zh: 三年，以滿洲兵丁未習水戰，增設天津水師營，以滿洲、蒙古兵二千人隸之。

translations.literal: In the third year, because Manchu soldiers were unpracticed in naval warfare, the Tianjin naval camp was added, with two thousand Manchu and Mongol troops subordinate to it.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year (1725), because Manchu troops were untrained for sea combat, a Tianjin naval camp was formed with two thousand Manchu and Mongol soldiers.

sentences.zh: 四年，以福建水師常駐內地，不耐風浪，浙江水師尤甚，乃更改舊制，於本省洋面巡哨外，每年選派船弁，在閩、浙外洋更番巡歷會哨，以靖海氛。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, because the Fujian naval forces often remained in the interior and could not endure wind and waves—and the Zhejiang naval forces were even worse—the old system was changed: beyond patrol on their own province's seas, each year selected ship officers were dispatched to rotate patrol and joint rendezvous on the Fujian and Zhejiang open seas, to pacify maritime disturbances.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year (1726), Fujian's navy rarely left inland waters and could not weather open seas; Zhejiang's was worse still. The court therefore added rotating patrols off Fujian and Zhejiang, with selected officers relieving one another at sea to calm the coast.

sentences.zh: 五年，以杭州駐防旗兵抽練水師。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Hangzhou garrison banner troops were drawn off to drill as naval forces.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year (1727), banner troops garrisoned at Hangzhou were detached for naval training.

sentences.zh: 江寧駐防旗兵，即以鎮江原有戰船，隸江寧將軍，督率旗兵習水戰。

translations.literal: Jiangning garrison banner troops were assigned the war vessels formerly at Zhenjiang, placed under the Jiangning general, who supervised banner troops in learning naval combat.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangning's garrison bannermen took over Zhenjiang's existing warships under the Jiangning general, who drilled them in naval warfare.

sentences.zh: 尋令旗兵四千人悉習水營事務。

translations.literal: Soon four thousand banner troops were ordered all to study naval-camp duties.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward, four thousand banner soldiers were ordered to train in all naval-camp duties.

sentences.zh: 令江南、江西各水師營，於弓矢、鳥槍外，增練藤牌、大刀、鉤鐮槍、過船槍、鉞、斧、標彈等武器。

translations.literal: The Jiangnan and Jiangxi naval camps were ordered, beyond bows, arrows, and muskets, additionally to drill with rattan shields, broadswords, hook-sickles, boarding spears, battle-axes, hatchets, throwing darts, and other weapons.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan and Jiangxi naval camps were told to add training in rattan shields, broadswords, boarding hooks, gangplank spears, axes, hatchets, and throwing darts to their usual bows and muskets.

sentences.zh: 戰船分大中小三等。

translations.literal: War vessels were divided into large, medium, and small grades.
translations.idiomatic: Warships were classed as large, medium, or small.

sentences.zh: 增練排槍。

translations.literal: Volley muskets were added to training.
translations.idiomatic: Volley-fire muskets were added to the drill.

sentences.zh: 湖廣水師，每兵千人，增鳥槍四百桿。

translations.literal: For the Huguang naval forces, per thousand troops, four hundred muskets were added.
translations.idiomatic: The Huguang navy received four hundred muskets for every thousand men.

sentences.zh: 六年，令水師船廠附近省城者，凡戰船造成，在城之督、撫、提、鎮會同驗看。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, for naval shipyards near provincial capitals, whenever war vessels were completed, the governor-general, governor, regional commander-in-chief, and commander in the city jointly inspected them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year (1728), wherever shipyards lay near a provincial capital, newly finished warships had to be inspected jointly by the governor, naval commander-in-chief, and garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 是年，因浙江水師技藝生疏，乃於福建水師中，擇精練之兵，赴浙江教練。

translations.literal: That year, because Zhejiang naval skills were crude, elite trained troops were chosen from the Fujian naval forces to go to Zhejiang to instruct.
translations.idiomatic: That year, because Zhejiang's sailors were poorly skilled, picked veterans from Fujian were sent north to train them.

sentences.zh: 尋定浙江戰船用木之丈尺，及船身深廣之制。

translations.literal: Soon the dimensions of timber for Zhejiang war vessels and the regulations for hull depth and breadth were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations soon fixed the timber sizes and hull dimensions for Zhejiang warships.

sentences.zh: 奉天水師亦如之。

translations.literal: The Fengtian naval forces did likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The Fengtian navy adopted the same standards.

sentences.zh: 七年，以旅順水師不諳戰務，撥福建水師營精卒赴奉天教練。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, because the Lüshun naval forces were unskilled in combat duties, elite troops from the Fujian naval camp were transferred to Fengtian for instruction.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year (1729), because the Lüshun fleet was unfit for combat, elite Fujian sailors were sent to Fengtian as instructors.

sentences.zh: 是年，增浙江乍浦水師營。

translations.literal: That year, the Zhejiang Zhapu naval camp was expanded.
translations.idiomatic: That year, the Zhejiang Zhapu naval camp was expanded.

sentences.zh: 八年，撥江寧駐防兵八百人隸乍浦營。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, eight hundred Jiangning garrison troops were transferred to the Zhapu camp.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year (1730), eight hundred Jiangning garrison troops were assigned to the Zhapu camp.

sentences.zh: 旋因各省水師營承修造船之員，逐層需索，迨交收後，復盜賣損毀，各營皆然，京口標兵尤甚，令督、撫嚴懲之。

translations.literal: Soon because officers in charge of shipbuilding in each province's naval camps extorted at every level, and after handover again stole and sold or damaged [vessels]—every camp was thus, and Jingkou banner troops especially—governors were ordered to punish severely.
translations.idiomatic: It soon emerged that shipwright officers in every naval camp extorted bribes at every level and, after delivery, stole fittings or wrecked vessels—worst of all at Jingkou—so governors were ordered to punish offenders harshly.

sentences.zh: 九年，以文武各員承修戰船，每多貽誤，弊竇叢生，乃嚴治各員，限期修竣，以除巧脫中飽之弊。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, because civil and military officers undertaking war-vessel repair often delayed and abuses multiplied, all officers were strictly governed, with fixed deadlines for completion, to remove the abuses of evasion and embezzlement.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year (1731), chronic delays and graft in warship repair led to strict deadlines and punishment to end evasion and embezzlement.

sentences.zh: 十年，令天津水師大小趕繒船所用梗木舵牙及藤篾等具，收存備用。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, the Tianjin naval forces were ordered to store for reserve use the hardwood rudders, tiller teeth, rattan matting, and other fittings used on large and small ganzeng vessels.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year (1732), the Tianjin navy was told to stock spare hardwood rudders, tillers, rattan rigging, and other fittings for its ganzeng fleet.

sentences.zh: 各省戰船設承修官，以董造船之役。

translations.literal: Each province's war vessels had repair-construction officers appointed to oversee shipbuilding duties.
translations.idiomatic: Each province appointed repair officers to supervise warship construction.

sentences.zh: 由督、撫、提、鎮委副將、參將，會同文職道、府，領價督修，委都司會同文職府佐，辦料修造。

translations.literal: Governors-general, governors, regional commanders-in-chief, and commanders delegated deputy commanders and regimental commanders, jointly with civil circuit and prefectural officials, to receive funds and supervise repair; they delegated battalion commanders, jointly with civil prefectural assistants, to procure materials and build.
translations.idiomatic: Governors and commanders named deputy and regimental commanders, working with circuit and prefectural officials, to draw funds and oversee repairs, while battalion commanders and prefectural aides procured timber and carried out the work.

sentences.zh: 隸將軍標者，委參領等官辦理。

translations.literal: Those subordinate to a general's banner were delegated to company commanders and similar officers to handle.
translations.idiomatic: Ships under a territorial general's banner were handled by company commanders and their staff.

sentences.zh: 大修小修之年，各營呈報有司，題咨承修官，具冊領價。

translations.literal: In years of major or minor repair, each camp reported to the responsible office, memorialized the repair officer, and received funds on register.
translations.idiomatic: In major- or minor-repair years, camps reported upward, memorialized the repair officer, and drew funds against a registered schedule.

sentences.zh: 江南、江西、湖廣、福建、浙江、廣東等省，於屆修兩月前，領銀備料。

translations.literal: Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Huguang, Fujian, Zhejiang, Guangdong, and other provinces received silver to prepare materials two months before the repair term.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Huguang, Fujian, Zhejiang, Guangdong, and similar provinces drew repair funds two months before work was due.

sentences.zh: 台灣、瓊州於四月前備料。

translations.literal: Taiwan and Qiongzhou prepared materials before the fourth month.
translations.idiomatic: Taiwan and Qiongzhou prepared materials before the fourth month.

sentences.zh: 天津、山東於八月前備料。

translations.literal: Tianjin and Shandong prepared materials before the eighth month.
translations.idiomatic: Tianjin and Shandong prepared materials before the eighth month.

sentences.zh: 各營駕船赴廠，承修官即於次月興工，如期修竣，違則懲之。

translations.literal: Each camp sailed vessels to the yard; the repair officer began work the next month and finished on schedule—violators were punished.
translations.idiomatic: Camps sailed ships to the yard; repair officers began the following month and had to finish on time or face punishment.

sentences.zh: 其船名號各殊，大小異式，皆因地制宜。

translations.literal: Their vessel names and types differed, large and small in varied patterns, all adapted to local conditions.
translations.idiomatic: Vessel names, types, and sizes varied by region, each design suited to local waters.

sentences.zh: 山東登州、膠州南北二汛海口趕繒船、雙篷船，福建大號趕繒船及二三號船、雙篷船，江西南湖營沙唬船，天津大小趕繒船，京口水師船，蘇州、狼山、川沙、吳淞水師船，湖北、湖南、廣東各水師船之船身大小，木板厚薄，咸遵定制，令道員會同副將等監視督造。

translations.literal: For Shandong's Dengzhou and Jiaozhou north and south season estuary ganzeng and twin-sail vessels; Fujian large ganzeng and second- and third-grade and twin-sail vessels; Jiangxi South Lake camp shahu vessels; Tianjin large and small ganzeng; Jingkou naval vessels; Suzhou, Langshan, Chuansha, and Wusong naval vessels; and Huguang and Guangdong naval vessels—the hull dimensions and plank thickness all followed fixed regulations; circuit intendants were ordered jointly with deputy commanders and others to supervise construction.
translations.idiomatic: Hull sizes and plank thickness for ganzeng and twin-sail craft at Shandong's Dengzhou and Jiaozhou posts, Fujian's large and secondary ganzeng, Jiangxi's shahu patrol boats, Tianjin's ganzeng, Jingkou's fleet, the Suzhou–Wusong squadrons, and Huguang and Guangdong warships all followed standard specifications, with circuit intendants and deputy commanders supervising construction.

sentences.zh: 廣東外海內河戰船亦如之。

translations.literal: Guangdong open-sea and inner-river war vessels were the same.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong's open-sea and river warships followed the same rules.

sentences.zh: 十一年，定修造戰船限期，直隸限四月，福建、台灣限十月，山東限六月，江西大修拆造限三月，小修限兩月，江南限四月，湖廣大修拆造限六月，小修限四月，浙江限四月，廣東瓊州限六月，其餘各廠均限四月。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, deadlines for war-vessel repair and construction were fixed: Zhili four months; Fujian and Taiwan ten months; Shandong six months; Jiangxi major repair and dismantling three months, minor repair two months; Jiangnan four months; Huguang major repair and dismantling six months, minor repair four months; Zhejiang four months; Guangdong Qiongzhou six months; all other yards four months.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year (1733), repair deadlines were set: four months for Zhili and Jiangnan; ten for Fujian and Taiwan; six for Shandong; three for Jiangxi major work and two for minor; six and four respectively for Huguang major and minor work; four for Zhejiang; six for Qiongzhou; four for all other yards.

sentences.zh: 十二年，裁江蘇太湖營參將，改設太湖協副將，兼轄浙江太湖營游擊各官，定為內河水師營。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, the Jiangsu Taihu camp regimental commander was abolished; a Taihu brigade deputy commander was established, also commanding Zhejiang Taihu camp mobile brigadiers and other officers, fixed as an inner-river naval camp.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year (1734), the Jiangsu Taihu regimental post was abolished in favor of a brigade deputy who also commanded Zhejiang Taihu mobile brigadiers, defining an inland-river naval command.

sentences.zh: 十三年，議定天津、福建、浙江、廣東各戰船所需物料，或按年更新，或越年更新。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, materials needed for war vessels at Tianjin, Fujian, Zhejiang, and Guangdong were deliberated and fixed—some renewed annually, some biennially.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year (1735), supplies for Tianjin, Fujian, Zhejiang, and Guangdong warships were scheduled for annual or biennial renewal as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，議准江南各廠拆造及修理沙唬船、艍繒船，兩淮廠拆造沙唬船、修造趕繒船，於部價外，加津貼銀兩有差。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong, it was approved that for Jiangnan yards' dismantling and building of shahu and juyu vessels, and Lianghuai yards' dismantling of shahu and repair of ganzeng, supplemental allowance silver beyond ministry prices was added in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qianlong (1736), Jiangnan yards rebuilding shahu and juyu craft and Lianghuai yards rebuilding shahu and ganzeng received supplemental allowances above the ministry price list.

sentences.zh: 各廠同之。

translations.literal: All yards were the same.
translations.idiomatic: Other yards received the same treatment.

sentences.zh: 二年，令山東登、膠南北二汛額設雙篷船、趕繒船，屆修之年，亦增津貼銀。

translations.literal: In the second year, Shandong's Deng and Jiao north and south season allotted twin-sail and ganzeng vessels, in repair years, also received supplemental allowance silver.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year (1737), Shandong's Dengzhou and Jiaozhou twin-sail and ganzeng fleets received supplemental repair allowances when due for refit.

sentences.zh: 三年，撥湖北武昌水師駐漢口，為漢陽水師營中軍。

translations.literal: In the third year, Hubei Wuchang naval forces were transferred to garrison Hankou as the central battalion of the Hanyang naval camp.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year (1738), Wuchang's naval detachment was posted at Hankou as the Hanyang camp's central battalion.

sentences.zh: 議准廣東各標營外海戰船拆造，視修工大小，加津貼有差。

translations.literal: It was approved that for dismantling and building open-sea war vessels of Guangdong's various garrison camps, according to the scale of repair work, supplemental allowances differed.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong's open-sea warship rebuilds were approved for scaled supplemental allowances according to the size of the job.

sentences.zh: 四年，因沿海各省戰船報部，有缺少至十之二三者，或侵蝕修船帑銀，或賃與商人謀利。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, because coastal provinces' war vessels reported to the ministry were short by as much as two or three tenths, or repair funds were embezzled, or [vessels] were rented to merchants for profit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year (1739), coastal provinces reporting warships to the ministry were found short by up to thirty percent, or had embezzled repair funds, or leased vessels to merchants for profit.

sentences.zh: 令督撫嚴懲。

translations.literal: Governors were ordered to punish severely.
translations.idiomatic: Governors were ordered to punish offenders severely.

sentences.zh: 又諭浙江艍繒船拆修視江蘇省之例，艄船視江蘇省沙唬船之例，量加津貼。

translations.literal: It was further ordered that Zhejiang juyu vessel dismantling and repair follow Jiangsu's precedent, and stern vessels follow Jiangsu shahu precedent, with supplemental allowances added as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang was told to follow Jiangsu's allowance rules for juyu rebuilds and shahu-type stern craft, with appropriate supplements.

sentences.zh: 五年，復申禁沿海戰船缺少賃用之弊。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the prohibition was renewed against the abuse of coastal war-vessel shortages and leasing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year (1740), the court again forbade understating fleets and leasing warships for private gain.

sentences.zh: 六年，以台灣遠隔重洋，修造戰船，仍循舊制。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, because Taiwan was far across the ocean, war-vessel repair and construction still followed the old system.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year (1741), Taiwan's distance across the sea left its warship repair rules unchanged.

sentences.zh: 其福建各船廠，興泉道之泉廠，與興、泉、永三府協辦，汀漳龍道之漳廠，與汀、漳、龍三府協辦，鹽法道承修之福建廠，與延、邵、建三府協辦。

translations.literal: Fujian's various shipyards: the Quanzhou yard of the Xing-Quan circuit, jointly handled with Xinghua, Quanzhou, and Yongchun prefectures; the Zhangzhou yard of the Ting-Zhang-Long circuit, with Tingzhou, Zhangzhou, and Longyan; the Fujian yard undertaken by the Salt Control circuit, with Yanping, Shaowu, and Jianning.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian's yards were shared: the Quanzhou yard with three prefectures under the Xing-Quan intendant; the Zhangzhou yard with Ting, Zhang, and Longyan; and the main Fujian yard under the salt intendant with Yanping, Shaowu, and Jianning.

sentences.zh: 七年，裁江蘇黃浦營弁兵，改為提標水師右營。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Jiangsu Huangpu camp officers and troops were abolished and changed to the regional commander's banner naval right camp.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year (1742), the Huangpu detachment was abolished and reconstituted as the naval commander's right battalion.

sentences.zh: 八年，加福建三船廠津貼銀。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, supplemental allowance silver was added for Fujian's three shipyards.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year (1743), supplemental allowances were granted to Fujian's three shipyards.

sentences.zh: 十二年，加台灣船廠運費。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, transport costs for the Taiwan shipyard were increased.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year (1747), shipping subsidies for the Taiwan yard were increased.

sentences.zh: 十四年，令外海、內河水師戰船、哨船修竣後，承修官以船身丈尺及器具報有司毋損。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, after open-sea and inner-river naval war and patrol vessels were repaired, repair officers were ordered to report hull dimensions and equipment to the responsible office without loss.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year (1749), repair officers had to report full hull dimensions and fittings to civil authorities after refitting open-sea or river warships and patrol craft.

sentences.zh: 十五年，以閩、浙海洋綿亙數千里，遠達異域，所有外海商船，內洋賈舶，藉水師為巡護，尤恃兩省總巡大員，督飭弁兵，保商靖盜。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, because the Fujian and Zhejiang seas stretched thousands of li and reached distant regions, all open-sea merchant vessels and inner-coast trading ships relied on the naval forces for patrol protection, especially depending on the two provinces' grand patrol officers to supervise officers and troops, protect merchants, and pacify pirates.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year (1750), Fujian and Zhejiang's seas stretched thousands of miles to foreign waters; merchantmen on the open sea and coast depended on the navy for escort, above all on the two provinces' grand patrol commanders to drive officers and men to protect trade and suppress piracy.

sentences.zh: 而舊法未盡周詳，自二月出巡，至九月撤巡，為時太久。

translations.literal: Yet the old methods were not fully thorough; from setting out patrol in the second month until withdrawing patrol in the ninth month, the period was too long.
translations.idiomatic: The old rules were inadequate: patrols that began in the second month and did not end until the ninth lasted too long.

sentences.zh: 乃令各鎮總兵官每閱兩月會哨一次。

translations.literal: Therefore each garrison commander was ordered to hold a joint rendezvous once every two months.
translations.idiomatic: Commanders were therefore ordered to rendezvous at sea every two months.

sentences.zh: 其會哨之月，上汛則先巡北洋，後巡南洋。

translations.literal: In rendezvous months, in the upper season they first patrolled the northern sea route, then the southern.
translations.idiomatic: In rendezvous months of the upper season, they patrolled the northern route first, then the southern.

sentences.zh: 下汛則先巡南洋，後巡北洋。

translations.literal: In the lower season they first patrolled the southern route, then the northern.
translations.idiomatic: In the lower season the order was reversed: southern route first, then northern.

sentences.zh: 定海、崇明、黃岩、溫州、海壇、金門、南澳各水師總兵官，南北會巡，指定地方，蟬遞相聯，後先上下，由督撫派員稽察。

translations.literal: The naval commanders of Dinghai, Chongming, Huangyan, Wenzhou, Haitan, Jinmen, and Nan'ao, in north-south joint patrol, at designated places linked in continuous relay, fore and aft in sequence, were inspected by officers dispatched by governors.
translations.idiomatic: Naval commanders at Dinghai, Chongming, Huangyan, Wenzhou, Haitan, Jinmen, and Nan'ao patrolled north and south in relay at fixed stations, with governors sending officers to audit the chain.

sentences.zh: 至台澎水師，仍循曩例。

translations.literal: As for the Taiwan-Penghu naval forces, the former precedent was still followed.
translations.idiomatic: The Taiwan and Penghu fleets kept their former arrangements.

sentences.zh: 十六年，令福建三江口營大小戰船，按季整洗。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, Fujian's Sanjiangkou camp large and small war vessels were ordered cleaned and overhauled each quarter.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year (1751), Fujian's Sanjiangkou camp was ordered to clean and overhaul all warships quarterly.

sentences.zh: 十七年，令各省水師，除江南省沙唬船、巡快船，福建省艍船，輕便易使，廣東虎門協營沙礁迂曲外，其沿海各省戰船，一律製備頭巾插花，藉助風力，以資巡哨。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, each province's naval forces were ordered—except Jiangnan shahu and fast patrol vessels, Fujian juyu vessels that were light and easy to use, and Guangdong Humen brigade's winding sand reefs—to equip all coastal war vessels uniformly with headcloth sails and flower sails to aid wind power for patrol.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year (1752), coastal warships—except Jiangnan shahu and fast patrol craft, Fujian's light juyu, and Guangdong's twisting Humen shoals—were uniformly fitted with auxiliary sails to aid patrol in the wind.

sentences.zh: 巡船則仿民船，隨時修整。

translations.literal: Patrol vessels imitated civilian craft and were repaired at any time.
translations.idiomatic: Patrol boats copied merchant designs and could be refitted whenever needed.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，以外海、內河戰船，舊例酌留一半為捕盜之用，其餘各船，次第屆期改造，咸令展期三月，福建、浙江、江南、山東各省，咸展期半年。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year, for open-sea and inner-river war vessels, by old rule roughly half were kept for pirate suppression; the rest, as each reached its term, were to be rebuilt—all were ordered a three-month extension; Fujian, Zhejiang, Jiangnan, and Shandong each received a six-month extension.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fourth year (1789), half of open-sea and river warships were kept on patrol under the old rule while the rest were rebuilt on schedule; all provinces received three months' grace, and Fujian, Zhejiang, Jiangnan, and Shandong six months.

sentences.zh: 五十五年，以搜捕海盜，戰船拙滯，允水師將弁之請，仿民船改制戰船，以期迅捷。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fifth year, for hunting pirates, because war vessels were clumsy and slow, the request of naval officers was granted to rebuild war vessels on the model of civilian craft, hoping for speed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fifth year (1790), warships proved too slow for pirate hunts, so the court approved naval officers' request to rebuild them along merchant lines for greater speed.

sentences.zh: 五十八年，因廣東海盜充斥，自南澳至瓊、崖，千有餘里，水師戰船，雖有大小百數十號，僅能分防本營洋面，不敷追捕，致商船報劫頻聞。

translations.literal: In the fifty-eighth year, because Guangdong was full of pirates, from Nan'ao to Qiong and Ya, more than a thousand li, although the naval war vessels numbered over a hundred large and small, they could only divide defense of their own camp's sea area and were insufficient for pursuit, so merchant-vessel robbery reports were often heard.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-eighth year (1793), pirates filled Guangdong's thousand-odd miles from Nan'ao to Hainan; though the navy mustered over a hundred warships, they could guard only their own stations and could not chase raiders, and merchant losses mounted.

sentences.zh: 歷年捕盜，俱賃用東莞米艇，而船隻不多，民間苦累。

translations.literal: Year after year for pirate suppression, Dongguan rice barges were all rented, but vessels were few and the populace suffered hardship.
translations.idiomatic: For years the navy had rented Dongguan rice barges for raids, but there were too few boats and civilians bore the burden.

sentences.zh: 乃籌款十五萬兩，製造二千五百石大米艇四十七艘，二千石中米艇二十六艘，一千五百石小米艇二十艘，限三月造竣，按通省水師營，視海道遠近，分佈上下洋面，配兵巡緝，以佐舊船所不及。

translations.literal: Therefore 150,000 taels were raised to build forty-seven large rice barges of 2,500 piculs capacity, twenty-six medium barges of 2,000 piculs, and twenty small barges of 1,500 piculs, to be completed within three months; distributed among the province's naval camps according to distance on the sea routes on upper and lower open waters, with troops assigned to patrol, to supplement what old vessels could not reach.
translations.idiomatic: The government raised 150,000 taels to build ninety-three new patrol barges—forty-seven of 2,500 piculs, twenty-six of 2,000, and twenty of 1,500—within three months, posting them with crews along Guangdong's coast where old warships could not reach.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，以浙江定海縣之舟山外有五奎山，外洋船隻，皆於此寄泊，實為海濱要區，於定海鎮標內，酌撥弁兵，更番戍守。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year, because outside Zhoushan in Zhejiang's Dinghai county there was Wukui Mountain, where open-sea vessels all anchored—a true key coastal area—officers and troops were allotted from the Dinghai garrison banner to garrison in rotation.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-ninth year (1794), Wukui Mountain off Dinghai's Zhoushan, where ocean-going ships routinely anchored, was judged a vital post and garrisoned by rotating detachments from the Dinghai command.

sentences.zh: 六十年，以沿海戰船過於累重，不便捕盜，每屆修造，需費尤多，通飭各督撫，屆修造之年，俱仿商船之式改造，以所節浮費，為外洋緝捕之用。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year, because coastal war vessels were too heavy and cumbersome for pirate suppression, and each repair term cost especially much, all governors were ordered that in repair years all should be rebuilt in merchant-ship style, using saved excess funds for open-sea pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixtieth year (1795), coastal warships were judged too heavy and costly for anti-piracy work; governors were told to rebuild them like merchant craft at each refit and devote the savings to open-sea patrols.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，浙江戰船俱仿民船改造。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiaqing, all Zhejiang war vessels were rebuilt imitating civilian craft.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jiaqing (1797), Zhejiang rebuilt all warships on civilian models.

sentences.zh: 山東戰船亦仿浙省行之。

translations.literal: Shandong war vessels also followed Zhejiang's practice.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong followed Zhejiang's example for its fleet.

sentences.zh: 其餘沿海戰船，於應行拆造之年，一律改小，仿民船改造，以利操防。

translations.literal: The remaining coastal war vessels, in years when dismantling and rebuilding was due, were uniformly made smaller and rebuilt on civilian models, to benefit maneuver and defense.
translations.idiomatic: Other coastal warships due for rebuild were uniformly scaled down to civilian patterns to improve handling and combat readiness.

sentences.zh: 五年，諭各省水師，向設統巡、總巡、分巡及專汛各員，出洋巡哨。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, each province's naval forces were instructed: the established grand patrol, general patrol, sub-patrol, and dedicated-garrison officers were to go to sea on patrol.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year (1800), every provincial navy was reminded that grand, general, and sub-patrol officers and dedicated garrison commanders were required to patrol at sea.

sentences.zh: 奉行日久，有以千總等代巡之弊。

translations.literal: Observed over time, there was the abuse of company commanders and others substituting for patrol.
translations.idiomatic: Over time, the abuse had spread of letting company-grade officers substitute for commanders on patrol.

sentences.zh: 嗣後令總兵官為統巡，副將、參將、游擊為總巡，都司、守備為分巡，遇有事故，以次代巡，不得以微員擅代。

translations.literal: Henceforth commanders were made grand patrol officers; deputy commanders, regimental commanders, and mobile brigadiers general patrol; battalion and garrison commanders sub-patrol; when incidents occurred, substitutes patrolled in order of rank—low officers must not usurp substitution on their own.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter commanders alone held grand patrol duty, deputies and regimental officers general patrol, and battalion and garrison commanders sub-patrol; substitutes had to follow rank order, and junior officers could no longer stand in for their superiors.

sentences.zh: 山東水師，向未有統巡等職名，亦一律行之。

translations.literal: Shandong naval forces had never had titles such as grand patrol; this was also uniformly applied.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong's navy, which had never had grand patrol and similar posts, was brought under the same rule.

sentences.zh: 九年，因各省師船向遵部頒定式，僅能就近海巡查，不能放洋遠出，多改雇商船，出洋捕盜。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, because each province's fleet vessels customarily followed Board-prescribed patterns, they could only patrol near coastal waters and could not sail far out to open sea; many turned to hiring merchant vessels to go to sea and capture pirates.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, provincial warships built to standard designs could patrol only close to shore and could not venture far out; many provinces hired merchantmen for open-sea piracy suppression instead.

sentences.zh: 廷臣建議，戰船改商船制度，以收實用。

translations.literal: Court officials proposed converting war vessels to merchant-ship designs to gain practical utility.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers recommended remaking warships on merchant models for real effectiveness.

sentences.zh: 旋諭江蘇省濱海之區，屢有盜劫，所有舊式戰船，令疆臣仿廣東、福建、浙江之例，即行改制。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward Jiangsu's coastal districts, which had suffered repeated robbery, were instructed: all old-style war vessels should be immediately rebuilt following the examples of Guangdong, Fujian, and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: The throne then ordered Jiangsu, plagued by coastal raids, to rebuild all old warships immediately on the model already used in Guangdong, Fujian, and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 十一年，諭沿海疆吏，當乾隆五十五年，曾嚴飭統兵官實力訓練舟師，乃日久玩生，弁兵於操駕事宜，全不練習，遇放洋之時，僱用舵工，名為舟師，不諳水務。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, coastal frontier officials were admonished: in the fifty-fifth year of Qianlong strict orders had been issued for commanding officers to train naval forces in earnest, yet over time laxness had set in—officers and men practiced nothing in sailing and handling; when it came time to put to sea they hired helmsmen, called them sailors, who were unskilled in naval affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, coastal governors were reminded that in the fifty-fifth year of Qianlong the throne had ordered real naval training; discipline had since collapsed, troops never drilled in sailing, and at sea they hired helmsmen who barely knew the water.

sentences.zh: 嗣後通飭所轄各營，勒期訓練，一切帆舵各技，務皆嫺習。

translations.literal: Thereafter orders went out to every garrison under their jurisdiction to train within a set period; every skill in sails, rudders, and the like was to be thoroughly mastered.
translations.idiomatic: All camps were then ordered to train on a fixed schedule until every sail and steering skill was fully mastered.

sentences.zh: 其最優者，不次擢用，惰者懲之。

translations.literal: The most excellent were promoted out of turn; the slack were punished.
translations.idiomatic: Top performers would be promoted ahead of schedule; laggards would be punished.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，規復天津水師營汛，以閩、浙、兩廣、兩江各省所裁水師，遵舊制募足額數，改隸天津水師，分營管轄。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, the Tianjin naval garrison posts were planned for restoration; naval forces cut from Fujian, Zhejiang, the two Guang provinces, and the two Jiang provinces were recruited to full establishment per old regulations, reassigned to Tianjin naval forces, and divided among garrisons for jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, Tianjin's naval posts were restored by recruiting to full strength from men cut from coastal provinces and organizing them under Tianjin command in separate camps.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，增設天津水師總兵官，以專責成。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, a Tianjin naval commander was added to bear sole responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, a dedicated naval commander was appointed for Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 道光四年，諭福建疆臣，前以閩省戰船遲重，駕駛不便，曾裁汰十五船，其餘俟拆修之年，令承修官仿同安梭船式，一律改造。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Daoguang, Fujian officials were instructed: because Fujian war vessels had been slow and heavy and hard to sail, fifteen had been cut; the rest, when their dismantling-and-rebuild year came, were to be uniformly rebuilt by repair officers on the Tong'an fast-sail model.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Daoguang, Fujian was told that fifteen heavy warships had already been scrapped and the remainder must be rebuilt as Tong'an-style fast-sail craft at the next refit.

sentences.zh: 嗣後閩洋米艇，緝捕仍不得力，其已改造之勝字六號米艇八艘無須裁汰外，所有屆修之捷字六號十二艘，存營之勝字一號十號兩艘，修竣之勝字三號一艘，悉行裁撤。

translations.literal: Afterward rice barges on Fujian seas still proved inadequate for pursuit; aside from eight rebuilt Sheng No. 6 rice barges that need not be cut, all twelve Jie No. 6 due for repair, two Sheng No. 1 and No. 10 kept in camp, and one Sheng No. 3 newly repaired were entirely abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian's rice barges still failed at patrol work; aside from eight rebuilt Sheng No. 6 vessels, twenty-one others—twelve Jie No. 6 due for refit, two in service, and one just repaired—were all scrapped.

sentences.zh: 十年，令直隸、浙江、福建統兵官，增撥哨船，梭巡南北洋面。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, commanding officers of Zhili, Zhejiang, and Fujian were ordered to allocate additional patrol vessels to shuttle-cruise the north and south open waters.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, Zhili, Zhejiang, and Fujian commanders were told to deploy more patrol craft on the northern and southern coastal seas.

sentences.zh: 是年，定水師人員一年試驗之制，各統兵官隨帶出洋，親加考驗。

translations.literal: That year the system was fixed for annual examination of naval personnel; each commanding officer would take men to sea and personally examine them.
translations.idiomatic: That year an annual at-sea examination was instituted, with each commander testing his men personally.

sentences.zh: 又嚴定改用外海水師人員之制，其外省世職，及陸路呈改人員，有才具可用，或曾立功績者，由督撫保題。

translations.literal: The system was also strictly set for transferring open-sea naval personnel: hereditary officers from other provinces and those who had petitioned to transfer from land service, if talented or having rendered merit, were to be recommended by governors.
translations.idiomatic: Rules were tightened for filling open-sea posts: hereditary officers and land officers seeking transfer with proven talent or merit could be recommended by governors.

sentences.zh: 十三年，整頓浙江省水師，增造闊船、舢板船。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Zhejiang naval forces were reorganized and additional broad boats and sampans were built.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, Zhejiang's navy was reorganized and more broad boats and sampans were constructed.

sentences.zh: 十五年，以各省水師廢弛，憚於出巡，致盜案疊出，嚴飭水師提、鎮實力訓練緝捕。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, because provincial naval forces had decayed and feared going on patrol, causing cases of piracy to pile up, naval admirals and commanders were strictly ordered to train and pursue in earnest.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, decay and patrol-shyness across provincial navies had led to a surge in piracy; admirals and commanders were ordered to train and hunt pirates in earnest.

sentences.zh: 十八年，以各省戰船每屆修造之年，承辦各員，冒領中飽，不能如式製造，或以舊代新，或操駕不勤，馴至朽腐，令統兵大臣核實辦理。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, because each repair cycle for provincial war vessels saw contractors embezzle and fill their own pockets, failing to build to spec, or pass off old for new, or sail and drill lazily until vessels rotted, commanding grand ministers were ordered to verify and deal with the matter.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, corrupt shipbuilding and neglected maintenance had left warships rotting; senior commanders were ordered to investigate and punish those responsible.

sentences.zh: 十九年，令督、撫、提、鎮禁將弁扣索之弊，並甄汰劣員，如有呈改召募，不得瞻徇。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, governors, admirals, and commanders were ordered to forbid the abuse of officers withholding and extorting, to screen out inferior personnel, and not show favor when petitions for transfer or recruitment came in.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, governors and commanders were told to stop officers' extortion, purge incompetents, and refuse favoritism in transfers and recruitment.

sentences.zh: 二十年，以各省戰船修造草率，並有遲延積壓各弊。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, because provincial war-vessel repair was slipshod and there were abuses of delay and backlog.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, slipshod repairs and mounting backlogs plagued provincial warships.

sentences.zh: 福建船廠所修成字四號大船，甫經拆造，即致破壞。

translations.literal: At the Fujian shipyard, the large Cheng No. 4 vessel had barely been rebuilt when it broke apart.
translations.idiomatic: A large Cheng No. 4 ship at the Fujian yard fell apart immediately after rebuilding.

sentences.zh: 自道光六年至二十年，積壓各船至三十艘之多。

translations.literal: From the sixth to the twentieth year of Daoguang, backlogged vessels piled up to as many as thirty.
translations.idiomatic: From the sixth through the twentieth year of Daoguang, the backlog reached thirty ships.

sentences.zh: 承修各員，悉予懲處。

translations.literal: All repair contractors were punished.
translations.idiomatic: Everyone responsible for the repairs was punished.

sentences.zh: 各廠應修之船，一律嚴催。

translations.literal: Ships due for repair at every yard were uniformly pressed with strict deadlines.
translations.idiomatic: Every yard was ordered to hurry overdue repairs.

sentences.zh: 其水師各船巡洋之餘，各提、鎮大員，飭將弁操練燂洗，毋任久泊海壖。

translations.literal: When not cruising, naval vessels were ordered by admirals and commanders to drill and careen, and not be left long at anchor on the shore.
translations.idiomatic: Between patrols, admirals and commanders were to have officers drill crews and careen hulls instead of letting ships rot at anchor.

sentences.zh: 又因廣東虎門海口為海防中路要區，以西境之香山，東境之大鵬，為左右兩翼，嘉慶十五年，設水師提督，節制各路。

translations.literal: Also, because Humen estuary in Guangdong was a key midline for coastal defense, with Xiangshan on the west and Dapeng on the east as left and right wings—in the fifteenth year of Jiaqing a naval admiral was established to control all routes.
translations.idiomatic: Humen, the central pivot of Guangdong's defense with Xiangshan and Dapeng as its flanks, had gained a naval admiral in the fifteenth year of Jiaqing to oversee all routes.

sentences.zh: 香山副將所轄水師，兵力稍厚。

translations.literal: The naval forces under the Xiangshan deputy commander were somewhat stronger in numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangshan's deputy commander commanded a somewhat larger force.

sentences.zh: 大鵬參將所轄弁兵，僅九百餘人。

translations.literal: The officers and men under the Dapeng regimental commander numbered only nine hundred-odd.
translations.idiomatic: Dapeng's regimental commander had barely nine hundred troops.

sentences.zh: 道光十年，又分為二營，其所轄大嶼山及尖沙嘴洋面，為夷船聚泊之所，乃擇要建砲台二座，與水師相依護，以澄海副將改為大鵬協副將，移駐九龍山，增額設水師，兼守砲台，增造大號中號米艇四艘，快船二艘，在水師各協營，抽配弁兵，巡緝洋面。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Daoguang it was divided into two camps; the waters of Lantau and Tsim Sha Tsui under its jurisdiction, where foreign vessels gathered, were deemed critical—two forts were built at key points, mutually protecting with the navy; the Chenghai deputy commander was changed to Dapeng brigade deputy commander, transferred to Kowloon Hill, naval strength was increased to garrison the forts, four large and medium rice barges and two fast boats were added, and officers and men were drawn from various naval brigade camps to patrol the open waters.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Daoguang the district was split into two camps; forts were built where foreign ships anchored at Lantau and Tsim Sha Tsui, the Chenghai deputy was moved to Kowloon as Dapeng brigade deputy, extra naval troops garrisoned the forts, and new rice barges and fast boats joined patrols drawn from other camps.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，以外夷船堅砲利，舊設外海水師，強弱不敵，等於虛設，擬改水師為陸師，專防內地。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, because foreign vessels were stout and guns powerful, the established open-sea navy could not match them and was virtually useless—it was proposed to convert naval forces to land forces and defend only the interior.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, foreign ships outclassed the open-sea navy so completely that officials proposed turning sailors into land troops and abandoning open-water defense.

sentences.zh: 尋以海盜滋擾，全恃水師緝捕，廣東之虎門，為外海籓籬，尤藉舟師之力，乃定議緩裁。

translations.literal: Soon because pirates multiplied and suppression depended entirely on the navy—and Guangdong's Humen was the open sea's outer barrier, especially relying on naval strength—the decision to cut forces was deferred.
translations.idiomatic: Piracy soon made the plan moot: suppression still depended on the navy, and Humen remained the outer shield of Guangdong, so the cut was postponed.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，以海上用兵，專恃砲火，令各疆臣訓練弁兵，一律以施放砲位有準，為弁兵去取。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, because warfare at sea relied solely on gunfire, frontier officials were ordered to train officers and men, uniformly using accurate gunnery as the criterion for keeping or dismissing them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, coastal warfare turned on artillery; governors were ordered to train troops and keep or dismiss them based on shooting accuracy.

sentences.zh: 又以海上用兵二載，閩、粵、江、浙水師，迭致挫敗，令四川、湖廣等省，採購巨木，速制堅船，駛往閩、浙等省，防守海疆。

translations.literal: Also, after two years of warfare at sea the navies of Fujian, Guangdong, Jiangsu, and Zhejiang had suffered repeated defeats; Sichuan, Huguang, and other provinces were ordered to procure great timber, swiftly build sturdy ships, and sail them to Fujian, Zhejiang, and elsewhere to defend the coast.
translations.idiomatic: After two years of naval war had broken Fujian, Guangdong, Jiangsu, and Zhejiang fleets, Sichuan and Huguang were told to cut timber, build stout ships, and send them to defend the coast.

sentences.zh: 尋因各省戰船，如快蟹、拖風、撈繒、八槳等船，僅能用於江湖港汊，新造之船，亦止備內河巡緝，難於海上衝鋒。

translations.literal: Soon it was seen that provincial war vessels—fast-crab boats, tow-sail boats, laozeng boats, eight-oar boats, and the like—could be used only on rivers, lakes, and creeks, and newly built ships were fit only for inner-river patrol, not for charging on the open sea.
translations.idiomatic: It became clear that fast-crab, tow-sail, laozeng, and eight-oar craft served only rivers and creeks; even new ships could patrol inland waters but not fight at sea.

sentences.zh: 惟潘仕成捐資新制之船，堅固適用，砲亦得力，並仿美利堅國兵船製造船樣一艘，又仿英吉利國中等兵船之式，調取各省工匠，改造大船。

translations.literal: Only the ships Pan Shicheng had funded and newly built were solid and useful, their guns effective; one vessel was also built on an American warship model, and on British medium warship models craftsmen from various provinces were summoned to rebuild large ships.
translations.idiomatic: Only Pan Shicheng's privately funded new vessels proved sturdy and effective; one copied an American warship, British mid-size models guided larger rebuilds, and craftsmen from many provinces were called in.

sentences.zh: 其例修師船，一律停造，以資挹注。

translations.literal: Scheduled repair of fleet vessels was uniformly halted to supply resources from that stream.
translations.idiomatic: Routine fleet repairs were halted so funds could be diverted to the new program.

sentences.zh: 並以船砲圖說，飭江蘇、福建、浙江三省督撫詳勘，何者利用，由廣東省製成，分運各省。

translations.literal: Ship-and-gun diagrams and specifications were sent ordering Jiangsu, Fujian, and Zhejiang governors to examine which designs were useful; Guangdong would manufacture them and distribute to each province.
translations.idiomatic: Governors of Jiangsu, Fujian, and Zhejiang were sent ship and gun plans to choose the best designs for Guangdong to build and ship province by province.

sentences.zh: 又因湖北省所轄長江千餘里，舊設宜昌鎮標，荊州、漢陽各水師營，戰船不能載砲。

translations.literal: Also because Hubei's jurisdiction over the Yangtze exceeded a thousand li, with the old Yichang garrison banner and Jingzhou and Hanyang naval camps, war vessels could not carry guns.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei's thousand-li stretch of Yangtze, guarded by Yichang, Jingzhou, and Hanyang camps, had warships too weak to mount artillery.

sentences.zh: 廣東匠役何禮貴曾為外洋造船，能造火輪及各式戰船，飭赴湖北，擇何項戰船利於長江駕駛，即就海船之式，量為變通。

translations.literal: The Guangdong artisan He Ligui, who had built foreign-style ships and could build steamers and every kind of war vessel, was ordered to go to Hubei and choose what type of war vessel suited Yangtze sailing, adapting seagoing models as needed.
translations.idiomatic: He Ligui, a Guangdong shipwright experienced in foreign-style and steam vessels, was sent to Hubei to adapt seagoing designs for the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 裕泰擬造之開浪船，于海戰未宜，罷之。

translations.literal: The kailang boat Yu Tai proposed to build was unsuitable for sea battle and was abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Tai's proposed kailang boat was rejected as unfit for naval combat.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，飭沿海各提、鎮，於每歲出洋及巡洋事畢，所經歷情形，悉以上聞。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, coastal admirals and commanders were ordered that when each year's voyages to sea and cruises were finished, all circumstances experienced were to be fully reported upward.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, coastal admirals and commanders were required to report fully on every annual patrol once it ended.

sentences.zh: 三十年，因浙江省水師廢弛，飭有司整治船砲，嚴禁奸民接濟海盜，並令沿海將領，按時出洋會哨。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, because Zhejiang naval forces had decayed, officials were ordered to restore ships and guns, strictly forbid civilians aiding pirates, and require coastal generals to go to sea on schedule for joint patrols.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year, Zhejiang's decayed navy prompted orders to fix ships and guns, stop civilian aid to pirates, and keep coastal commanders on patrol schedule.

sentences.zh: 又令山東疆臣，以三汛師船，四縣水勇，合而為一，統以專員，往來策應，並於扼要島嶼，設置大砲。

translations.literal: Shandong officials were also ordered to combine the three-season fleet, water braves of four counties, into one body under a dedicated officer for mutual support, and to place large guns on key islands.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong was told to unite its seasonal fleet and county water militia under one officer for coordinated response and to mount heavy guns on strategic islands.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，以長江轄境綿長，令張亮基等購置船砲，擇要駐守。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng, because the Yangtze jurisdiction was long, Zhang Liangji and others were ordered to purchase ships and guns and garrison key points.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xianfeng, the long Yangtze stretch led to orders for Zhang Liangji and others to buy ships and guns for key garrisons.

sentences.zh: 三年，調廣東外海水師拖罟戰船，及快蟹、大扒等船百艘，統以大員，由海道駛赴江寧，助剿粵寇。

translations.literal: In the third year, a hundred open-sea trawler-type war junks and fast-crab and dabba boats from Guangdong's open-sea navy were transferred under a senior officer, sailing by sea route to Jiangning to help suppress the Cantonese rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, a hundred Guangdong trawler junks, fast-crab boats, and dabba craft sailed by sea to Jiangning under a senior commander to fight the rebels.

sentences.zh: 是年，江忠源疏請廣制戰船，以靖江面。

translations.literal: That year Jiang Zhongyuan memorialized requesting broad manufacture of war vessels to pacify the river surface.
translations.idiomatic: That year Jiang Zhongyuan asked permission to build many warships to secure the river.

sentences.zh: 旋令兩廣督臣，以廣東拖罟船式咨行四川、湖廣各督撫，或在本省，或在湖北宜昌一帶，迅簡工匠，造水師船百餘艘，每船載兵五十人，於三月內竣事。

translations.literal: Shortly the Liangguang governor was ordered to circulate Guangdong trawler specifications to Sichuan and Huguang governors; craftsmen were to be quickly selected either in their own provinces or around Yichang in Hubei to build over a hundred naval vessels, fifty troops per ship, completed within three months.
translations.idiomatic: The governor-general of Liangguang was told to send Guangdong trawler plans to Sichuan and Huguang so craftsmen could build a hundred-plus naval ships—fifty men each—within three months.

sentences.zh: 兼飭湖南、湖北二省，購船募兵，與長江下遊艇船，協力防江。

translations.literal: Hunan and Hubei were also ordered to purchase ships and recruit troops, coordinating with downstream Yangtze patrol boats to defend the river jointly.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan and Hubei were also told to buy boats, recruit troops, and work with downstream Yangtze craft to hold the line.

sentences.zh: 旋以所購民船不合用，乃收買江船之巨者，仿廣東船式，安置砲位，與廣東所募紅單船，及賃用拖罟船，駛赴江南剿寇。

translations.literal: Soon because purchased civilian vessels were unfit, large Yangtze boats were bought, rebuilt on Guangdong models with gun mounts, and together with Guangdong-recruited red-bar ships and rented trawlers were sent to Jiangnan to suppress rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Purchased civilian craft proved useless, so large river boats were bought, fitted with guns on Guangdong patterns, and sent south with red-bar ships and rented trawlers to fight the rebels.

sentences.zh: 又以廣東內河及濱海各廳縣，均有捐造緝捕快蟹船，道光間，江海捕盜，悉藉其力。

translations.literal: Also, in Guangdong's inner rivers and coastal districts every subprefecture and county had donated fast-crab boats for pursuit—in the Daoguang era river and sea piracy suppression had relied entirely on their strength.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong's inner rivers and coast had also produced donated fast-crab patrol boats that had carried Daoguang-era anti-piracy work.

sentences.zh: 船頭藏巨砲，旁列子母砲，勇丁咸技藝精練，洵水戰最長。

translations.literal: Their bows concealed great guns, sides lined with chambered cannon; braves were all skilled in technique—they were truly best at water combat.
translations.idiomatic: Their bows hid heavy guns and their sides carried chambered cannon; their crews were expert—the finest force for river fighting.

sentences.zh: 令各船由海道至長江會師。

translations.literal: All vessels were ordered to reach the Yangtze by sea route and assemble.
translations.idiomatic: Every boat was ordered to reach the Yangtze by sea and join the fleet.

sentences.zh: 是年，曾國籓試造師船於湖南，以規模過小，乃就廣東之拖罟船、快蟹船二種，參酌其制，先造十艘，續增二、三十艘，以能載千斤之砲為度。

translations.literal: That year Zeng Guofan trial-built fleet vessels in Hunan; finding them too small, he took Guangdong trawler and fast-crab models, blending their designs—first ten, then twenty or thirty more—with the standard of carrying thousand-jin guns.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan first tried building fleet ships in Hunan but found them too small; he then blended Guangdong trawler and fast-crab designs, building ten then twenty to thirty more, each able to mount a thousand-jin gun.

sentences.zh: 至拖罟船，則由兩湖督撫如式製造。

translations.literal: As for trawlers, the Huguang governors were to manufacture them to pattern.
translations.idiomatic: Trawlers were to be built to pattern by the Huguang governors.

sentences.zh: 四年，令廣東賃用之紅單船二十三艘，並修治十九艘，凡四十二艘，統一武員，駛入長江。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, twenty-three rented red-bar ships from Guangdong plus nineteen repaired ones—forty-two in all—were placed under one military officer and sailed into the Yangtze.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, forty-two red-bar ships—twenty-three rented and nineteen refitted—entered the Yangtze under one commander.

sentences.zh: 是年，以粵寇竄擾東南，水師不敷剿堵，下游惟廣東紅單、拖罟等船漸集瓜洲，上游惟曾國籓新造戰船，自湖南順流而下，已達武昌。

translations.literal: That year, because Cantonese rebels raided the southeast and the navy was insufficient to suppress and block them, downstream only Guangdong red-bar and trawler ships gradually gathered at Guazhou; upstream only Zeng Guofan's newly built war vessels, flowing down from Hunan, had already reached Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels overran the southeast and the navy could not contain them; downstream Guangdong red-bar and trawler craft gathered at Guazhou while upstream Zeng Guofan's new ships from Hunan had reached Wuchang.

sentences.zh: 其九江、安慶等處，尚無戰艦，令張亮基、駱秉章購置江船及釣鉤等船，裕瑞、夏廷樾在四川採購材料，與駱秉章商辦。

translations.literal: At Jiujiang, Anqing, and elsewhere there were still no warships; Zhang Liangji and Luo Bingzhang were ordered to purchase river boats and hook boats; Yurui and Xia Tingyue procured materials in Sichuan, consulting with Luo Bingzhang.
translations.idiomatic: Jiujiang and Anqing still lacked warships; Zhang Liangji and Luo Bingzhang were to buy river and hook boats while Yurui and Xia Tingyue sourced materials in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 旋駱秉章以四川造船，江險而途遠，水程不便，仍在湖南購料製造。

translations.literal: Soon Luo Bingzhang noted that building ships in Sichuan—the river treacherous and distance great—made transport inconvenient, and materials were still purchased and built in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Bingzhang then judged Sichuan shipbuilding impractical because of treacherous rivers and long hauls, and kept procurement in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 兩湖紳士丁善慶，遵曾國籓所定之式，已成大板艇五十號，長龍等船亦次第告成。

translations.literal: Huguang gentry Ding Shanqing, following Zeng Guofan's fixed patterns, had completed fifty daban boats; long dragon boats and others also came successively to completion.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Shanqing of Huguang gentry, using Zeng Guofan's designs, finished fifty daban boats; long dragon boats and others followed.

sentences.zh: 長江剿寇，在江南取勝者，以紅單船、拖罟船二種為最，體勢雄壯，置砲最多，而能順風不能逆風，宜江面寬闊，不宜港汊。

translations.literal: For Yangtze rebel suppression, in Jiangnan the victors were chiefly red-bar ships and trawlers—imposing in build, with the most guns—but they could run with the wind and not against it; suited to broad river reaches, not creeks and harbors.
translations.idiomatic: On the lower Yangtze, red-bar ships and trawlers proved strongest: massive, heavily armed, fast downwind but helpless against it, fit for open water not narrow creeks.

sentences.zh: 在湖南取勝者，以舢板船、長龍船、快蟹船三種為最，往來輕便，搜捕尤宜，而風急水溜，一下難於遽上，勢散而力單。

translations.literal: In Hunan the victors were chiefly sampans, long dragon boats, and fast-crab boats—light in coming and going, especially suited to search and capture—but in fierce wind and swift current, once swept downstream it was hard to regain position; force was scattered and strength thin.
translations.idiomatic: Upstream Hunan favored sampans, long dragon boats, and fast-crab craft: nimble for pursuit but swept helplessly downstream in strong wind and current, with forces scattered and strength thin.

sentences.zh: 令湖南水師沿江攻剿，與江南水師會合，各用其所長，以期制勝。

translations.literal: Hunan naval forces were ordered to attack along the river and join Jiangnan naval forces, each employing its strengths, to seek victory.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan's navy was ordered to fight downriver and meet Jiangnan's fleet, each side using its strengths to win.

sentences.zh: 六年，以曾國籓在江西所造戰船，最為得力，令福濟選擇將弁，率工匠赴廬州仿造，所需洋砲，在上海撥款辦解。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, because war vessels Zeng Guofan built in Jiangxi were most effective, Fu Ji was ordered to select officers, lead craftsmen to Luzhou to copy them, and foreign guns needed were funded and dispatched from Shanghai.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Zeng Guofan's Jiangxi-built warships were judged best; Fu Ji was told to copy them at Luzhou with foreign guns funded from Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 六年，胡林翼以長江水師，自五年春間回駐武、漢以後，戰艦無多，乃與駱秉章協商，督率船砲局各員，儘力籌謀，水師復振。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Hu Linyi noted that since the Yangtze navy returned to garrison at Wuhan in spring of the fifth year there were few warships; he consulted with Luo Bingzhang, supervised ship-and-gun bureau staff, and exerted all effort in planning—the navy revived.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Hu Linyi, finding few warships since the fleet returned to Wuhan in spring of the fifth year, worked with Luo Bingzhang to revive the Yangtze navy.

sentences.zh: 湖南紳局所制船械，交至營中者，大小戰船凡三百餘艘，火藥四十餘萬斤，砲子一百四十萬斤，其餘各械咸備，請優詔獎之。

translations.literal: Ship and arms from Hunan gentry bureaus delivered to camps included over three hundred large and small war vessels, over four hundred thousand jin of gunpowder, 1.4 million jin of shot—all other equipment complete—a request for an imperial commendation was made.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan gentry bureaus supplied over three hundred warships, four hundred thousand jin of powder, and 1.4 million jin of shot; a reward edict was requested.

sentences.zh: 水師重在砲位，廣東運到洋砲二百尊，續運六百尊，配置各師船，自武、漢至九江，所向克捷。

translations.literal: Naval forces rely heavily on gun mounts; two hundred foreign guns arrived from Guangdong, six hundred more followed, fitted to fleet vessels—from Wuchang to Jiujiang, wherever sent, victory followed.
translations.idiomatic: The navy depended on artillery; two hundred foreign guns came from Guangdong, then six hundred more, arming the fleet for victories from Wuhan to Jiujiang.

sentences.zh: 惟長江水戰，上下游形勢不同，武、漢以上，利用輕便戰船，潯、皖以下，江面漸廣，利用巨艦，秋冬風勁宜巨艦，春夏宜小艇，船砲之大小，宜因時因地而損益之。

translations.literal: Only on Yangtze water combat upstream and downstream conditions differed: above Wuhan light war vessels were useful; below Xun and Wan the river widened and great ships were useful; in autumn and winter when winds were strong great ships suited, in spring and summer small boats suited—ship and gun size should be increased or decreased according to time and place.
translations.idiomatic: Yangtze fighting differed by reach: light craft above Wuhan, large ships below where the river widened; autumn-winter favored big hulls, spring-summer small boats—ship and gun size had to match season and terrain.

sentences.zh: 請令兩廣督臣，續購大小洋砲，自四百斤至一千五百斤，凡八百尊，盡易舊式砲位，以利東征。

translations.literal: Request that the Liangguang governor continue purchasing large and small foreign guns from four hundred to fifteen hundred jin, eight hundred in all, replacing all old-style gun mounts to benefit the eastern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: They asked Liangguang to buy eight hundred foreign guns from four hundred to fifteen hundred jin to replace old mounts for the eastern offensive.

sentences.zh: 八年，以天津原設水師，道光間，先後裁撤，乃籌復設，以重海防。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, because Tianjin's original naval forces had been cut in stages during Daoguang, plans were made to restore them to strengthen coastal defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, Tianjin's navy cut under Daoguang was slated for restoration to reinforce coastal defense.

sentences.zh: 令福建、廣東疆吏，各抽調大號戰艦，備齊砲械，由海道駛赴天津，設水師三千人。

translations.literal: Fujian and Guangdong officials were ordered each to detach large warships, equip them fully with guns and gear, sail by sea to Tianjin, and establish a navy of three thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian and Guangdong were told to send large warships with full armament by sea to Tianjin and raise a three-thousand-man navy.

sentences.zh: 十年，令清淮籌防局籌款，為防湖水師常年經費，增設淮揚水師營，以保兩淮鹽場，兼佐陸軍。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, the Qingshuai defense bureau was ordered to raise funds for the Huai Lake naval forces' regular expenses, add a Huai-Yang naval camp to protect the two Huai salt works, and assist the land army.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, the Qingshuai defense bureau funded a new Huai-Yang naval camp to guard the Huai salt fields and support land forces.

sentences.zh: 蕪湖孤懸水中，令曾國籓籌設寧國水師，以攻蕪湖，為克金陵之本。

translations.literal: Wuhu stood isolated in the water; Zeng Guofan was ordered to plan a Ningguo navy to attack Wuhu—the foundation for taking Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: Wuhu, isolated in the lake, led to orders for Zeng Guofan to raise a Ningguo fleet to take it as groundwork for Jinling.

sentences.zh: 增設太湖水師，為克蘇州之本。

translations.literal: A Taihu naval force was added as the foundation for taking Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: A Lake Tai navy was added as groundwork for Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 同治二年，諭沿海督臣舉水師將才。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tongzhi, coastal governors were instructed to recommend naval command talent.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tongzhi, coastal governors were told to recommend naval talent.

sentences.zh: 又令曾國籓所部內江水師，都興阿所部揚防水師，有勝外海水師之任者，各舉以聞。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan's inner-river navy and Duxing'a's Yangzhou-defense navy—whoever could match open-sea naval duties—were each to be recommended and reported.
translations.idiomatic: Men from Zeng Guofan's river fleet and Duxing'a's Yangzhou defenders who could handle open-sea duty were also to be recommended.

sentences.zh: 四年，在山東省仿長江戰船之式，造長龍、舢板船，於黃河水性駕駛合宜。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, in Shandong long dragon and sampan boats were built on Yangtze war-vessel patterns, suited to Yellow River conditions.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Shandong built long dragon and sampan boats on Yangtze patterns suited to the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 以水師泊黃、運二河，防堵逸寇，必須分段扼守，而地勢綿長，不敷調遣。

translations.literal: Because the navy was stationed on the Yellow and Grand Canal rivers to block fleeing rebels, segmented holding was needed, but the terrain was long and troops insufficient.
translations.idiomatic: Naval posts on the Yellow River and Grand Canal had to block fleeing rebels at intervals, but the line was too long for available forces.

sentences.zh: 復由山東增造長龍船，並增舢板船十艘，以武職大員督領巡防。

translations.literal: Shandong again built more long dragon boats and added ten sampans, under senior military officers for patrol defense.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong added more long dragon boats and ten sampans under senior officers for patrol.

sentences.zh: 五年，改造江南海口之紅單廣艇三十艘，合原有廣艇凡四十艘，分防海口。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, thirty red-bar broad boats of Jiangnan estuary were rebuilt; with existing broad boats forty in all, divided to defend the estuary.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, Jiangnan rebuilt thirty red-bar broad boats for forty total to guard the estuary.

sentences.zh: 六年，整頓福建台灣海防，增置龍艚等船。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Fujian-Taiwan coastal defense was reorganized and longchao and other vessels were added.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Fujian and Taiwan coastal defense was reorganized with new longchao boats and others.

sentences.zh: 七年，曾國籓議改水師之制，以江南水師，向分外海、內河二支，外海水師六千七百七十六名，武員一百十八人，內河水師八千二十一名，武員一百三十三人。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Zeng Guofan proposed reforming naval institutions: Jiangnan naval forces had been divided into open sea and inner river branches—open-sea navy 6,776 men, 118 military officers; inner-river navy 8,021 men, 133 military officers.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Zeng Guofan proposed navy reform: Jiangnan's open-sea branch had 6,776 men and 118 officers, the inner-river branch 8,021 men and 133 officers.

sentences.zh: 船數則近稽道光二十四年江南舊例，水師船二百七十五艘，朽壞居多，別造舢板船一百三十五艘，大船十二艘，約計各船不過載兵二千數百人，而額定之兵數，尚有萬餘人。

translations.literal: By recent count per Jiangnan's old regulations of the twenty-fourth year of Daoguang, naval vessels numbered 275, most rotten; separately 135 sampans and 12 large ships were built—altogether the ships could carry only some two thousand-odd troops, while authorized strength still exceeded ten thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: By Daoguang twenty-fourth year standards Jiangnan had 275 naval ships, mostly rotten, plus 135 new sampans and 12 large ships—enough berths for barely two thousand men against an authorized strength of over ten thousand.

sentences.zh: 徒費餉項，有水師之名，無舟楫之實，宜大為變通，講求實際。

translations.literal: Pay was wasted in vain—they had the name of naval forces but not the reality of boats; major changes should be made to seek practical results.
translations.idiomatic: Pay was wasted on a navy in name only; Zeng urged sweeping practical reform.

sentences.zh: 江蘇水師，其營制餉章，悉仿長江水師之例，外海之紅單廣艇，亦略增其餉，與李鴻章、丁日昌諸臣協力籌辦，期於外防與內盜並謀，舊制與新章兼顧。

translations.literal: For Jiangsu naval forces, camp organization and pay regulations would all follow the Yangtze navy example; pay for open-sea red-bar broad boats would also be slightly increased—cooperating with Li Hongzhang, Ding Richang, and others to plan, aiming to address both outer defense and inner banditry, old institutions and new rules together.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu's camps and pay would follow the Yangtze model, with slightly higher stipends for open-sea red-bar boats; Zeng, Li Hongzhang, and Ding Richang would jointly balance coastal defense, inland piracy, and old versus new rules.

sentences.zh: 俟章程既定，沿海福建、廣東各省水師，均可酌改行之。

translations.literal: Once regulations were fixed, coastal Fujian, Guangdong, and other provincial navies could all adapt and implement them as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Once the regulations were set, Fujian, Guangdong, and other coastal provinces could adapt them.

sentences.zh: 八年，部臣定議，從曾國籓所陳，改江蘇水師為內洋、外海、里河三大支，以資控御。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Board officials fixed policy following Zeng Guofan's memorial: Jiangsu naval forces were changed to three major branches—inner coastal waters, open sea, and inner rivers—for control.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, the Board adopted Zeng's plan to reorganize Jiangsu's navy into inner coastal, open-sea, and inner-river branches.

sentences.zh: 里河水師，以原設提標右營，太湖左營、右營及增設淞北、淞南二營為五營，隸提督統轄。

translations.literal: Inner-river navy: the original admirals' right camp, Taihu left and right camps, and added Songbei and Songnan two camps—five camps subordinate to the admiral.
translations.idiomatic: The inner-river branch comprised five camps—the admirals' right camp, Taihu left and right, and new Songbei and Songnan—under the admiral.

sentences.zh: 舢板船每營船數不等，一律興修，不得缺額。

translations.literal: Sampan counts per camp differed; all were to be built and maintained uniformly with no shortfall.
translations.idiomatic: Each camp's sampan quota differed, but every boat had to be maintained at full strength.

sentences.zh: 所有太湖七營，改為里河五營，其裁員歸併提標序補。

translations.literal: All seven Taihu camps were changed to five inner-river camps; cut personnel were merged into the admirals' banner for sequential filling.
translations.idiomatic: Seven Taihu camps became five inner-river camps, with surplus officers folded into the admirals' banner.

sentences.zh: 馬新貽等續議，九江水師營改城守營，設陸汛四處。

translations.literal: Ma Xinyi and others continued deliberation: Jiujiang naval camp became a city-garrison camp with four land garrison posts.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xinyi and others added that Jiujiang's naval camp would become a city garrison with four land posts.

sentences.zh: 鄱陽營改陸汛二處。

translations.literal: Poyang camp was changed to two land garrison posts.
translations.idiomatic: The Poyang camp became two land garrison posts.

sentences.zh: 洞庭水師營改龍陽城守營。

translations.literal: Dongting naval camp became Longyang city-garrison camp.
translations.idiomatic: The Dongting naval camp became the Longyang city garrison.

sentences.zh: 岳州水師營酌留水兵，隸陸路管轄。

translations.literal: Yuezhou naval camp retained water troops as appropriate, subordinate to land command.
translations.idiomatic: Yuezhou kept a reduced water force under land command.

sentences.zh: 荊州水師營酌留弁兵有差。

translations.literal: Jingzhou naval camp retained officers and men in varying numbers as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhou retained officers and men in varying numbers.

sentences.zh: 九年，諭定安等以寧靈各軍，運餉艱難，增造砲船，由黃河運送。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, because the Ding'an and other Ning-Ling armies found supply transport difficult, gunboats were added to transport by the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, the Ding'an and other Ning-Ling armies, struggling to move supplies, gained gunboats for Yellow River transport.

sentences.zh: 所有大小戰船三十二艘，編為一營，設統帶等官。

translations.literal: All thirty-two large and small war vessels were organized as one camp with commanding officers and the like appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-two warships were organized into one camp with commanders appointed.

sentences.zh: 十年，沈葆楨以外海兵船製成，應簡知兵大員督率操練。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Shen Baozhen noted that open-sea war vessels were completed; a military officer versed in warfare should be selected to lead drill.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, Shen Baozhen said completed open-sea warships needed an experienced commander to drill the crews.

sentences.zh: 尋以福建水師提督李成謀為兵船統領。

translations.literal: Soon Fujian naval admiral Li Chengmou was made commander of war vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian's naval admiral Li Chengmou was soon named commander of the new warships.

sentences.zh: 是年，曾國籓以江南水師章程初議十四條，嗣由馬新貽等增為二十五條，乃刪減歸併定為二十一條。

translations.literal: That year, Zeng Guofan noted Jiangnan naval regulations were first discussed at fourteen articles; later Ma Xinyi and others expanded to twenty-five; then trimmed, merged, and fixed at twenty-one articles.
translations.idiomatic: That year Zeng Guofan consolidated Jiangnan naval regulations from an initial fourteen articles through Ma Xinyi's twenty-five down to a final twenty-one.

sentences.zh: 外海六營，以次巡哨。

translations.literal: Six open-sea camps patrolled in rotation.
translations.idiomatic: Six open-sea camps rotated patrol duty.

sentences.zh: 內洋五營，分定汛界。
