translations.literal: Five inner-coastal camps had fixed garrison boundaries divided.
translations.idiomatic: Five inner-coastal camps each held assigned patrol zones.

sentences.zh: 里河五營，分定汛界。

translations.literal: Five inner-river camps had patrol boundaries fixed and divided.
translations.idiomatic: Five inner-river camps each held assigned patrol zones.

sentences.zh: 淞南營、淞北營、太湖左營、太湖右營酌增戰船。

translations.literal: Songnan camp, Songbei camp, Taihu left camp, and Taihu right camp had war vessels appropriately increased.
translations.idiomatic: Songnan, Songbei, and Taihu left and right camps each received additional warships.

sentences.zh: 水師營所遺陸汛，移並留防。

translations.literal: Land garrisons left over from naval camps were transferred, merged, and retained for defense.
translations.idiomatic: Leftover land garrisons from naval camps were consolidated and kept on station.

sentences.zh: 京口三營陸汛砲堤，分別管轄。

translations.literal: The three Jingkou camps' land garrisons and gun batteries were separately administered.
translations.idiomatic: Jingkou's three camps each administered their own land posts and gun batteries.

sentences.zh: 改定轄營，及留設守備，要汛多留陸兵。

translations.literal: Subordinate camps were revised and fixed; garrison commanders were retained; key garrison posts kept more land troops.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate camps were reorganized, garrison commanders retained, and more land troops posted at critical zones.

sentences.zh: 定將弁處分則例。

translations.literal: Regulations for disciplining officers were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Rules for disciplining officers were established.

sentences.zh: 規定各營船數。

translations.literal: Ship counts for each camp were stipulated.
translations.idiomatic: Each camp's ship quota was set.

sentences.zh: 酌定外委員數。

translations.literal: Numbers of acting sub-officials were fixed as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Acting sub-official quotas were adjusted.

sentences.zh: 酌定裁缺薪糧。

translations.literal: Pay for eliminated posts was fixed as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Stipends for cut posts were adjusted.

sentences.zh: 營官建衙署地方，各營座船之數，官兵額定數目，書吏名數，雨蓬旗幟等費，官兵糧額，各船酌用槍砲數目，各船酌用火藥槍砲彈，綜計餉項之數，下所司核議行之。

translations.literal: Sites for camp officers' yamens, numbers of each camp's command vessels, authorized officer and soldier counts, clerk quotas, costs for awnings, flags, and banners, troop grain allowances, appropriate gun and cannon counts per vessel, appropriate gunpowder and cannon shot per vessel—the total pay figures were submitted to the responsible offices for review and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: Yamen sites, command vessels, authorized troop and clerk strength, costs for awnings and flags, grain allowances, and guns, powder, and shot per ship were totaled and sent to the relevant offices for approval.

sentences.zh: 十一年，丁寶楨調撥福建省所制安瀾兵輪赴山東洋面巡緝。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Ding Baozhen transferred the Anlan gunboat built in Fujian Province to patrol and suppress on the Shandong coast.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, Ding Baozhen sent Fujian's Anlan gunboat to patrol the Shandong coast.

sentences.zh: 瑞麟調撥福建省小號兵輪赴奉天海口巡緝。

translations.literal: Rui Lin transferred a small Fujian gunboat to patrol and suppress at Fengtian's river mouth.
translations.idiomatic: Rui Lin dispatched a small Fujian gunboat to patrol Fengtian's harbor mouth.

sentences.zh: 光緒四年，裁去廣東輪拖巡船水勇二千三百餘人。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Guangxu, more than 2,300 Guangdong steam-tow patrol-boat water braves were cut.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu fourth year, over 2,300 Guangdong steam-tow patrol boat sailors were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 五年，以各省舉辦水師，奉天、直隸、山東、江蘇、浙江、福建、廣東次第駐泊兵輪，編製水師，而沿海各省形勢不同，操法未能一律，吳淞口為南北海疆適中之地，乃命江南提督李朝斌為外海兵輪統領，督率各省大小兵輪，定期在吳淞口會操。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, as each province established naval forces, Fengtian, Zhili, Shandong, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Fujian, and Guangdong in turn berthed gunboats and organized navies; but coastal provinces differed in terrain and drill methods could not be uniform—Wusong was the midpoint of north and south maritime frontiers, so Jiangnan admiral Li Chaobin was made commander of open-sea gunboats to lead all provincial gunboats large and small in scheduled joint drill at Wusong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, as provinces established navies and berthed gunboats at Fengtian, Zhili, Shandong, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Fujian, and Guangdong, drill methods still varied by coast. Wusong lay midway between north and south, so Jiangnan admiral Li Chaobin was named commander of open-sea gunboats to lead provincial warships in scheduled exercises there.

sentences.zh: 六年，以新置蚊砲船便利合用，續向外洋購置數十艘，募福建、廣東沿海精壯之民為水師，分屯北洋各海口。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, because newly acquired mosquito gunboats were convenient and effective, several dozen more were purchased abroad; stout coastal men of Fujian and Guangdong were recruited as naval forces and stationed at Northern Fleet harbor mouths.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, finding the new mosquito gunboats practical, the court bought several dozen more abroad and recruited stout Fujian and Guangdong coastal men as sailors, stationing them at Northern Fleet harbors.

sentences.zh: 七年，以奉天旅順口原有旗營，艇船朽壞，弁兵疲弱，悉行裁汰，歸陸師巡防，別以快砲防海。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, because Fengtian's Lüshunkou had an original banner camp whose cutters were rotten and officers and men weak, all were cut; defense reverted to land forces, with quick-firing guns separately guarding the sea.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Lüshunkou's banner camp, with rotten cutters and weak troops, was abolished; land forces took over patrol while quick-firing guns guarded the coast.

sentences.zh: 時丁汝昌由英國率戰艦回國，為中國水軍航外海之始，乃擢丁汝昌為水師提督。

translations.literal: At that time Ding Ruchang returned from Britain leading warships—the beginning of Chinese naval forces sailing the open sea—and Ding Ruchang was promoted to naval admiral.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Ruchang's return from Britain with warships marked China's first open-sea navy; he was promoted to naval admiral.

sentences.zh: 八年，以江南形勢，先海後江，朝議擬以長江水師提督駐吳淞口，狼山、福山、崇明三鎮標隸之，以江南提督移駐淮、徐，改福建水師提督為閩浙水師提督。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, given Jiangnan's terrain—sea first, then river—the court proposed stationing the Yangtze naval admiral at Wusong with Langshan, Fushan, and Chongming three garrison banners subordinate; moving the Jiangnan admiral to Huai and Xu; and changing the Fujian naval admiral to Min-Zhe naval admiral.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, the court proposed that given Jiangnan's sea-then-river layout, the Yangtze naval admiral should move to Wusong with Langshan, Fushan, and Chongming under him, the Jiangnan admiral to Huai and Xu, and the Fujian admiral retitled Min-Zhe naval admiral.

sentences.zh: 尋左宗棠、彭玉麟議覆，以海防不外戰守二端，戰宜厚集兵力，守宜因勢設險，仍循舊制為宜。

translations.literal: Soon Zuo Zongtang and Peng Yulin replied in deliberation: coastal defense had only attack and defense—attack required massed forces, defense required exploiting terrain to set obstacles; following the old system remained appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo Zongtang and Peng Yulin replied that coastal defense came down to fighting and holding—mass troops for offense, terrain for defense—and the old system should stand.

sentences.zh: 福建水師自裁兵加餉後，實存水師六千九百餘人，旗營水師三百餘人，各營拖罾、龍艚、快艇等大小戰船實存四十艘，台灣、澎湖戰船六艘，大小兵輪十艘，宜聯合浙江省水師會操，官制則仍循其舊。

translations.literal: After Fujian naval forces cut troops and raised pay, actual strength was over 6,900 sailors, over 300 banner-camp sailors, forty war vessels of drag-net boats, dragon junks, fast boats, and the like, six Taiwan and Penghu war vessels, and ten gunboats large and small—they should join Zhejiang naval forces in joint drill; official ranks would still follow the old system.
translations.idiomatic: After cuts and pay increases Fujian had some 6,900 sailors plus 300 banner troops, forty junks and fast boats, six Taiwan and Penghu warships, and ten gunboats; they should drill jointly with Zhejiang while keeping the old command structure.

sentences.zh: 九年，以廣東內河之肇慶河面縣長六百餘里，僅有小巡船二十餘艘，不敷分佈，九龍洋面水淺，大船難於行駛，乃於二處各增設淺水兵輪船。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, because Guangdong's inner-river Zhaoqing stretch exceeded six hundred li in length but had only twenty-odd small patrol boats—not enough for distribution—and Kowloon waters were shallow and large ships hard to navigate, shallow-draft gunboats were added at both places.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, Zhaoqing's six-hundred-li river had only twenty-odd patrol boats and Kowloon waters were too shallow for large ships, so shallow-draft gunboats were added at both places.

sentences.zh: 十年，試造尖底舢板船，分佈海口。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, sharp-bottomed sampans were trial-built and distributed at harbor mouths.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, sharp-bottomed sampans were trial-built and posted at harbor mouths.

sentences.zh: 旋以船質弱小，罷之。

translations.literal: Soon because the vessels were weak in build, they were abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: They were soon abandoned as too flimsy.

sentences.zh: 十一年，彭玉麟以海防日亟，議設水師總統於吳淞，分設二鎮：一駐直隸大沽，凡盛京、直隸、山東、江南各海口戰船隸之；

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Peng Yulin, because coastal defense grew daily urgent, proposed a naval commander-in-chief at Wusong and two regional commands: one stationed at Zhili's Dagu, with war vessels of Shengjing, Zhili, Shandong, and Jiangnan harbor mouths subordinate;
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, Peng Yulin urged a naval commander at Wusong and two regional commands—one at Dagu over Shengjing, Zhili, Shandong, and Jiangnan warships;

sentences.zh: 一駐福建廈門，凡浙江、福建、台灣、廣東各海口戰船隸之。

translations.literal: One stationed at Fujian's Xiamen, with war vessels of Zhejiang, Fujian, Taiwan, and Guangdong harbor mouths subordinate.
translations.idiomatic: the other at Xiamen over Zhejiang, Fujian, Taiwan, and Guangdong warships.

sentences.zh: 兩鎮每年周巡海口，會哨於吳淞。

translations.literal: Both commands annually toured harbor mouths in circuit and met for patrol rendezvous at Wusong.
translations.idiomatic: Both commands would circuit the harbors yearly and rendezvous at Wusong.

sentences.zh: 是為南北洋水師建議之始。

translations.literal: This was the beginning of proposals for Northern and Southern Fleet navies.
translations.idiomatic: This marked the first proposal for separate Northern and Southern Fleets.

sentences.zh: 十二年，議裁減浙江沿海水師。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, cutting Zhejiang coastal naval forces was proposed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, the court proposed cuts to Zhejiang's coastal navy.

sentences.zh: 旋浙撫劉秉璋以舊額戰船二百五十餘艘，粵寇亂後，購造不及半數。

translations.literal: Soon Zhejiang governor Liu Bingzhang noted that of the old quota of over 250 war vessels, after the Taiping rebellion purchases and construction had not reached half.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang governor Liu Bingzhang replied that of 250 authorized warships, fewer than half had been built or bought since the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 光緒八年，裁水師船十三艘，停修舊船三艘，已符裁兵三成之數。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Guangxu, thirteen naval vessels were cut and repair of three old vessels stopped—already matching the thirty-percent troop-cut quota.
translations.idiomatic: By Guangxu eighth year, cutting thirteen ships and halting repair on three old ones already met the thirty-percent reduction target.

sentences.zh: 惟巡洋之紅單船十一艘，不在額設裁減之例。

translations.literal: Only the eleven red-bar patrol vessels on cruise duty were not within the authorized cut quota.
translations.idiomatic: Eleven red-bar patrol boats on cruise duty were exempt from the cuts.

sentences.zh: 十四年，因台灣疆土日辟，改安平水師副將為台東陸路副將，改鹿港游擊為安平水師游擊，任新設地方鎮守之職。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, because Taiwan's territory expanded daily, the Anping naval deputy commander became Taidong land-route deputy commander; the Lukang mobile brigadier became Anping naval mobile brigadier—to hold garrison duties in newly established districts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, as Taiwan expanded, the Anping naval deputy became Taidong land deputy, the Lukang brigadier became Anping naval brigadier, and both garrisoned new districts.

sentences.zh: 十五年，以福建內河水師砲船舊額共九十八艘，頻年裁撤，實存三十艘。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, Fujian inner-river naval gunboats had an old quota of ninety-eight vessels; after years of cuts, thirty remained.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, Fujian's inner-river gunboat quota of ninety-eight had been cut to thirty.

sentences.zh: 每船配置水師六人，專任巡緝內洋。

translations.literal: Each vessel had six sailors assigned, dedicated to patrolling and suppressing in inner coastal waters.
translations.idiomatic: Each ship carried six sailors to patrol inner coastal waters.

sentences.zh: 十六年，調撥福建海壇水師駐防福清縣屬，以靖海盜。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, Fujian Haitan naval forces were transferred to garrison Fuqing county districts to pacify pirates.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, Fujian's Haitan sailors were posted to Fuqing to suppress piracy.

sentences.zh: 十七年，於湖南選鋒水師中、前、後、左、右營內，撥一千六百餘人，分防省城及岳州等處，撥長勝、毅安水師四百餘人，分防辰州、沅州、常德等處，撥澄湘水師三百餘人，分防衡州等處，以專責成。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, from Hunan's Xuanfeng naval center, front, rear, left, and right camps over 1,600 men were assigned to garrison the provincial capital, Yuezhou, and elsewhere; over 400 Changsheng and Yi'an sailors to Chenzhou, Yuanzhou, Changde, and elsewhere; over 300 Chengxiang sailors to Hengzhou and elsewhere—to fix clear responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, Hunan detached over 1,600 Xuanfeng sailors for the capital and Yuezhou, 400 Changsheng and Yi'an men for Chenzhou, Yuanzhou, and Changde, and 300 Chengxiang men for Hengzhou, each with a fixed district.

sentences.zh: 是年，因奉天遼河下游舊有巡船，上游則僅有陸隊兼巡，未有水師。

translations.literal: That year, because Fengtian's Liao River downstream had old patrol boats but upstream only land detachments on patrol—no naval force.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Fengtian's lower Liao had patrol boats but the upper reach had only land detachments and no navy.

sentences.zh: 乃增置長龍砲船一艘，舢板船八艘，於練軍內選撥弁勇，梭巡遼河上下及省南之洋河。

translations.literal: One long-dragon gunboat and eight sampans were added; officers and men were selected from the training army to shuttle-patrol the Liao River up and down and the Yang River south of the province.
translations.idiomatic: One long-dragon gunboat and eight sampans were added, with officers and men from the training army to patrol the Liao and the southern Yang River.

sentences.zh: 十九年，令提督黃翼升校閱長江提標五營，上江十三營，下江四營，定訓誡之規，禁陸居，戒嗜好，勤練藝，屏虛文，不得蹈綠營之習，日久玩生。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, Admiral Huang Yisheng was ordered to inspect the Yangtze admirals' five camps, thirteen upper-river camps, and four lower-river camps; rules of admonition were fixed—forbidding living on land, warning against indulgences, urging diligent drill, rejecting empty formalities, not falling into Green Banner habits until laxity bred over time.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, Admiral Huang Yisheng inspected the Yangtze admirals' five camps plus thirteen upper and four lower camps, forbidding land living, indulgence, and empty form while demanding drill—lest Green Banner laxity return.

sentences.zh: 閩、浙疆臣會議，以浙江省有元凱、超武二兵輪，福建省有伏波、琛航、靖遠三兵輪，與沿海水師協力緝捕。

translations.literal: Fujian and Zhejiang frontier officials met: Zhejiang had the Yuankai and Chaowu gunboats, Fujian the Fubo, Chenhang, and Jingyuan gunboats—to cooperate with coastal naval forces in pursuit and capture.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian and Zhejiang officials agreed that Zhejiang's Yuankai and Chaowu gunboats and Fujian's Fubo, Chenhang, and Jingyuan would cooperate with coastal forces against pirates.

sentences.zh: 而浙省水師船自裁減後，僅存五十餘艘，閩省自馬江戰後，僅存艇船二十九艘，乃在寧波海口賃用紅單等船八艘，酌撥弁兵，以靖海盜。

translations.literal: But after cuts Zhejiang naval vessels numbered only fifty-odd; after the Mawei battle Fujian had only twenty-nine cutters—so eight red-bar and other vessels were hired at Ningbo harbor mouth and officers and men assigned as appropriate to pacify pirates.
translations.idiomatic: After cuts Zhejiang had only fifty-odd ships and post-Mawei Fujian only twenty-nine cutters, so eight red-bar boats were hired at Ningbo with assigned crews to suppress piracy.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，令江蘇省之外海、內洋、里河、太湖四支水師，一律酌裁水勇。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, Jiangsu's four naval branches—open sea, inner coastal waters, inner river, and Taihu—were all ordered to cut water braves as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, Jiangsu's open-sea, inner-coastal, inner-river, and Taihu branches were all ordered to trim their sailor strength.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，以安徽省江防在下游者為東西梁山，建有砲堤砲台，在上游者為闌江磯前江口及省城之江心洲，咸有砲台，而缺乏水師，乃撥澄清營砲船二十五艘，及長江水師之蕪湖、裕溪、大通、安慶、華陽各營，聯絡防守。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, Anhui's downstream river defense at East and West Liangshan had gun batteries and platforms; upstream at Lanjiangji before the river mouth and the provincial capital's mid-river islet—all had batteries but lacked naval forces—so twenty-five Chengqing camp gunboats and Yangtze naval camps at Wuhu, Yuxi, Datong, Anqing, and Huayang were assigned for linked defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, Anhui's batteries at Liangshan downstream and Lanjiangji and the capital's river islet upstream lacked ships, so twenty-five Chengqing gunboats and Yangtze camps at Wuhu, Yuxi, Datong, Anqing, and Huayang were linked in defense.

sentences.zh: 又令長江五省督撫，各派將領，不分畛域，嚴密設防。

translations.literal: The five Yangtze provinces' governors-general and governors were also ordered each to dispatch generals, without regard to provincial boundaries, to set defense strictly.
translations.idiomatic: The five Yangtze provinces were also told to send generals across provincial lines for coordinated defense.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，以奉天鳳凰廳沿海一帶，素稱盜藪，曾由北洋撥兵輪巡洋，其支港各處，宜屯泊水師，乃於大孤山、太平溝、沙河三口岸，各造兵船三艘，酌配水師巡緝。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, because Fengtian's Fenghuang coastal strip was known as a pirate nest and the Northern Fleet had once assigned gunboats to cruise, branch harbors everywhere should berth naval forces—so at Dagushan, Taipinggou, and Shahe three ports three military vessels each were built with sailors assigned as appropriate to patrol and suppress.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, the pirate-ridden Fenghuang coast, once patrolled by Northern Fleet gunboats, gained three warships each at Dagushan, Taipinggou, and Shahe with assigned crews.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，因浙江杭、嘉、湖三府捕匪兵單，於原有水師中，抽練游擊一隊，駐嘉興府，增練游擊三隊，分佈嘉興、湖州各河港，以游擊小隊駐杭州省城，賃用上海商人之小輪船十艘，曳帶兵梭船巡水道，以期迅捷。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year, because Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Huzhou three prefectures of Zhejiang had too few troops to catch bandits, from existing naval forces one drilled mobile brigade team was drawn to garrison Jiaxing; three more mobile brigade teams were added, distributed at Jiaxing and Huzhou river harbors; a mobile brigade squad garrisoned Hangzhou capital; ten small steamers of Shanghai merchants were hired to tow armed patrol boats along waterways for speed.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year, with too few troops in Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Huzhou, one drilled brigade team garrisoned Jiaxing, three more spread through river ports, a squad held Hangzhou, and ten Shanghai merchant steamers towed armed patrol boats for speed.

sentences.zh: 在南洋船塢造淺水兵輪船四艘，配快砲八尊，江蘇亦制淺水兵輪船四艘，協同內河水師，仿歐西各國章程，編為聯隊，以資防剿。

translations.literal: Four shallow-draft gunboats were built at the Southern Fleet dockyard with eight quick-firing guns; Jiangsu also built four shallow-draft gunboats; together with inner-river naval forces, following Western nations' regulations, they were organized as a combined squadron for defense and suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Four shallow-draft gunboats with eight quick-firers were built at the Southern Fleet yard and four more in Jiangsu; with inner-river forces they formed a Western-style squadron for defense and pursuit.

sentences.zh: 此整治水師之概略也。

translations.literal: This is the general outline of naval force reorganization.
translations.idiomatic: Such was the broad outline of naval reorganization.

sentences.zh: 其兵額之增減，船械之配置，各省隨時編定。

translations.literal: Troop quotas added or cut and arms and vessels assigned were fixed by each province from time to time.
translations.idiomatic: Each province adjusted troop strength and ship allocations as needed.

sentences.zh: 外海水師，北自盛京，南訖閩、廣，凡拖繒、紅單等船隸焉。

translations.literal: Open-sea naval forces, north from Shengjing south to Fujian and Guangdong—all drag-net boats, red-bar boats, and the like were subordinate.
translations.idiomatic: Open-sea forces from Shengjing to Fujian and Guangdong included drag-net boats, red-bar boats, and the like.

sentences.zh: 內河水師，各省巡哨舢板等船隸焉。

translations.literal: Inner-river naval forces—all provinces' patrol and sentry sampans and other vessels were subordinate.
translations.idiomatic: Inner-river forces comprised each province's patrol sampans and similar craft.

sentences.zh: 奉天、直隸、山東、福建水師船均屬外海。

translations.literal: Fengtian, Zhili, Shandong, and Fujian naval vessels all belonged to open sea.
translations.idiomatic: Fengtian, Zhili, Shandong, and Fujian ships were all open-sea craft.

sentences.zh: 江西、湖廣水師船均屬內河。

translations.literal: Jiangxi and Huguang naval vessels all belonged to inner river.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi and Huguang ships were all inner-river craft.

sentences.zh: 江南、浙江、廣東水師船分屬外海、內河。

translations.literal: Jiangnan, Zhejiang, and Guangdong naval vessels were divided between open sea and inner river.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan, Zhejiang, and Guangdong divided their fleets between open sea and inner river.

sentences.zh: 其別練之師，有巡湖水師、巡鹽水師、親兵營、練軍營。

translations.literal: Among separately drilled forces were lake-patrol navy, salt-patrol navy, bodyguard camps, and training army camps.
translations.idiomatic: Separate drilled forces included lake patrol, salt patrol, bodyguard, and training army units.

sentences.zh: 同治以後，增定長江水師、太湖水師之制，視舊制加詳矣。

translations.literal: After Tongzhi, Yangtze and Taihu naval systems were added and fixed—more detailed than the old system.
translations.idiomatic: After Tongzhi, Yangtze and Taihu naval regulations were added in greater detail than the old rules.

sentences.zh: 其巡防之規，外海水師巡防盛京，以協領為總巡，佐領、防禦、驍騎校為分巡。

translations.literal: As for patrol regulations: open-sea naval forces patrolling Shengjing had assistant commandants as grand patrol, and vice commandants, defense officers, and brave-rider captains as sub-patrol.
translations.idiomatic: Open-sea patrol in Shengjing placed assistant commandants in overall command and vice commandants, defense officers, and cavalry captains as sector patrols.

sentences.zh: 直隸等沿海各省，以總兵官為總巡，副將以下為分巡。

translations.literal: Zhili and other coastal provinces had regional commanders as grand patrol and deputy commanders and below as sub-patrol.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhili and other coastal provinces, regional commanders led grand patrol and deputy commanders and below handled sectors.

sentences.zh: 各於所治界內，率水師沿海上下，更番往來，詰奸禁暴，兩界相交之處，戒期會哨，以巡緝情形，申報所屬將軍、總督、提督，委員稽察。

translations.literal: Each within his jurisdiction led naval forces up and down the coast in rotation, interrogating wrongdoers and forbidding violence; where two jurisdictions met, scheduled patrol rendezvous were set; patrol and suppression conditions were reported to subordinate generals, governors-general, and admirals, with commissioners to inspect.
translations.idiomatic: Each commander rotated sailors along his coast to check crime, rendezvousing at sector boundaries, reporting to generals, governors, and admirals while commissioners inspected.

sentences.zh: 若因風阻滯，各廠到界之日具報。

translations.literal: If wind delayed them, the day each station reached the boundary was reported.
translations.idiomatic: Wind delays were reported with the date each station reached its boundary.

sentences.zh: 其每歲定期，以二月、四月、五月為始，至九月事竣回營。

translations.literal: The annual schedule began in the second, fourth, and fifth months and ended in the ninth, when duties finished and camps were reentered.
translations.idiomatic: Patrols ran from the second, fourth, and fifth months through September, then returned to camp.

sentences.zh: 有引避不巡，或巡而不周遍者，論如軍律。

translations.literal: Those who evaded patrol or patrolled incompletely were judged under military law.
translations.idiomatic: Evading patrol or patrolling incompletely was punishable under military law.

sentences.zh: 其內河水師巡防之制，長江自四川巫山而東，出三江口，至湖廣界，經岳州、武昌、興國至江西界，經九江、江寧、京口等處，東至於海，各省將軍、總督、提、鎮分委旗標弁兵，沿江游巡，及界而還。

translations.literal: Inner-river naval patrol regulations: the Yangtze from Wushan in Sichuan eastward, out the Three Rivers mouth to the Huguang border, through Yuezhou, Wuchang, and Xingguo to the Jiangxi border, through Jiujiang, Jiangning, Jingkou, and elsewhere east to the sea—each province's generals, governors-general, admirals, and regional commanders delegated banner and garrison officers and men to cruise the river and return at the boundary.
translations.idiomatic: Inner-river patrol ran the Yangtze from Wushan through Yuezhou, Wuchang, Jiujiang, Jiangning, and Jingkou to the sea, with each province's commanders posting banner troops to cruise to the border and back.

sentences.zh: 自康熙以後，以外海利用巨艦，內河利用輕舟，故船制屢改，而轄境遼闊，水師兵額，時有增加，遇有戰事，增艦尤多。

translations.literal: From Kangxi onward, open sea used large vessels and inner rivers light boats—so ship types changed repeatedly; jurisdictions were vast and naval troop quotas increased from time to time; when war came, adding vessels was especially common.
translations.idiomatic: From Kangxi on, open sea favored large ships and rivers light craft; ship types shifted often, quotas grew across vast jurisdictions, and wars brought especially sharp increases.

sentences.zh: 征吳三桂之役，命尚善率舟師入洞庭湖取岳州。

translations.literal: In the campaign against Wu Sangui, Shang Shan was ordered to lead the fleet into Dongting Lake to take Yuezhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the campaign against Wu Sangui, Shang Shan led the fleet into Dongting Lake to capture Yuezhou.

sentences.zh: 及鄂鼐統水師，增造鳥船百艘，沙船四百三十八艘，置水師三萬人。

translations.literal: When E'nai commanded the navy, one hundred bird boats and 438 sand boats were added, with 30,000 sailors established.
translations.idiomatic: Under E'nai the navy added one hundred bird boats and 438 sand boats and mustered 30,000 sailors.

sentences.zh: 征台灣之役，命萬正色督率湖南、浙江戰船二百艘，由海道赴福建。

translations.literal: In the Taiwan campaign, Wan Zhengse was ordered to lead 200 Hunan and Zhejiang war vessels by sea route to Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taiwan campaign, Wan Zhengse led 200 Hunan and Zhejiang warships by sea to Fujian.

sentences.zh: 姚啟聖亦修戰船三百艘，水師二萬人。

translations.literal: Yao Qisheng also built 300 war vessels and 20,000 sailors.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Qisheng built 300 warships and raised 20,000 sailors.

sentences.zh: 施琅之克澎湖，用戰船三百艘，水師二萬人。

translations.literal: Shi Lang's capture of Penghu used 300 war vessels and 20,000 sailors.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Lang took Penghu with 300 warships and 20,000 sailors.

sentences.zh: 施世驃之平硃一貴，用大小戰船六百餘艘。

translations.literal: Shi Shipiao's pacification of Zhu Yigui used over 600 war vessels large and small.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Shipiao suppressed Zhu Yigui with over 600 warships.

sentences.zh: 乾隆間，征緬甸之役，命湖廣船匠造船於蠻暮，取道金沙江以攻緬甸，兼調福建、廣東水師助之。

translations.literal: In the Qianlong period, in the Burma campaign, Huguang shipwrights were ordered to build vessels at Manmu and advance via the Jinsha River to attack Burma, with Fujian and Guangdong naval forces also mobilized to assist.
translations.idiomatic: During Qianlong's Burma campaign, Huguang shipwrights built boats at Manmu for a Jinsha River advance while Fujian and Guangdong sailors reinforced them.

sentences.zh: 李長庚之剿海寇，在福建造大船三十艘，名曰霆船，配置大砲四百尊，合閩、浙水師全力，轉戰重洋，遂平蔡牽。

translations.literal: Li Changgeng's suppression of sea bandits: in Fujian thirty large vessels called thunder boats were built with 400 great cannon; combining Fujian and Zhejiang naval forces at full strength, fighting across the deep sea, Cai Qian was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Li Changgeng built thirty Fujian thunder boats carrying 400 heavy guns, joined Fujian and Zhejiang at full strength on the open sea, and crushed Cai Qian.

sentences.zh: 道光以後，海警狎至，木質舊船不敵外洋鐵艦之堅利。

translations.literal: After Daoguang, maritime alarms came repeatedly; old wooden vessels could not match foreign ironclads in strength and sharpness.
translations.idiomatic: After Daoguang, repeated maritime crises exposed wooden junks as no match for foreign ironclads.

sentences.zh: 同治五年，始仿歐洲兵輪船式，於福建省開廠製造輪船。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tongzhi, European gunboat patterns were first copied and a dockyard opened in Fujian Province to build steam vessels.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi fifth year, Fujian opened a yard to build steam gunboats on European models.

sentences.zh: 江蘇初設輪船四艘。

translations.literal: Jiangsu first established four steam vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu acquired its first four steamers.

sentences.zh: 十一年，廣東、山東各設輪船一艘，奉天設小輪船一艘，咸配置水師。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Guangdong and Shandong each established one steam vessel, Fengtian one small steamer—all with naval crews assigned.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, Guangdong and Shandong each got one steamer, Fengtian a small one, all crewed by sailors.

sentences.zh: 其後沿海各省購置兵輪，歲有增益，舊式水師戰船分別裁汰。

translations.literal: Thereafter coastal provinces purchased gunboats with yearly increases; old-style naval war vessels were cut in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Coastal provinces then bought gunboats yearly while phasing out old-style warships.

sentences.zh: 至光緒中葉，綜各省外海、內河實存師船之數，奉天外海繒船十艘。

translations.literal: By mid-Guangxu, totaling each province's actual open-sea and inner-river fleet vessels: Fengtian open sea had ten seine boats.
translations.idiomatic: By mid-Guangxu, provincial fleets counted ten Fengtian open-sea seine boats.

sentences.zh: 直隸外海長龍船二艘，先鋒舢板船四十八艘。

translations.literal: Zhili open sea: two long-dragon boats, forty-eight vanguard sampans.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili's open sea had two long-dragon boats and forty-eight vanguard sampans.

sentences.zh: 山東外海拖罾船十四艘，內河哨船六艘。

translations.literal: Shandong open sea: fourteen drag-net boats; inner river: six sentry boats.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong had fourteen open-sea drag-net boats and six inner-river sentry boats.

sentences.zh: 江蘇外海輪船二艘，艇船八艘，內洋輪船二艘，舢板船六十艘，內河舢板船、艇船三百八十五艘，長江舢板船七十六艘，督陣舢板船七艘，長龍船十艘，巡哨舢板船一百二十八艘。

translations.literal: Jiangsu open sea: two steam vessels, eight cutters; inner coastal waters: two steam vessels, sixty sampans; inner river sampans and cutters 385; Yangtze sampans 76; command-formation sampans 7; long-dragon boats 10; patrol sentry sampans 128.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu counted two open-sea steamers, eight cutters, two inner-coastal steamers, sixty sampans, 385 inner-river sampans and cutters, 76 Yangtze sampans, 7 command sampans, 10 long-dragon boats, and 128 patrol sampans.

sentences.zh: 安徽舢板船二百八十二艘，長龍船十五艘，八團船一艘，槍劃十艘，護卡巡船十五艘，督陣舢板船七艘，輪船二艘。

translations.literal: Anhui: 282 sampans, 15 long-dragon boats, one eight-squad boat, ten gun punts, 15 checkpoint-guard patrol boats, 7 command-formation sampans, 2 steam vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Anhui had 282 sampans, 15 long-dragon boats, one eight-squad boat, ten gun punts, 15 checkpoint patrol boats, 7 command sampans, and 2 steamers.

sentences.zh: 江西長龍船十五艘，舢板船二百六十三艘，督陣舢板船六艘，輪船一艘。

translations.literal: Jiangxi: 15 long-dragon boats, 263 sampans, 6 command-formation sampans, 1 steam vessel.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi had 15 long-dragon boats, 263 sampans, 6 command sampans, and 1 steamer.

sentences.zh: 福建外海長龍船一艘，舢板船十九艘，小艇十四艘，哨船十四艘，龍艚船二艘，拕艚船一艘，內河砲船三十艘。

translations.literal: Fujian open sea: one long-dragon boat, 19 sampans, 14 small cutters, 14 sentry boats, 2 dragon junks, 1 tow junk; inner river: 30 gunboats.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian's open sea had one long-dragon boat, 19 sampans, 14 small cutters, 14 sentry boats, 2 dragon junks, and 1 tow junk, plus 30 inner-river gunboats.

sentences.zh: 浙江外海釣船二十七艘，艇船十二艘，龍艚船十七艘，哨船二艘，快船一艘，內河大舢板船五十八艘，中舢板船八十四艘，飛划船四十九艘，長龍船座船二百十三艘，槍船八艘，砲船五艘。

translations.literal: Zhejiang open sea: 27 fishing boats, 12 cutters, 17 dragon junks, 2 sentry boats, 1 fast boat; inner river: 58 large sampans, 84 medium sampans, 49 flying rowboats, 213 long-dragon command vessels, 8 gun boats, 5 cannon boats.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang's open sea had 27 fishing boats, 12 cutters, 17 dragon junks, 2 sentry boats, and 1 fast boat; its rivers had 58 large and 84 medium sampans, 49 flying rowboats, 213 long-dragon command vessels, 8 gun boats, and 5 cannon boats.

sentences.zh: 湖北督陣大舢板船八艘，長龍船十二艘，舢板船一百八十艘。

translations.literal: Hubei: 8 large command-formation sampans, 12 long-dragon boats, 180 sampans.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei had 8 large command sampans, 12 long-dragon boats, and 180 sampans.

sentences.zh: 湖南督陣大舢板船四艘，長龍船四艘，舢板船六十艘。

translations.literal: Hunan: 4 large command-formation sampans, 4 long-dragon boats, 60 sampans.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan had 4 large command sampans, 4 long-dragon boats, and 60 sampans.

sentences.zh: 廣東外海大小輪船二十二艘，巡船十四艘，拕船十艘，長龍船一艘，扒船一艘，內河兩櫓槳船一艘，櫓船一艘，槳船四十艘，巡船一百九十六艘，急跳船十五艘，平底槳船二艘，快哨船二艘，快船十四艘，快槳船七艘，艚船四艘，櫓船二艘。

translations.literal: Guangdong open sea: 22 steam vessels large and small, 14 patrol boats, 10 tow boats, 1 long-dragon boat, 1 scoop boat; inner river: 1 two-oar paddle boat, 1 oar boat, 40 paddle boats, 196 patrol boats, 15 rapid-leap boats, 2 flat-bottom paddle boats, 2 fast sentry boats, 14 fast boats, 7 fast paddle boats, 4 junk boats, 2 oar boats.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong's open sea had 22 steamers, 14 patrol boats, 10 tow boats, 1 long-dragon boat, and 1 scoop boat; its rivers had 1 two-oar paddle boat, 1 oar boat, 40 paddle boats, 196 patrol boats, 15 rapid-leap boats, 2 flat-bottom paddle boats, 2 fast sentry boats, 14 fast boats, 7 fast paddle boats, 4 junks, and 2 oar boats.

sentences.zh: 各省戰船，咸分隸標營，擇地屯泊，以時會哨。

translations.literal: All provinces' war vessels were subordinate to garrison banners, berthed at chosen sites, meeting for patrol rendezvous on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial warships reported to garrison banners, berthed at assigned stations, and rendezvoused on schedule.

sentences.zh: 外海師船，以海軍規制漸立，僅任沿海捕盜之責。

translations.literal: Open-sea fleet vessels, as naval regulations gradually took shape, bore only the duty of coastal pirate capture.
translations.idiomatic: As modern naval regulations took shape, open-sea vessels were reduced to coastal pirate suppression.

sentences.zh: 各省內河師船，均仿長江水師舢板船之式。

translations.literal: Each province's inner-river fleet vessels all followed the Yangtze naval sampan pattern.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial inner-river fleets followed the Yangtze sampan model.

sentences.zh: 惟巡緝等船，分巡支河汊港，利用輕捷，船制少殊耳。

translations.literal: Only patrol and suppression vessels, patrolling branch rivers and inlets, used lightness and speed—ship types differed slightly.
translations.idiomatic: Patrol craft on branch streams and inlets differed slightly for lightness and speed.

sentences.zh: 其漕、河水師營制，始於明代隆慶間。

translations.literal: Grain-transport and river naval camp systems began in the Longqing period of the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: Grain-transport and river naval camp systems dated to Ming Longqing.

sentences.zh: 清代略更其制。

translations.literal: The Qing slightly changed the system.
translations.idiomatic: The Qing modified the system slightly.

sentences.zh: 以衛卒專司輓運漕糧，以營兵專任護漕，別設城守營守護城池。

translations.literal: Guard soldiers were dedicated to hauling grain tribute; camp troops were dedicated to escorting tribute; city-garrison camps were separately established to guard cities.
translations.idiomatic: Guard soldiers hauled tribute grain, camp troops escorted it, and separate city garrisons guarded the towns.

sentences.zh: 分漕院與巡撫為二，漕運總督標下，統轄左、右、中三營及城守四營，駐山陽境及漕運要地，分別置兵。

translations.literal: The grain bureau and governor were divided in two; under the grain-transport governor-general's banner, left, right, and center three camps and four city-garrison camps were unified, garrisoned at Shanyang district and key grain-transport points, with troops placed separately.
translations.idiomatic: The grain bureau and governorship were split; under the grain-transport governor-general, left, center, and right camps plus four city garrisons were posted at Shanyang and key transport points.

sentences.zh: 淮郡舊為黃、淮二河交注之區，特建兩大閘，設河兵及堡夫守之。

translations.literal: Huai prefecture was formerly where the Yellow and Huai rivers joined; two great sluices were specially built, with river troops and fort laborers to guard them.
translations.idiomatic: Huai prefecture, where the Yellow and Huai rivers met, had two great sluices guarded by river troops and fort laborers.

sentences.zh: 河營遂與漕營並重，各有副將、參將、游擊、守備等官。

translations.literal: River camps thus stood equal with grain camps, each with deputy commanders, brigadiers, mobile brigadiers, garrison commanders, and other officers.
translations.idiomatic: River camps ranked with grain camps, each with deputy commanders, brigadiers, mobile brigadiers, and garrison commanders.

sentences.zh: 河營升遷之例，與軍功等，專司填築堤防之事，而緝捕之責不與焉。

translations.literal: River camp promotion regulations equaled military merit cases; they were dedicated to filling and building dikes and embankments—the duty of pursuit and capture did not apply.
translations.idiomatic: River camp promotions followed military merit rules; their duty was dikes and embankments, not pursuit and capture.

sentences.zh: 清代水師武功之盛，守洞庭而平吳逆，戰重洋而殲蔡牽，下長江而制粵寇，東南數千里，威行桴鼓，勞臣健將，蹈厲功名，超逾曩代。

translations.literal: The flourishing martial achievements of Qing naval forces—holding Dongting and pacifying the Wu rebel, fighting the deep sea and destroying Cai Qian, descending the Yangtze and controlling the Guangdong rebels—for several thousand li in the southeast, authority ran with drum and oar; toiling ministers and stalwart generals pressed forward for merit, surpassing former ages.
translations.idiomatic: Qing naval glory peaked in holding Dongting and crushing Wu Sangui, fighting the open sea to destroy Cai Qian, and descending the Yangtze against the Taiping—drum and oar commanding thousands of li in the southeast as tireless ministers and bold generals won fame beyond any earlier age.

sentences.zh: 及海禁宏開，鐵船橫駛，舟師舊制，弱不敵堅，遂盡失所恃。

translations.literal: When the maritime prohibitions were broadly lifted, iron ships plied the seas at will; the old naval establishment, weak unable to match strong, thus wholly lost what it had relied upon.
translations.idiomatic: When the maritime barriers fell and iron-hulled vessels prowled the coast at will, the old river-and-sea forces—light craft against armored hulls—lost every advantage they had once depended on.

sentences.zh: 時會迫迕，非規畫之疏也。

translations.literal: The times pressed and circumstances clashed; it was not a fault of planning.
translations.idiomatic: It was the pressure of the age, not defective planning.

sentences.zh: 凡直省舊額船數分防之制，分列於篇：曰東三省，曰直隸，曰山東，曰江南，附太湖湖標、漕標各水師，曰浙江，曰福建，曰廣東，曰廣西，曰湖南，曰湖北，曰安徽，曰長江水師。

translations.literal: As for the system whereby each directly administered province had fixed quotas of ships for divided defense, these are set forth separately in this section: the Three Eastern Provinces; Zhili; Shandong; Jiangnan, with the naval forces under the Taihu Lake banner and the Grain Transport banner appended; Zhejiang; Fujian; Guangdong; Guangxi; Hunan; Hubei; Anhui; and the Changjiang naval forces.
translations.idiomatic: The old quotas and patrol divisions for each directly governed province are treated province by province below: the Three Eastern Provinces, Zhili, Shandong, Jiangnan (with the Taihu and Grain Transport naval banners noted separately), Zhejiang, Fujian, Guangdong, Guangxi, Hunan, Hubei, Anhui, and the Yangtze flotillas.

sentences.zh: 東三省沿海各口岸，以金州、旅順口為尤要。

translations.literal: Among the coastal ports of the Three Eastern Provinces, Jinzhou and Lüshunkou were especially vital.
translations.idiomatic: Of all the coastal ports in Manchuria, Jinzhou and Port Arthur mattered most.

sentences.zh: 清初即有水師之制。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Qing dynasty there was already a naval establishment.
translations.idiomatic: The Qing had maintained waterborne forces from the dynasty's earliest years.

sentences.zh: 松花江、嫩江貫注吉林、黑龍江二省腹地。

translations.literal: The Songhua and Nen Rivers run through the heartlands of Jilin and Heilongjiang provinces.
translations.idiomatic: The Songhua and Nen rivers pierced the interior of Jilin and Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 所設水師營汛，由吉林而北抵墨爾根、黑龍江一帶。

translations.literal: The naval garrison posts established extended from Jilin northward to the Mer-gen and Heilongjiang region.
translations.idiomatic: Naval garrisons and patrol stations ran north from Jilin to Mer-gen and the Amur country.

sentences.zh: 至光緒間，旅順築海軍港，屯駐鐵艦，迥殊曩制。

translations.literal: By the Guangxu period, a naval harbor was built at Lüshun, ironclad warships were stationed there—utterly unlike the former system.
translations.idiomatic: In the Guangxu era, Port Arthur became a modern naval base with ironclads on station—a world apart from the old regime.

sentences.zh: 其東部之圖們、混同江上，時有俄羅斯戰艦侵軼，非舊制師船，械弱兵單，所能控制矣。

translations.literal: On the Tumen and Hunchun rivers in the east, Russian warships from time to time intruded and raided; this was not something the old-style command ships, with weak arms and sparse troops, could control.
translations.idiomatic: Along the Tumen and Amur headwaters in the east, Russian warships periodically violated the frontier—far beyond what the legacy patrol fleet, outgunned and understrength, could restrain.

sentences.zh: 列經制水師於後：

translations.literal: The regular established naval forces are listed below:
translations.idiomatic: The standing naval establishments follow:

sentences.zh: 奉天旅順口，於順治初年設水師營，以山東趕繒船十艘隸之，始編營汛。

translations.literal: At Fengtian Lüshunkou, in the early Shunzhi period a naval camp was established, with ten Shandong gan-zeng boats subordinated to it, and garrison posts were first organized.
translations.idiomatic: At Lüshunkou in Fengtian, the court founded a naval camp in the early Shunzhi reign, assigning ten Shandong chase-net junks and establishing the first patrol stations.

sentences.zh: 康熙十五年，設水師協領二人，佐領二人，防禦四人，驍騎校八人，水兵五百人。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 15, two naval assistant commandants, two company commandants, four defense officers, eight vanguard captains, and five hundred sailors were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Kangxi (1676), the roster stood at two assistant commandants, two company commandants, four defense officers, eight vanguard captains, and five hundred sailors.

sentences.zh: 五十三年，由浙江、福建二省船廠造大戰船六艘，由海道至奉省，駐防海口。

translations.literal: In the fifty-third year, six large war junks were built at the dockyards of Zhejiang and Fujian, sent by sea to Fengtian province, and stationed to defend the harbor mouth.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 53 (1714), six large warships built in Zhejiang and Fujian sailed north to Fengtian for harbor defense.

sentences.zh: 金州水師營隸城守尉，水兵百人。

translations.literal: The Jinzhou naval camp was subordinate to the city garrison colonel, with one hundred sailors.
translations.idiomatic: Jinzhou's naval detachment answered to the city garrison colonel and mustered one hundred sailors.

sentences.zh: 吉林水師營，順治間，設四、五、六品官。

translations.literal: The Jilin naval camp, during the Shunzhi period, had officials of the fourth, fifth, and sixth ranks appointed.
translations.idiomatic: During Shunzhi, Jilin's naval camp received fourth-, fifth-, and sixth-rank officers.

sentences.zh: 光緒十四年，增設總管一人，六品官二人。

translations.literal: In Guangxu 14, one superintendent and two sixth-rank officials were added.
translations.idiomatic: In 1888 an additional superintendent and two sixth-rank officers were added.

sentences.zh: 齊齊哈爾水師營，康熙二十三年，設總管一人，四品官二人，六品官二人，造船四、五、六品官各一人，領催八人，水兵二百六十八人，後增至五百六十八人，大戰船二艘，二號戰船十五艘。

translations.literal: The Qiqihar naval camp: in Kangxi 23, one superintendent, two fourth-rank officials, two sixth-rank officials, one official each of the fourth, fifth, and sixth ranks for shipbuilding, eight supply officers, two hundred sixty-eight sailors (later increased to five hundred sixty-eight), two large war junks, and fifteen second-class war junks.
translations.idiomatic: At Qiqihar, Kangxi 23 (1684) brought a superintendent, two fourth-rank and two sixth-rank officers, shipwright officers of three ranks, eight supply officers, 268 sailors (later 568), two heavy junks, and fifteen second-class warships.

sentences.zh: 康熙四十年，撥歸黑龍江十艘。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 40, ten were transferred to Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In 1701 ten vessels were reassigned to the Heilongjiang flotilla.

sentences.zh: 雍正間，撥歸墨爾根六艘，存大小戰船二十五艘，江船五艘，划子船十艘。

translations.literal: During Yongzheng, six were transferred to Mer-gen; there remained twenty-five large and small war junks, five river boats, and ten rowboats.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yongzheng, six boats went to Mer-gen; Qiqihar retained twenty-five war junks of various sizes, five river craft, and ten rowboats.

sentences.zh: 墨爾根水師營，康熙二十三年，設四品官一人，領催一人，由本城協領兼轄，凡戰船六艘，水兵四十三人，雍正間增戰船六艘。

translations.literal: The Mer-gen naval camp: in Kangxi 23, one fourth-rank official, one supply officer, jointly commanded by the local assistant commandant; six war junks in all, forty-three sailors; in Yongzheng, six more war junks were added.
translations.idiomatic: Mer-gen's naval camp, established Kangxi 23, had one fourth-rank officer and one supply officer under the city's assistant commandant; it began with six warships and forty-three sailors, and Yongzheng added six more.

sentences.zh: 黑龍江水師營，康熙二十三年，設總管一人，五品官二人，六品官二人，領催八人，戰船三十艘，水兵四百十九人。

translations.literal: The Heilongjiang naval camp: in Kangxi 23, one superintendent, two fifth-rank officials, two sixth-rank officials, eight supply officers, thirty war junks, four hundred nineteen sailors.
translations.idiomatic: Heilongjiang's camp, Kangxi 23: one superintendent, two fifth- and two sixth-rank officers, eight supply officers, thirty warships, and 419 sailors.

sentences.zh: 四十年，自齊齊哈爾撥船增之，凡大戰船十艘，二號戰船四十艘，江船十艘，划子船十艘。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year, boats transferred from Qiqihar augmented it: ten large war junks, forty second-class war junks, ten river boats, ten rowboats.
translations.idiomatic: In 1701, transfers from Qiqihar raised its strength to ten heavy junks, forty second-class warships, ten river boats, and ten rowboats.

sentences.zh: 直隸省水師，始於雍正四年，設天津水師營，都統一人，駐天津，專防海口，水師凡二千人，省內各河，咸歸陸汛，無內河水師。

translations.literal: Zhili provincial naval forces began in Yongzheng 4 with the Tianjin naval camp: one banner general stationed at Tianjin, devoted to defending the harbor mouth; naval forces totaled two thousand; all rivers within the province came under land garrisons—there were no inland river naval forces.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili's naval arm dates to Yongzheng 4 (1726), when a Tianjin naval camp was raised under a banner general to guard the estuary with two thousand sailors; inland rivers were left to land garrisons, with no separate river flotilla.

sentences.zh: 乾隆八年，增設副都統一人，水師千人，大小趕繒船二十四艘，仔船八艘。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 8, one vice banner general was added, one thousand naval troops, twenty-four large and small gan-zeng boats, eight tender boats.
translations.idiomatic: In 1743 a vice banner general joined the command, along with a thousand sailors, twenty-four chase-net junks, and eight tenders.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，以海口無事，徒費餉糈，全行裁汰。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year, because the harbor mouth was peaceful and provisions were wasted in vain, the entire force was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In 1767, with the harbor quiet and pay going to waste, the whole establishment was scrapped.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二十一年，復設水師千人。

translations.literal: In Jiaqing 21, one thousand naval troops were restored.
translations.idiomatic: In 1816 a thousand-man naval contingent was restored.

sentences.zh: 旋設大名鎮，以水師總兵歸併大名，實存守備一人，參將一人，千總二人，把總三人，水師四百九十一人。

translations.literal: Soon Daming garrison was established; the naval brigade general was merged into Daming; what actually remained was one garrison commander, one regimental commander, two battalion commanders, three platoon commanders, and four hundred ninety-one naval troops.
translations.idiomatic: Daming garrison was soon created; the naval brigade general was absorbed into it, leaving one garrison commander, one regimental commander, two battalion commanders, three platoon commanders, and 491 sailors.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十九年，直隸督臣那彥成以官兵虛設，兵船多朽，疏請裁撤，仍併入大名鎮。

translations.literal: In Jiaqing 19, Zhili governor Nayancheng, noting that troops and ships existed in name only and many vessels were rotted, memorialized requesting abolition and re-absorption into Daming garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In 1814 Governor Nayancheng of Zhili reported that the force was hollow and the hulls rotting, and asked that it be dissolved back into Daming garrison.

sentences.zh: 咸豐八年，以海疆多警，增設海口六營，於大沽南北兩岸，修築砲台，凡大砲台五座，平砲台十座，大砲九十九尊，水師三千人，以五百人為一營，分編左右六營。

translations.literal: In Xianfeng 8, because the coast was frequently alarmed, six harbor-mouth camps were added; on both banks of the Dagu estuary, fortifications were built—five large batteries, ten level batteries, ninety-nine great guns; three thousand naval troops, five hundred per camp, organized into six left and right camps.
translations.idiomatic: In 1858, with the coast under repeated threat, six harbor camps were added along both shores of Dagu: five main forts, ten barbette positions, ninety-nine heavy guns, and three thousand sailors in six battalions of five hundred each.

sentences.zh: 九年，改為一千八百人。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, this was changed to one thousand eight hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the force was cut to 1,800 men.

sentences.zh: 同治八年，督臣李鴻章疏請酌定營制，設大沽協副將，駐新城海口，防守砲台。

translations.literal: In Tongzhi 8, Governor Li Hongzhang memorialized requesting a settled camp organization, establishing an assistant brigade general for Dagu, stationed at Xincheng harbor mouth, to defend the batteries.
translations.idiomatic: In 1869 Li Hongzhang proposed a permanent organization: an assistant brigade general at Dagu, based at Xincheng mouth to hold the forts.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，李鴻章於大沽、北塘等處，增建砲台，購置歐洲鐵甲快船、碰船、水雷船，以海軍將領統之，不隸舊制協標之內。

translations.literal: In Guangxu 1, Li Hongzhang at Dagu, Beitang, and elsewhere added batteries, purchased European ironclad dispatch vessels, ram ships, and torpedo boats, commanded by naval officers—not subordinate within the old assistant-command banner establishment.
translations.idiomatic: In 1875 Li Hongzhang extended the Dagu and Beitang batteries and bought European ironclads, rams, and torpedo craft under naval officers—outside the old assistant-command structure.

sentences.zh: 其內河水師船，始於同治間，仿長江水師之制，設督標水師中營，管帶官一人，哨官三十二人，水師四百七十六人，舢板戰船三十二艘，駐三岔河口，親兵總哨官一人，哨官十四人，水師二百二人，舢板戰船十四艘，駐西沽河口。

translations.literal: Its inland river naval boats began in the Tongzhi period, modeled on the Changjiang naval system: a governor's-banner central naval camp with one commanding officer, thirty-two patrol officers, four hundred seventy-six sailors, thirty-two sampan war craft, stationed at the Sancha River mouth; one personal-guard chief patrol officer, fourteen patrol officers, two hundred two sailors, fourteen sampan war craft, stationed at the Xigou River mouth.
translations.idiomatic: River patrols came in the Tongzhi era, copied from the Yangtze model: a central naval battalion under the governor's banner with 476 sailors and 32 sampan gunboats at Sancha mouth, plus a personal guard detachment of 202 men and 14 boats at Xigou mouth.

sentences.zh: 山東，順治元年，始於登州府設水師營，領以守備、千總等官，凡沙唬船、邊江船十三艘，水兵三百八十六人，駐紮水城，分防東西海口。

translations.literal: Shandong: in Shunzhi 1, a naval camp was first established at Dengzhou prefecture, led by garrison commander, battalion commander, and other officers; thirteen sand-display boats and border-river boats in all, three hundred eighty-six sailors, garrisoned at the Water City, dividing defense of the eastern and western harbor mouths.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong's first naval camp, Shunzhi 1, was at Dengzhou under garrison and battalion commanders: thirteen patrol junks, 386 sailors, billeted in the Water City to cover both harbor mouths.

sentences.zh: 十五年，移沂州鎮於膠州，改膠州水師為陸營。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, Yizhou garrison was moved to Jiaozhou; the Jiaozhou naval force was converted to a land camp.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 15, Yizhou garrison relocated to Jiaozhou, and Jiaozhou's naval unit became a land garrison.

sentences.zh: 十八年，移臨清鎮於登州，以隸屬城守營之水師，改為前營水師。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, Linqing garrison was moved to Dengzhou; the naval force subordinate to the city-garrison camp became the Forward Naval Camp.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 18, Linqing garrison moved to Dengzhou; the city garrison's sailors were reorganized as the Forward Naval Camp.

sentences.zh: 康熙四十三年，增設游擊二員及守備以下各官，增水師為千二百人，改沙唬船為趕繒船二十艘，分巡東西海口，東至寧海州，西至萊州府，分為前後二營，各專其職。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 43, two brigade commanders and garrison commanders and lower officers were added; naval forces increased to twelve hundred; sand-display boats were converted to twenty gan-zeng boats, patrolling east and west harbor mouths from Ninghai department east to Laizhou prefecture west, divided into Forward and Rear camps, each with its own duties.
translations.idiomatic: In 1704 two brigade commanders and a full officer corps were added, raising strength to 1,200 sailors and replacing sand junks with twenty chase-net boats; patrols ran from Ninghai east to Laizhou west in separate Forward and Rear camps.

sentences.zh: 四十五年，以前營水師移駐膠州，巡哨南海，後營水師駐水城，巡哨北海。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year, the Forward Naval Camp was moved to Jiaozhou to patrol the South Sea; the Rear Naval Camp remained at Water City to patrol the North Sea.
translations.idiomatic: In 1706 the Forward Camp shifted to Jiaozhou for the southern patrol, while the Rear Camp stayed in the Water City for the northern coast.

sentences.zh: 五十三年，裁後營經制員弁，裁水師七百人，撥趕繒船十艘赴旅順口，僅存前營水師游擊等官，趕繒船十艘，分南北二汛，以游擊、守備分轄兵船之半。

translations.literal: In the fifty-third year, the Rear Camp's regular officers were abolished, seven hundred sailors cut; ten gan-zeng boats were sent to Lüshunkou; only the Forward Camp's brigade commander and other officers remained, ten gan-zeng boats, divided into south and north patrol seasons, brigade and garrison commanders each controlling half the fleet.
translations.idiomatic: In 1714 the Rear Camp's officers were struck and 700 men cut; ten junks went to Lüshunkou, leaving the Forward Camp with ten boats in north and south divisions under the brigade and garrison commanders.

sentences.zh: 雍正七年，每船增兵十人，兩汛共增兵百人，增雙篷艍船七艘，每艘配兵三十人，南汛艍船三艘，北汛艍船四艘，北汛增將弁一人。

translations.literal: Yongzheng 7: ten men added per boat, one hundred added across both patrol seasons; seven double-sailed ju boats added, thirty men each; south patrol three ju boats, north four; one officer added to north patrol.
translations.idiomatic: In 1729 each boat gained ten men—a hundred in all—and seven double-sailed ju craft joined the fleet, thirty men apiece; the south patrol took three, the north four, with an extra officer on the northern station.

sentences.zh: 九年，又增設艍船三艘，增兵一百九十人，每艍船共配兵四十人，南北汛各五艘。

translations.literal: Year 9: three more ju boats, one hundred ninety more men, forty per ju boat, five each for north and south patrols.
translations.idiomatic: In 1731 three more ju boats and 190 sailors were added, forty men per boat, giving each patrol season five ju craft.

sentences.zh: 十二年，增將弁六人，又於成山頭增設東汛水師，抽撥南北汛趕繒船各一艘，雙篷艍船各一艘，分配戰守兵，撥南北汛將弁四人，配船巡哨成山、馬頭嘴一帶，與各汛會旗，總歸水師前營管轄，以本鎮統之。

translations.literal: Year 12: six officers added; East Patrol naval force established at Chengshan Head; one gan-zeng and one double-sailed ju boat each drawn from north and south patrols, combat and garrison troops allocated, four officers from north and south patrols assigned to patrol Chengshan and Matouzui, rendezvous by signal flags with other patrols, all under Forward Naval Camp, commanded by the garrison general.
translations.idiomatic: In 1734 six officers were added and an East Patrol was stood up at Chengshan Head, each existing division contributing one chase-net junk and one ju boat; four officers patrolled Chengshan and Matouzui, coordinating by signal flag with the other stations—all under the Forward Camp and the garrison general.

sentences.zh: 列定制於後：

translations.literal: The fixed establishment is listed below:
translations.idiomatic: The authorized roster follows:

sentences.zh: 前營水師，游擊、守備各一人，千總二人，把總四人，外委千總二人，外委把總四人，水戰兵八百人，守兵二百人，趕繒船十艘，雙篷艍船十艘，每船各帶腳船一艘。

translations.literal: Forward Naval Camp: one brigade commander, one garrison commander, two battalion commanders, four platoon commanders, two brevet battalion commanders, four brevet platoon commanders, eight hundred combat sailors, two hundred garrison sailors, ten gan-zeng boats, ten double-sailed ju boats, each with one tender.
translations.idiomatic: The Forward Naval Camp mustered one brigade commander, one garrison commander, two battalion commanders, four platoon commanders, two brevet battalion commanders, four brevet platoon commanders, 800 combat sailors and 200 garrison sailors, ten chase-net junks and ten double-sailed ju boats—each towing a tender.

sentences.zh: 南汛駐膠州之頭營子，游擊一人，把總二人，外委千總、把總各一人，趕繒船四艘，雙篷船四艘，共配戰守兵四百人，南境巡哨至江南交界之鶯游山，東至榮成縣馬頭嘴，與東汛會旗。

translations.literal: South Patrol garrisoned at Touyingzi in Jiaozhou: one brigade commander, two platoon commanders, one brevet battalion and one brevet platoon commander each, four gan-zeng and four double-sailed boats, four hundred combat and garrison troops; south patrol to Yingyoushan on the Jiangnan border; east to Matouzui in Rongcheng, signal rendezvous with East Patrol.
translations.idiomatic: The South Patrol, based at Touyingzi in Jiaozhou, fielded a brigade commander, two platoon commanders, brevet officers, four chase-net and four double-sailed boats, and 400 sailors; its beat ran south to Yingyoushan on the Jiangnan border and east to Matouzui, where it met the East Patrol by signal flag.

sentences.zh: 東汛駐養魚池，千總、把總各一人，外委千總、把總各一人，趕繒船四艘，雙篷艍船四艘，共配戰守兵四百人，南境巡哨至馬頭嘴，與南汛會旗，北境巡哨至成山頭，與北汛會旗。

translations.literal: East Patrol at Yangyuchi: battalion and platoon commanders each one, brevet officers each one, four gan-zeng and four ju boats, four hundred troops; south to Matouzui with South Patrol, north to Chengshan Head with North Patrol.
translations.idiomatic: The East Patrol at Yangyuchi had battalion and platoon commanders, brevet officers, four chase-net and four ju boats, and 400 men; it linked south with the South Patrol at Matouzui and north with the North Patrol at Chengshan Head.

sentences.zh: 北汛駐登州府水城，中軍守備、千總、把總各一人，外委把總二人，趕繒船四艘，雙篷艍船四艘，共配戰守兵四百人，南境巡哨至成山頭，與東汛會旗，北境巡哨至隍城島，與直隸水師、盛京水師分界。

translations.literal: North Patrol at Dengzhou Water City: garrison commander, battalion commander, platoon commander each one, two brevet platoon commanders, four gan-zeng and four ju boats, four hundred troops; south to Chengshan Head with East Patrol; north to Huangcheng Island, boundary with Zhili and Shengjing naval forces.
translations.idiomatic: The North Patrol at Dengzhou's Water City held a garrison commander, battalion and platoon commanders, two brevet platoon commanders, four chase-net and four ju boats, and 400 sailors; southward it met the East Patrol at Chengshan Head, northward it marked the boundary with Zhili and Shengjing at Huangcheng Island.

sentences.zh: 江南水師，順治初年，江蘇松江等營，各有捕盜小快船四十艘，常州、鎮江等營，各有一、二十艘不等。

translations.literal: Jiangnan naval forces: early Shunzhi, Jiangsu Songjiang and other camps each had forty small fast pirate-catching boats; Changzhou, Zhenjiang camps had ten or twenty each, varying.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan's naval arm began in early Shunzhi, when Songjiang and other Jiangsu garrisons each kept forty small anti-piracy cutters and Changzhou and Zhenjiang held ten to twenty apiece.

sentences.zh: 自康熙七年，查毀沿江海各營出海之船，其內河快船，亦從裁汰。

translations.literal: From Kangxi 7, boats going to sea from river and coastal camps were investigated and destroyed; inland fast boats were also abolished.
translations.idiomatic: From Kangxi 7 (1668) the court seized and scrapped seagoing craft from every river and coastal garrison, and inland fast boats were cut as well.

sentences.zh: 嗣巡撫馬祜、提督楊捷疏請蘇、松、常、鎮四府，各塘汛設水師巡船三百二十五艘，以靖水盜。

translations.literal: Later Governor Ma Hu and Regional Commander Yang Jie memorialized requesting Sufu, Songjiang, Changzhou, Zhenjiang four prefectures set up three hundred twenty-five patrol boats at post stations to pacify river pirates.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Ma Hu and Regional Commander Yang Jie later asked that Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, and Zhenjiang post 325 patrol boats at their river stations to suppress water bandits.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，江蘇、浙江督撫會商，以太湖連跨二省，夙為盜藪，乃於湖濱各口，增設水師營汛巡船，分界巡防。

translations.literal: Yongzheng 1, Jiangsu and Zhejiang governors consulted; as Taihu straddled two provinces and had long been a bandit nest, naval camps and patrol boats were added at lake mouths for divided patrol.
translations.idiomatic: In 1723 the Jiangsu and Zhejiang governors agreed that Taihu, spanning both provinces and long a thieves' haven, needed new naval camps and patrol craft at its outlets for joint policing.

sentences.zh: 其湖內各地，系二省交會者，令參將各率水師會同巡緝。

translations.literal: Where lake areas were provincial junctions, brigade generals each led naval forces for joint patrol and arrest.
translations.idiomatic: In waters where the two provinces met, the brigade generals on each side led their sailors in combined patrols and arrests.

sentences.zh: 五年，令京口八旗營仿天津水師之制，設京口水師營，分撥京口大小戰船二十艘至江寧練習。

translations.literal: Year 5, ordered Jingkou Eight Banners camp to imitate Tianjin naval system, establish Jingkou naval camp, allocate twenty large and small war junks from Jingkou to Jiangning for drill.
translations.idiomatic: In 1727 the Jingkou Eight Banners were ordered to copy Tianjin's naval model, founding a Jingkou naval camp and sending twenty war junks downriver to Jiangning for training.

sentences.zh: 其駐寧水師，凡滿洲、蒙古兵千人，設協領四人，佐領、防禦、驍騎校各十二人。

translations.literal: Naval forces garrisoned at Ning: one thousand Manchu and Mongol troops, four assistant commandants, twelve each of company commandants, defense officers, and vanguard captains.
translations.idiomatic: The Ning garrison mustered a thousand Manchu and Mongol sailors under four assistant commandants and twelve company commandants, defense officers, and vanguard captains each.

sentences.zh: 是為江南水師之始。

translations.literal: This was the beginning of Jiangnan naval forces.
translations.idiomatic: Thus began the Jiangnan naval establishment.

sentences.zh: 鎮守京口左右兩路水師，設統兵官二人，分統左右營，各置沙船二十八艘，水艍船八艘，犁繒船八艘，舵椗手二百二十人，水手、匠役四百九十二人。

translations.literal: Jingkou left and right route naval forces: two overall commanders, left and right camps, each with twenty-eight sand junks, eight ju patrol boats, eight li-zeng boats, two hundred twenty helmsmen and anchorsmen, four hundred ninety-two sailors and craftsmen.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingkou left and right naval routes each had a commander, twenty-eight sand junks, eight ju patrol boats, eight li-zeng boats, 220 helmsmen and anchorsmen, and 492 sailors and shipwrights.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十一年，改隸江南提督標下，分為中、左、右三營。

translations.literal: Kangxi 21, transferred to Jiangnan regional commander's banner, divided into central, left, right three camps.
translations.idiomatic: In 1682 they passed to the Jiangnan regional commander's banner and were split into central, left, and right camps.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，裁總兵官，設副將以下各官，每營設沙船二十三艘，唬船七艘，小巴船四艘，水手四百六十八人。

translations.literal: Year 36, abolished brigade general, set vice general and lower; each camp twenty-three sand junks, seven hu boats, four small ba boats, four hundred sixty-eight sailors.
translations.idiomatic: In 1697 the brigade general was removed in favor of a vice general and subordinates; each camp then held twenty-three sand junks, seven display boats, four small ba craft, and 468 sailors.

sentences.zh: 自雍正二年後，迭有改撥，每營存唬船二艘，小巴唬船七艘，渡馬淺船六艘。

translations.literal: From Yongzheng 2 onward, repeated transfers; each camp retained two hu boats, seven small ba-hu boats, six shallow horse-ferry boats.
translations.idiomatic: After Yongzheng 2 (1724) repeated reallocations left each camp with two display boats, seven small ba-hu craft, and six shallow horse-ferries.

sentences.zh: 江南提督水師標兵，順治四年，始設參將以下各官，分為中、左、右、前、後五營及城守六營。

translations.literal: Jiangnan regional commander naval banner troops: Shunzhi 4, first set regimental commander and lower, divided into central, left, right, forward, rear five camps and six city-garrison camps.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangnan regional commander's naval banner, established Shunzhi 4, placed regimental commanders and subordinates over five sea camps—central, left, right, forward, and rear—and six city-garrison detachments.

sentences.zh: 中營唬船一艘，巡船十五艘，中號四櫓哨船二艘，槳櫓快哨船二艘。

translations.literal: Central camp: one hu boat, fifteen patrol boats, two medium four-oar sentry boats, two oar-and-scull fast sentry boats.
translations.idiomatic: The central camp: one display boat, fifteen patrol craft, two medium four-oared sentry boats, and two fast oared sentry boats.

sentences.zh: 左營唬船三艘，巡船十五艘，中號四櫓哨船二艘，槳櫓快哨船二艘。

translations.literal: Left camp: three hu boats, fifteen patrol boats, two medium four-oar sentry boats, two oar-and-scull fast sentry boats.
translations.idiomatic: The left camp: three display boats, fifteen patrol craft, two medium four-oared sentry boats, and two fast oared sentry boats.

sentences.zh: 右營浦江游巡哨船四艘，改設哨船一艘，槳船一艘，二櫓哨船一艘，巡船七艘。

translations.literal: Right camp Pu River patrol: originally four sentry boats, changed to one sentry boat, one oar boat, one two-oar sentry boat, seven patrol boats.
translations.idiomatic: The right camp's Pu River patrol had held four sentry boats; it was reorganized to one sentry boat, one oared craft, one two-oared sentry boat, and seven patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 前營中號四櫓哨船二艘，槳櫓快哨船二艘，巡船二十二艘。

translations.literal: Forward camp: two medium four-oar sentry boats, two oar-and-scull fast sentry boats, twenty-two patrol boats.
translations.idiomatic: The forward camp: two medium four-oared sentry boats, two fast oared sentry boats, and twenty-two patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 後營唬船一艘，中號四櫓哨船二艘，槳櫓快哨船二艘，巡船八艘。

translations.literal: Rear camp: one hu boat, two medium four-oar sentry boats, two oar-and-scull fast sentry boats, eight patrol boats.
translations.idiomatic: The rear camp: one display boat, two medium four-oared sentry boats, two fast oared sentry boats, and eight patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 松江城守營唬船一艘，中號四櫓哨船二艘，槳櫓快哨船二艘，巡船一艘。

translations.literal: Songjiang city garrison: one hu boat, two medium four-oar sentry boats, two oar-and-scull fast sentry boats, one patrol boat.
translations.idiomatic: Songjiang city garrison: one display boat, two medium four-oared sentry boats, two fast oared sentry boats, and one patrol boat.

sentences.zh: 金山營巡船十三艘。

translations.literal: Jinshan camp: thirteen patrol boats.
translations.idiomatic: Jinshan garrison: thirteen patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 柘林營巡船四艘。

translations.literal: Zhelin camp: four patrol boats.
translations.idiomatic: Zhelin garrison: four patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 青村營巡船二艘，小哨船一艘。

translations.literal: Qingcun camp: two patrol boats, one small sentry boat.
translations.idiomatic: Qingcun garrison: two patrol boats and one small sentry craft.

sentences.zh: 南匯營大罟船二艘，小哨船四艘。

translations.literal: Nanhui camp: two large seine boats, four small sentry boats.
translations.idiomatic: Nanhui garrison: two large seine-net boats and four small sentry craft.

sentences.zh: 川沙營捕匪大罟船三艘，放大罟船三艘，大罟船二艘，小哨船二艘，小號二櫓哨船二艘。

translations.literal: Chuansha camp: three bandit-catching large seine boats, three extended seine boats, two large seine boats, two small sentry boats, two small two-oar sentry boats.
translations.idiomatic: Chuansha garrison: three large anti-bandit seine boats, three extended seine craft, two large seiners, two small sentry boats, and two small two-oared sentry boats.

sentences.zh: 劉河營巡船八艘。

translations.literal: Liuhe camp: eight patrol boats.
translations.idiomatic: Liuhe garrison: eight patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 吳淞營沙船三艘，艍犁船四艘。

translations.literal: Wusong camp: three sand junks, four ju-li boats.
translations.idiomatic: Wusong garrison: three sand junks and four ju-li patrol craft.

sentences.zh: 福山營沙船四艘，官渡船四艘，巡船十六艘，後改為福山鎮標，設總兵以下各官。

translations.literal: Fushan camp: four sand junks, four official ferry boats, sixteen patrol boats; later changed to Fushan garrison banner with brigade general and lower.
translations.idiomatic: Fushan garrison held four sand junks, four official ferries, and sixteen patrol boats; it was later upgraded to a garrison banner under a brigade general.

sentences.zh: 太湖營沙船、快船、巴唬船共三十二艘，後改為太湖協標，設副將以下各官。

translations.literal: Taihu camp: thirty-two sand junks, fast boats, and ba-hu boats in all; later changed to Taihu assistant-command banner with vice general and lower.
translations.idiomatic: Taihu garrison mustered thirty-two sand junks, fast boats, and ba-hu craft combined; it later became an assistant-command banner under a vice general.

sentences.zh: 常州營巡船二十九艘。

translations.literal: Changzhou camp: twenty-nine patrol boats.
translations.idiomatic: Changzhou garrison: twenty-nine patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 江陰營唬船二艘，巡船七艘。

translations.literal: Jiangyin camp: two hu boats, seven patrol boats.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangyin garrison: two display boats and seven patrol craft.

sentences.zh: 靖江營唬船二艘。

translations.literal: Jingjiang camp: two hu boats.
translations.idiomatic: Jingjiang garrison: two display boats.

sentences.zh: 楊舍營巡船二艘。

translations.literal: Yangshe camp: two patrol boats.
translations.idiomatic: Yangshe garrison: two patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 鎮江城守營，順治十五年，設鎮守蘇、松水師總兵官，分中、左、右水師三營，各設沙船九艘，趕繒船五艘，尋改為參將等官，設巡船二十三艘。

translations.literal: Zhenjiang city garrison: Shunzhi 15, set garrison commander for Suzhou-Songjiang naval forces, divided central, left, right three naval camps, each nine sand junks five gan-zeng boats; soon changed to regimental commander and lower, twenty-three patrol boats.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenjiang's city garrison, Shunzhi 15, raised a brigade general for Suzhou-Songjiang naval forces with three camps, each holding nine sand junks and five chase-net boats; the post was soon reduced to a regimental commander with twenty-three patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 江南督標游兵營，順治初年，隸操江巡撫標下，設游擊以下各官，大唬船一艘，小唬船二十七艘。

translations.literal: Jiangnan governor-banner mobile camp: early Shunzhi, subordinate to River-Patrol governor's banner, brigade commander and lower, one large hu boat, twenty-seven small hu boats.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangnan governor's mobile camp, early Shunzhi, served under the River-Patrol governor with a brigade commander, one large display boat, and twenty-seven small display craft.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，裁併入督標。

translations.literal: Kangxi 1, abolished and merged into governor's banner.
translations.idiomatic: In 1662 it was abolished and absorbed into the governor's banner.

sentences.zh: 奇兵營，順治初年，隨操江巡撫赴安徽省駐防，改為太平右營，設游擊以下各官。

translations.literal: Qibing camp: early Shunzhi, followed River-Patrol governor to Anhui for garrison, changed to Taiping Right camp, brigade commander and lower.
translations.idiomatic: The Irregular camp, early Shunzhi, accompanied the River-Patrol governor to Anhui and was renamed the Taiping Right camp under a brigade commander.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，裁併入安慶營。

translations.literal: Kangxi 1, abolished and merged into Anqing camp.
translations.idiomatic: In 1662 it was abolished and merged into the Anqing garrison.

sentences.zh: 瓜洲營，順治二年，設守備以下各官，專防江北水汛，唬船八艘。

translations.literal: Guazhou camp: Shunzhi 2, garrison commander and lower, devoted to north-of-river water patrol, eight hu boats.
translations.idiomatic: Guazhou garrison, Shunzhi 2, placed a garrison commander and subordinates to guard the north-bank water line with eight display boats.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，改為參將，併入江南督標。

translations.literal: Kangxi 1, changed to regimental commander, merged into Jiangnan governor's banner.
translations.idiomatic: In 1662 it was downgraded to a regimental command and folded into the Jiangnan governor's banner.

sentences.zh: 十一年，改為瓜洲城守備，唬船八艘。

translations.literal: Year 11, changed to Guazhou city garrison commander, eight hu boats.
translations.idiomatic: In 1672 it became a city garrison command at Guazhou with eight display boats.

sentences.zh: 其各縣分防水師，寶應汛船十五艘，氾水汛船十四艘，永安汛船二十三艘，高郵汛船十六艘，江都汛船十四艘。

translations.literal: County-level divided-defense naval: Baoying post fifteen boats, Fanshui post fourteen boats, Yong'an post twenty-three boats, Gaoyou post sixteen boats, Jiangdu post fourteen boats.
translations.idiomatic: County detachments posted: Baoying fifteen boats, Fanshui fourteen, Yong'an twenty-three, Gaoyou sixteen, Jiangdu fourteen.

sentences.zh: 淮安廟灣營，順治初年，設游擊以下各官，沙船五艘，唬船四艘。

translations.literal: Huai'an Miaowan camp: early Shunzhi, brigade commander and lower, five sand junks, four hu boats.
translations.idiomatic: Huai'an's Miaowan garrison, early Shunzhi, fielded a brigade commander, five sand junks, and four display boats.

sentences.zh: 佃湖營，雍正九年，由廟灣營分防，設都司以下各官，沙船三艘，巡船四艘，唬船一艘，內河巡哨船一艘。

translations.literal: Dianhu camp: Yongzheng 9, split from Miaowan camp, brigade commander and lower, three sand junks, four patrol boats, one hu boat, one inland patrol boat.
translations.idiomatic: Dianhu garrison, spun off from Miaowan in Yongzheng 9, held a brigade commander, three sand junks, four patrol boats, one display boat, and one inland patrol craft.

sentences.zh: 營城營，順治三年，設守備以下各官，唬船四艘，小巡船四艘。

translations.literal: Yingcheng camp: Shunzhi 3, garrison commander and lower, four hu boats, four small patrol boats.
translations.idiomatic: Yingcheng garrison, Shunzhi 3, placed a garrison commander with four display boats and four small patrol craft.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十一年，改為唬船一艘，巡海哨船二艘，三號四號沙船二艘，小巡船四艘。

translations.literal: Qianlong 11: changed to one hu boat, two coastal sentry boats, two class-three and class-four sand junks, four small patrol boats.
translations.idiomatic: In 1746 its fleet was reset to one display boat, two coastal sentry craft, two third- and fourth-class sand junks, and four small patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 小關營，雍正十一年，由鹽城營分防，設都司以下各官，沙船二艘，唬船一艘，快船一艘。

translations.literal: Xiaoguan camp: Yongzheng 11, split from Yancheng camp, brigade commander and lower, two sand junks, one hu boat, one fast boat.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaoguan garrison, detached from Yancheng in Yongzheng 11, kept a brigade commander, two sand junks, one display boat, and one fast craft.

sentences.zh: 海州營，順治四年，設游擊以下各官，小巡船五艘。

translations.literal: Haizhou camp: Shunzhi 4, brigade commander and lower, five small patrol boats.
translations.idiomatic: Haizhou garrison, Shunzhi 4, mustered a brigade commander and five small patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年，併入東海營，增設沙唬船十艘。

translations.literal: Kangxi 3, merged into Donghai camp, added ten sand-hu boats.
translations.idiomatic: In 1664 it was merged into the Donghai garrison, which gained ten sand-display boats.

sentences.zh: 東海營，順治初年，設守備以下各官。

translations.literal: Donghai camp: early Shunzhi, garrison commander and lower.
translations.idiomatic: The Donghai garrison, early Shunzhi, was led by a garrison commander and subordinates.

sentences.zh: 十八年裁撤。

translations.literal: Year 18 abolished.
translations.idiomatic: It was abolished in Shunzhi 18.

sentences.zh: 康熙十八年復設。

translations.literal: Kangxi 18 restored.
translations.idiomatic: It was restored in Kangxi 18 (1679).

sentences.zh: 其分防汛地，鷹游內外洋汛船二艘，大浦汛商船二艘，海頭汛唬船一艘，臨洪口汛哨船二艘，高公島汛沙船一艘。

translations.literal: Divided patrol areas: Yingyou inner and outer sea post two boats, Dapu post merchant boats two, Haitou post one hu boat, Linhong mouth post two sentry boats, Gaogong Island post one sand junk.
translations.idiomatic: Its patrol sectors held: two boats at the Yingyou inner and outer sea station, two merchant-craft at Dapu, one display boat at Haitou, two sentry craft at Linhong mouth, and one sand junk at Gaogong Island.

sentences.zh: 江蘇撫標左右營，順治四年，設參將以下各官，左營巡船十艘，右營巡船十艘。

translations.literal: Jiangsu governor's banner left and right camps: Shunzhi 4, regimental commander and lower, left camp ten patrol boats, right camp ten patrol boats.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangsu governor's left and right camps, Shunzhi 4, each placed a regimental commander with ten patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 蘇州城守營，順治四年，設參將以下各官，巡船五十八艘。

translations.literal: Suzhou city-defense camp: Shunzhi 4, regimental commander and lower, fifty-eight patrol boats.
translations.idiomatic: The Suzhou city-defense garrison, established in Shunzhi 4 (1647), was led by a regimental commander and held fifty-eight patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 平望營，順治三年，設游擊以下各官，巡船十七艘。

translations.literal: Pingwang camp: Shunzhi 3, mobile brigade commander and lower, seventeen patrol boats.
translations.idiomatic: Pingwang garrison, Shunzhi 3, mustered a mobile brigade commander with seventeen patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 初隸提督標，乾隆以後，改隸巡撫標，巡船二十艘。

translations.literal: At first subordinate to regional commander's banner; after Qianlong, transferred to governor's banner; twenty patrol boats.
translations.idiomatic: It first answered to the regional commander's banner, but after the Qianlong reign was reassigned to the governor's banner, with twenty patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 福山營，自提督標分防，設游擊以下各官，其沙船四艘，巡船六艘，官渡船四艘，船數仍如曩制。

translations.literal: Fushan camp: split from regional commander's banner for defense, mobile brigade commander and lower; four sand junks, six patrol boats, four official ferry boats; ship count still as former regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Fushan garrison, detached from the regional commander's banner for separate defense, kept a mobile brigade commander, four sand junks, six patrol boats, and four official ferry craft—the fleet unchanged from the earlier establishment.

sentences.zh: 道光間，以海疆要地，改為鎮標，設總兵以下各官，分為中、左、右三營。

translations.literal: Daoguang period, because coastal frontier key place, changed to brigade banner, commander and lower, divided into center, left, right three camps.
translations.idiomatic: In the Daoguang years, as a vital coastal post, it was raised to a brigade banner with a commander and subordinates split into center, left, and right camps.

sentences.zh: 淞北營，原隸督標內河水師，同治十一年，改隸江南提標水師，增設副將以下各官，仿長江水師之制，設舢板船十六艘。

translations.literal: Songbei camp: originally under governor's banner inland navy; Tongzhi 11, transferred to Jiangnan regional naval banner, added deputy commander and lower, modeled on Yangtze navy system, sixteen sampan boats.
translations.idiomatic: Songbei garrison, once part of the governor's inland fleet, passed in Tongzhi 11 to the Jiangnan regional naval command; a deputy commander was added, the Yangtze model was adopted, and sixteen sampan warcraft were assigned.
