sentences.zh: 淞南營，同治十一年，改隸里河淞北協標，增設游擊以下各官，仿長江水師之制，設舢板船、座船凡三十七艘。

translations.literal: Songnan camp: Tongzhi 11, transferred to inland Songbei cooperative banner, added mobile brigade commander and lower, modeled on Yangtze navy system, thirty-seven sampan and command boats in all.
translations.idiomatic: Songnan garrison, in Tongzhi 11, was placed under the inland Songbei cooperative banner; a mobile brigade commander was added, the Yangtze pattern followed, and thirty-seven sampan and command craft were fielded.

sentences.zh: 江北狼山鎮標，順治十八年，設總兵以下各官．分中、左、右三營。

translations.literal: Jiangbei Langshan brigade banner: Shunzhi 18, commander and lower, divided into center, left, right three camps.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangbei Langshan brigade banner, Shunzhi 18, was led by a commander and split into center, left, and right camps.

sentences.zh: 中營趕繒船一艘，沙船一艘，唬船三艘，渡船五艘。

translations.literal: Center camp: one gan-zeng boat, one sand junk, three display boats, five ferry boats.
translations.idiomatic: The center camp: one pursuit junk, one sand junk, three display boats, and five ferry craft.

sentences.zh: 左營趕繒船一艘，沙船二艘，唬船三艘，渡船六艘。

translations.literal: Left camp: one gan-zeng boat, two sand junks, three display boats, six ferry boats.
translations.idiomatic: The left camp: one pursuit junk, two sand junks, three display boats, and six ferry craft.

sentences.zh: 右營趕繒船六艘，沙船一艘，唬船四艘，渡船三艘。

translations.literal: Right camp: six gan-zeng boats, one sand junk, four display boats, three ferry boats.
translations.idiomatic: The right camp: six pursuit junks, one sand junk, four display boats, and three ferry craft.

sentences.zh: 泰州營，順治二年，設游擊以下各官，趕繒船二艘，沙船二艘。

translations.literal: Taizhou camp: Shunzhi 2, mobile brigade commander and lower, two gan-zeng boats, two sand junks.
translations.idiomatic: Taizhou garrison, Shunzhi 2, placed a mobile brigade commander with two pursuit junks and two sand junks.

sentences.zh: 掘港營，順治三年，設守備以下各官，唬船三艘。

translations.literal: Juegang camp: Shunzhi 3, garrison commander and lower, three display boats.
translations.idiomatic: Juegang garrison, Shunzhi 3, was led by a garrison commander and kept three display boats.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十三年，以京口將軍標下沙船二十二艘，唬船十八艘，隸狼山鎮標，為海口巡防水師。

translations.literal: Kangxi 23: from Jingkou general's banner, twenty-two sand junks and eighteen display boats, assigned to Langshan brigade banner, as estuary patrol navy.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 23 (1684), twenty-two sand junks and eighteen display boats from the Jingkou general's banner were transferred to the Langshan brigade banner as the estuary patrol fleet.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，以戰船四艘，仍撥歸京口。

translations.literal: Year 28: four war boats, again reassigned back to Jingkou.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 28, four warships were reassigned to Jingkou.

sentences.zh: 四十八年，改為中、左、右三營。

translations.literal: Year 48: changed to center, left, right three camps.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 48 it was reorganized into center, left, and right camps.

sentences.zh: 中營趕繒船三艘，沙船二艘。

translations.literal: Center camp: three gan-zeng boats, two sand junks.
translations.idiomatic: The center camp held three pursuit junks and two sand junks.

sentences.zh: 左營趕繒船三艘，沙船三艘。

translations.literal: Left camp: three gan-zeng boats, three sand junks.
translations.idiomatic: The left camp held three pursuit junks and three sand junks.

sentences.zh: 右營趕繒船四艘，沙船二艘，唬船四艘。

translations.literal: Right camp: four gan-zeng boats, two sand junks, four display boats.
translations.idiomatic: The right camp held four pursuit junks, two sand junks, and four display boats.

sentences.zh: 雍正十年，實存大小水師船二十二艘。

translations.literal: Yongzheng 10: actually existing large and small navy ships, twenty-two.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 10 (1732), twenty-two large and small naval vessels were actually on the rolls.

sentences.zh: 十三年，右營增小哨沙船一艘。

translations.literal: Year 13: right camp added one small sentry sand junk.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 13 the right camp gained one small sentry sand junk.

sentences.zh: 同治五年，增設綏通、綏海二營，隸長江水師提督。

translations.literal: Tongzhi 5: added Suitong and Suihai two camps, subordinate to Yangtze naval regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 5 (1866), the Suitong and Suihai garrisons were added under the Yangtze naval regional commander.

sentences.zh: 江南福山鎮標，道光二十三年，設總兵以下各官，分中、左、右三營，以舊有之福山營水師為福中營，蘇松奇兵營水師為福左營，楊厙水師為福右營。

translations.literal: Jiangnan Fushan brigade banner: Daoguang 23, commander and lower, divided center left right three camps; old Fushan camp navy as Fu-center camp, Su-Song irregular camp navy as Fu-left camp, Yangshe navy as Fu-right camp.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangnan Fushan brigade banner, Daoguang 23 (1843), placed a commander and split into center, left, and right camps: the old Fushan naval garrison became the center camp, the Su-Song irregular naval force the left, and the Yangshe fleet the right.

sentences.zh: 中營舊設巡船十五艘，日久朽壞無存，以沙船四艘增換闊頭舢板船五艘，左營設大小舢板船八艘，右營設大小舢板船五艘。

translations.literal: Center camp originally had fifteen patrol boats, long decayed with none remaining; four sand junks exchanged to add five broad-bowed sampan boats; left camp set large and small sampan boats eight; right camp set large and small sampan boats five.
translations.idiomatic: The center camp's fifteen patrol boats had rotted away; four sand junks were traded in for five broad-bowed sampans, while the left camp received eight large and small sampans and the right camp five.

sentences.zh: 同治九年，改定營制，以中營併入左右營，以左營原轄之海門廳屬西半洋沙等汛，隸通州營，以左營分中左右三哨，分駕巡船十二艘，出巡洋面，以右營駐防陸路各汛。

translations.literal: Tongzhi 9: revised camp system; center camp merged into left and right camps; left camp's former jurisdiction over Haimen subprefecture's western Ban-yang-sha and other posts transferred to Tongzhou camp; left camp divided into center-left-right three squadrons, jointly crewing twelve patrol boats to patrol open sea; right camp garrisoned land posts.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 9 (1870) the establishment was reset: the center camp was absorbed into the wings; the left camp's Haimen sectors on the western Ban-yang-sha sandbars passed to Tongzhou; the left wing was split into three squadrons sharing twelve patrol boats for open-sea cruising, while the right wing held the land stations.

sentences.zh: 太湖水師，始於雍正間。

translations.literal: Taihu navy: began in Yongzheng period.
translations.idiomatic: The Taihu navy dates to the Yongzheng reign.

sentences.zh: 太湖連跨蘇州、常州、湖州之境，為全吳巨浸。

translations.literal: Taihu spans Suzhou, Changzhou, Huzhou territory; is all Wu's great lake.
translations.idiomatic: Taihu sprawls across Suzhou, Changzhou, and Huzhou—the great inland sea of the lower Yangzi delta.

sentences.zh: 湖中風浪與江海異，故巡湖水師，船制亦殊。

translations.literal: Lake wind and waves differ from rivers and sea; therefore lake-patrol navy, boat types also different.
translations.idiomatic: Wind and chop on the lake differ from river and sea conditions, so the lake patrol fleet used its own hull types.

sentences.zh: 其衛所巡司則以巡船，水師則以哨船。

translations.literal: Its guard posts and patrol inspectors use patrol boats; navy uses sentry boats.
translations.idiomatic: Guard posts and patrol offices sailed patrol craft; the navy itself manned sentry boats.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年，設太湖營游擊、千總、把總各一人。

translations.literal: Yongzheng 2: established Taihu camp—one mobile brigade commander, one battalion officer, one platoon officer each.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 2 (1724) the Taihu garrison was created with one mobile brigade commander, one battalion officer, and one platoon officer.

sentences.zh: 五年，以大錢汛口為浙江省瀕湖要道，增守備、千總各一人，把總三人，戰守水兵原額千人，歷年裁併，實存水戰兵一百八十六人，守兵四百七十二人，分防各處：甪頭汛兵一百八十五人，沙快船五艘；

translations.literal: Year 5: because Daqian mouth post is Zhejiang province's lakeside key route, added one garrison commander, one battalion officer, three platoon officers; combat-garrison sailors original quota one thousand, cut and merged over years, actually existing combat sailors one hundred eighty-six, garrison soldiers four hundred seventy-two, divided among posts: Lutou post one hundred eighty-five soldiers, five fast sand boats;
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 5, as Daqian mouth was Zhejiang's chief lakeside crossing, a garrison commander, battalion officer, and three platoon officers were added; though the original quota stood at a thousand sailors, cuts left 186 combat hands and 472 garrison troops posted thus: Lutou, 185 men and five fast sand junks;

sentences.zh: 西山汛兵六十九人，沙快船二艘；

translations.literal: Xishan post sixty-nine soldiers, two fast sand boats;
translations.idiomatic: Xishan, 69 men and two fast sand junks;

sentences.zh: 浙江烏程汛兵一百九十七人，沙快船九艘；

translations.literal: Zhejiang Wucheng post one hundred ninety-seven soldiers, nine fast sand boats;
translations.idiomatic: Wucheng in Zhejiang, 197 men and nine fast sand junks;

sentences.zh: 伍浦汛兵六十九人，快巡船九艘；

translations.literal: Wupu post sixty-nine soldiers, nine fast patrol boats;
translations.idiomatic: Wupu, 69 men and nine fast patrol craft;

sentences.zh: 南浦汛兵一百七人，快巡船九艘。

translations.literal: Nanpu post one hundred seven soldiers, nine fast patrol boats.
translations.idiomatic: Nanpu, 107 men and nine fast patrol craft.

sentences.zh: 七年，以沙船六艘為湖中大汛巡防，其餘改小號巡船二十艘，巡緝支河小港。

translations.literal: Year 7: six sand junks for lake major-season patrol defense; the rest changed to twenty small patrol boats, patrolling tributary rivers and small harbors.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 7 six sand junks guarded the lake during the high season; the remainder became twenty small patrol boats for tributaries and back channels.

sentences.zh: 九年，分水師為左右二營，左營守備駐簡村，列汛凡六，當震澤縣界。

translations.literal: Year 9: divided navy into left and right two camps; left camp garrison commander stationed at Jiancun, listed posts six in all, on Zhenze county border.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 9 the fleet split into left and right camps; the left garrison commander at Jiancun held six posts along the Zhenze county line.

sentences.zh: 千總一人，駐鯰魚口，列汛十有二，當吳縣、吳江、震澤界。

translations.literal: One battalion officer, stationed at Nianyu mouth, listed posts twelve, on Wu county, Wujiang, Zhenze borders.
translations.idiomatic: One battalion officer at Nianyu mouth covered twelve posts where Wu, Wujiang, and Zhenze met.

sentences.zh: 把總二人：一駐東山，列汛凡八，當吳縣界；

translations.literal: Two platoon officers: one stationed at Dongshan, listed posts eight, on Wu county border;
translations.idiomatic: Two platoon officers: one at Dongshan with eight posts on the Wu county line;

sentences.zh: 一駐吳江，列汛凡八，當吳江、震澤界。

translations.literal: one stationed at Wujiang, listed posts eight, on Wujiang, Zhenze border.
translations.idiomatic: one at Wujiang with eight posts on the Wujiang–Zhenze line.

sentences.zh: 右營守備駐周鐵橋，列汛凡六，當宜興、陽湖界。

translations.literal: Right camp garrison commander stationed at Zhoutie Bridge, listed posts six, on Yixing, Yanghu border.
translations.idiomatic: The right camp's garrison commander at Zhoutie Bridge held six posts on the Yixing–Yanghu border.

sentences.zh: 千總一人，駐馬山，列汛十有四，當常州、無錫、陽湖界。

translations.literal: One battalion officer, stationed at Mashan, listed posts fourteen, on Changzhou, Wuxi, Yanghu borders.
translations.idiomatic: One battalion officer at Mashan covered fourteen posts where Changzhou, Wuxi, and Yanghu converged.

sentences.zh: 把總二人：一駐黿山，列汛凡七，當吳縣界；

translations.literal: Two platoon officers: one stationed at Yuan Mountain, listed posts seven, on Wu county border;
translations.idiomatic: Two platoon officers: one at Turtle Hill with seven posts on the Wu county line;

sentences.zh: 一駐鳳川，列汛凡七，當宜興、荊溪界。

translations.literal: one stationed at Fengchuan, listed posts seven, on Yixing, Jingxi border.
translations.idiomatic: one at Fengchuan with seven posts on the Yixing–Jingxi line.

sentences.zh: 乾隆間，設副將以下各官，水師戰船，凡巴唬船十六艘，沙船三艘，大快船七艘，小快船三十二艘。

translations.literal: Qianlong period: established deputy commander and lower; navy war boats—in all sixteen ba-hu boats, three sand junks, seven large fast boats, thirty-two small fast boats.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qianlong a deputy commander was appointed, and the war fleet numbered sixteen ba-display boats, three sand junks, seven large fast craft, and thirty-two small fast craft.

sentences.zh: 至道光間，存巴唬船十六艘，沙船二艘，大快船六艘，小快船二十艘，槳船十艘。

translations.literal: By Daoguang period: remaining sixteen ba-hu boats, two sand junks, six large fast boats, twenty small fast boats, ten oared boats.
translations.idiomatic: By the Daoguang years the rolls showed sixteen ba-display boats, two sand junks, six large and twenty small fast craft, and ten oared boats.

sentences.zh: 迨咸豐年粵匪亂後，營伍船械全失。

translations.literal: By Xianfeng year, after Cantonese bandit rebellion, camps and ships and weapons all lost.
translations.idiomatic: After the Taiping uprising in the Xianfeng era, the garrisons lost every ship and weapon.

sentences.zh: 同治間，重整水師，盡易舊制，仿長江營制，設太湖協標二營，舢板戰船三十六艘。

translations.literal: Tongzhi period: reorganized navy, entirely changed old system, modeled on Yangtze camp system, established Taihu cooperative banner two camps, thirty-six sampan war boats.
translations.idiomatic: In the Tongzhi restoration the fleet was rebuilt on the Yangtze model: a two-camp Taihu cooperative banner with thirty-six sampan warcraft, the old establishment discarded entirely.

sentences.zh: 此江南水師之制也。

translations.literal: This is Jiangnan navy's system.
translations.idiomatic: Such was the organization of the Jiangnan navy.

sentences.zh: 其長江水師之在江南省者，為瓜洲鎮標，轄瓜洲營、孟湖營、三江營、江陰營，戰船兵額，與各省長江水師同。

translations.literal: Its Yangtze navy in Jiangnan province: Guazhou brigade banner, commanding Guazhou, Menghu, Sanjiang, Jiangyin camps; war boats and troop quotas same as other provinces' Yangtze navy.
translations.idiomatic: The Yangtze fleet in Jiangnan was the Guazhou brigade banner, overseeing Guazhou, Menghu, Sanjiang, and Jiangyin garrisons—its ships and quotas matched the Yangtze commands of other provinces.

sentences.zh: 河道總督標營凡二十營，雍正七年，以漕標右營改隸河標設，巡船九艘。

translations.literal: Grand Canal director-general's banner camps twenty in all; Yongzheng 7, changed from grain-transport banner right camp to subordinate to canal banner, established; nine patrol boats.
translations.idiomatic: The canal director-general's banner comprised twenty garrisons; one, spun off from the grain fleet's right wing in Yongzheng 7, kept nine patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 山清里河上營，康熙十七年設，船六十八艘。

translations.literal: Shanqing inner-river upper camp: Kangxi 17 established, sixty-eight boats.
translations.idiomatic: The Shanqing inner-river upper garrison, founded in Kangxi 17 (1678), fielded sixty-eight boats.

sentences.zh: 里河下營，雍正六年，由里河營分設，船十三艘。

translations.literal: Inner-river lower camp: Yongzheng 6, split from inner-river camp, thirteen boats.
translations.idiomatic: The inner-river lower garrison, detached in Yongzheng 6, held thirteen boats.

sentences.zh: 外河上營，船一百十四艘。

translations.literal: Outer-river upper camp: one hundred fourteen boats.
translations.idiomatic: The outer-river upper garrison mustered one hundred fourteen boats.

sentences.zh: 山安海防河營，雍正七年，由外河營分設，船五十四艘。

translations.literal: Shan'an coastal-defense river camp: Yongzheng 7, split from outer-river camp, fifty-four boats.
translations.idiomatic: The Shan'an coastal-defense river garrison, split from the outer-river command in Yongzheng 7, kept fifty-four boats.

sentences.zh: 高堰上營，康熙三十八年，由盱眙營分設，船三十四艘。

translations.literal: Gaoyan upper camp: Kangxi 38, split from Xuyi camp, thirty-four boats.
translations.idiomatic: The Gaoyan upper garrison, detached from Xuyi in Kangxi 38 (1699), held thirty-four boats.

sentences.zh: 山盱下營，雍正七年，由高堰營分設，船十七艘。

translations.literal: Shan-Xu lower camp: Yongzheng 7, split from Gaoyan camp, seventeen boats.
translations.idiomatic: The Shan-Xu lower garrison, split from Gaoyan in Yongzheng 7, kept seventeen boats.

sentences.zh: 桃源安清營，康熙三十八年設，船二十三艘。

translations.literal: Taoyuan Anqing camp: Kangxi 38 established, twenty-three boats.
translations.idiomatic: The Taoyuan–Anqing garrison, established in Kangxi 38, fielded twenty-three boats.

sentences.zh: 揚河上營，康熙十七年設，船八十二艘。

translations.literal: Yang-river upper camp: Kangxi 17 established, eighty-two boats.
translations.idiomatic: The Yangzhou canal upper garrison, founded in Kangxi 17, mustered eighty-two boats.

sentences.zh: 揚河下營，雍正七年設，船十四艘。

translations.literal: Yang-river lower camp: Yongzheng 7 established, fourteen boats.
translations.idiomatic: The Yangzhou canal lower garrison, created in Yongzheng 7, held fourteen boats.

sentences.zh: 徐河南北營，雍正六年設，船三十艘。

translations.literal: Xu-river north-south camp: Yongzheng 6 established, thirty boats.
translations.idiomatic: The Xu River north-south garrison, established in Yongzheng 6, kept thirty boats.

sentences.zh: 邳睢河營，順治初年設，船七十五艘。

translations.literal: Pi-Sui river camp: early Shunzhi established, seventy-five boats.
translations.idiomatic: The Pi–Sui river garrison, early Shunzhi, fielded seventy-five boats.

sentences.zh: 宿虹南北營，順治初年設，船百艘。

translations.literal: Su-Hong north-south camp: early Shunzhi established, one hundred boats.
translations.idiomatic: The Su–Hong north-south garrison, early Shunzhi, mustered one hundred boats.

sentences.zh: 桃源南北營，順治初年設，船六十八艘。

translations.literal: Taoyuan north-south camp: early Shunzhi established, sixty-eight boats.
translations.idiomatic: The Taoyuan north-south garrison, early Shunzhi, held sixty-eight boats.

sentences.zh: 宿遷運河營，雍正六年設，船十九艘。

translations.literal: Suqian canal camp: Yongzheng 6 established, nineteen boats.
translations.idiomatic: The Suqian canal garrison, established in Yongzheng 6, kept nineteen boats.

sentences.zh: 凡河防各營，設守備以下各官，大小各船，分浚船、柳船二類，修防河工，以營制部勒之。

translations.literal: All river-defense camps: garrison commander and lower, large and small boats, divided into dredging boats and willow boats two types, maintaining river works, organized by camp system.
translations.idiomatic: Every river-defense garrison placed a garrison commander and subordinates, with dredgers and willow-boat fleets of various sizes to maintain the works—all marshaled under the camp system.

sentences.zh: 漕運總督水師標營，分中營、左營、右營、城守四營，以中、左、右三營任護漕之責，以城守四營任地方之責，駐山陽境及漕運所經之地。

translations.literal: Grain-transport director-general naval banner camps: divided center, left, right, city-defense four camps; center left right three camps bear grain-guard duty; city-defense four camps bear local duty; stationed in Shanyang territory and places grain transport passes.
translations.idiomatic: The grain-transport director-general's naval banner split into center, left, right, and city-defense camps: the first three escorted the tribute grain, the city-defense wing held local posts, all stationed in Shanyang and along the canal route.

sentences.zh: 其運輓漕糧，則以衛卒任之。

translations.literal: Its transport and conveyance of tribute grain, then guard soldiers bear it.
translations.idiomatic: Actual hauling of the tribute grain fell to the guard soldiers.

sentences.zh: 浙江水師，杭州協錢塘水師營，順治初年，設守備各官，兵一百十五人，鱉子門汛兵七十九人，新城汛兵三十一人，塘棲汛兵九十三人，錢江汛兵七十七人，富陽汛兵一百五十人，防守河庄山唬船四艘，運河內河快唬船十一艘，錢塘江渡馬船六艘。

translations.literal: Zhejiang navy: Hangzhou cooperative Qiantang naval camp, early Shunzhi, garrison commander and officers, one hundred fifteen soldiers; Biezi Gate post seventy-nine soldiers, Xincheng post thirty-one, Tangxi post ninety-three, Qianjiang post seventy-seven, Fuyang post one hundred fifty; defending Hezhuang Mountain four display boats, canal inland fast display boats eleven, Qiantang River ferry horse boats six.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhejiang the Hangzhou cooperative Qiantang naval garrison, early Shunzhi, placed a garrison commander with 115 troops: Biezi Gate 79, Xincheng 31, Tangxi 93, Qianjiang 77, Fuyang 150; its fleet comprised four display boats at Hezhuang Mountain, eleven fast display craft on the canal, and six horse ferries on the Qiantang River.

sentences.zh: 乍浦水師營，雍正二年，以定海鎮右營改歸乍浦，設參將各官，水戰兵二百四十人，守兵二百七十六人，戰船十艘，內洋岑港轄洋面汛三十三，內洋瀝港轄洋面汛十五，內洋岱山轄洋面汛十九。

translations.literal: Zhapu naval camp: Yongzheng 2, Dinghai brigade right camp changed to Zhapu, regimental commander and officers, combat sailors two hundred forty, garrison soldiers two hundred seventy-six, ten war boats; inner sea Cen Harbor commands thirty-three open-sea posts, inner sea Ligang fifteen, inner sea Daishan nineteen.
translations.idiomatic: Zhapu naval garrison, Yongzheng 2 (1724), absorbed the Dinghai brigade's right wing; a regimental commander led 240 combat sailors and 276 garrison troops with ten warships, covering thirty-three open-sea sectors from Cen Harbor, fifteen from Ligang, and nineteen from Daishan.

sentences.zh: 嘉興協營，設副將各官，駐防府城，兵四百三十二人，快唬船五艘。

translations.literal: Jiaxing cooperative camp: deputy commander and officers, garrisoned at prefectural city, four hundred thirty-two soldiers, five fast display boats.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiaxing cooperative garrison, led by a deputy commander at the prefectural seat, mustered 432 troops and five fast display boats.

sentences.zh: 海鹽汛兵一百七十五人，快唬船三艘。

translations.literal: Haiyan post one hundred seventy-five soldiers, three fast display boats.
translations.idiomatic: Haiyan station: 175 men and three fast display boats.

sentences.zh: 乍浦汛兵二百十三人，快唬船二艘。

translations.literal: Zhapu post two hundred thirteen soldiers, two fast display boats.
translations.idiomatic: Zhapu station: 213 men and two fast display boats.

sentences.zh: 澉浦汛兵百人，快唬船一艘。

translations.literal: Kanpu post one hundred soldiers, one fast display boat.
translations.idiomatic: Kanpu station: 100 men and one fast display boat.

sentences.zh: 石門汛兵一百十人，快唬船四艘。

translations.literal: Shimen post one hundred ten soldiers, four fast display boats.
translations.idiomatic: Shimen station: 110 men and four fast display boats.

sentences.zh: 桐鄉汛兵七十六人，快唬船二艘。

translations.literal: Tongxiang post seventy-six soldiers, two fast display boats.
translations.idiomatic: Tongxiang station: 76 men and two fast display boats.

sentences.zh: 濮院汛兵六十一人，快唬船三艘。

translations.literal: Puyuan post sixty-one soldiers, three fast display boats.
translations.idiomatic: Puyuan station: 61 men and three fast display boats.

sentences.zh: 新城汛兵四十人，快唬船一艘。

translations.literal: Xincheng post forty soldiers, one fast display boat.
translations.idiomatic: Xincheng station: 40 men and one fast display boat.

sentences.zh: 平湖汛兵九十九人，快唬船三艘。

translations.literal: Pinghu post ninety-nine soldiers, three fast display boats.
translations.idiomatic: Pinghu station: 99 men and three fast display boats.

sentences.zh: 嘉善汛兵七十人，快唬船二艘。

translations.literal: Jiashan post seventy soldiers, two fast display boats.
translations.idiomatic: Jiashan station: 70 men and two fast display boats.

sentences.zh: 嘉興汛兵六十九人，快唬船二艘。

translations.literal: Jiaxing post sixty-nine soldiers, two fast display boats.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaxing station: 69 men and two fast display boats.

sentences.zh: 王江涇汛兵五十六人，快唬船二艘。

translations.literal: Wangjiangjing post fifty-six soldiers, two fast display boats.
translations.idiomatic: Wangjiangjing station: 56 men and two fast display boats.

sentences.zh: 雍正十年，裁撤快唬船二十艘，改造大號巡船二十艘，小號巡船二十艘，分配各汛。

translations.literal: Yongzheng 10: abolished twenty fast display boats, converted to twenty large patrol boats, twenty small patrol boats, distributed among posts.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 10 twenty fast display boats were scrapped and rebuilt as twenty large and twenty small patrol craft, then parcelled out among the stations.

sentences.zh: 湖州協營，設副將各官，駐防府城，兵四百七十六人，快巡船十三艘。

translations.literal: Huzhou cooperative camp: deputy commander and officers, garrisoned at prefectural city, four hundred seventy-six soldiers, thirteen fast patrol boats.
translations.idiomatic: The Huzhou cooperative garrison, led by a deputy commander at the prefectural seat, mustered 476 troops and thirteen fast patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 左營分防雙林汛兵五十人，快巡船三艘，德清汛兵三十四人，快巡船四艘，新市汛兵四十二人，快巡船四艘，含山汛兵四十二人，快巡船四艘，菱湖汛兵三十九人，快巡船五艘。

translations.literal: Left camp divided defense: Shuanglin post fifty soldiers, three fast patrol boats; Deqing post thirty-four soldiers, four fast patrol boats; Xinshi post forty-two soldiers, four fast patrol boats; Hanshan post forty-two soldiers, four fast patrol boats; Linghu post thirty-nine soldiers, five fast patrol boats.
translations.idiomatic: The left wing posted: Shuanglin, 50 men and three fast patrol craft; Deqing, 34 and four; Xinshi, 42 and four; Hanshan, 42 and four; Linghu, 39 and five.

sentences.zh: 右營分防泗安汛兵五十人，快巡船三艘。

translations.literal: Right camp divided defense: Si'an post fifty soldiers, three fast patrol boats.
translations.idiomatic: The right wing held Si'an with 50 men and three fast patrol craft.

sentences.zh: 長興汛兵四十四人，快巡船二艘。

translations.literal: Changxing post forty-four soldiers, two fast patrol boats.
translations.idiomatic: Changxing station: 44 men and two fast patrol craft.

sentences.zh: 武康汛兵二十人，快巡船一艘。

translations.literal: Wukang post twenty soldiers, one fast patrol boat.
translations.idiomatic: Wukang station: 20 men and one fast patrol craft.

sentences.zh: 馬要汛兵二十人，快巡船一艘。

translations.literal: Mayao post twenty soldiers, one fast patrol boat.
translations.idiomatic: Mayao station: 20 men and one fast patrol craft.

sentences.zh: 烏鎮汛兵二十四人，快巡船一艘。

translations.literal: Wuzhen post twenty-four soldiers, one fast patrol boat.
translations.idiomatic: Wuzhen station: 24 men and one fast patrol craft.

sentences.zh: 南潯汛兵五十八人，快巡船六艘。

translations.literal: Nanxun post fifty-eight soldiers, six fast patrol boats.
translations.idiomatic: Nanxun station: 58 men and six fast patrol craft.

sentences.zh: 菁山汛兵十六人，快巡船一艘。

translations.literal: Jingshan post sixteen soldiers, one fast patrol boat.
translations.idiomatic: Jingshan station: 16 men and one fast patrol craft.

sentences.zh: 梅溪汛兵八十人，快巡船二艘。

translations.literal: Meixi post eighty soldiers, two fast patrol boats.
translations.idiomatic: Meixi station: 80 men and two fast patrol craft.

sentences.zh: 紹興協營，設副將各官，水師一千八百七十二人，用衛所之制，設臨海、觀海二衛，瀝海、三江二所。

translations.literal: Shaoxing cooperative camp: deputy commander and officers, navy one thousand eight hundred seventy-two men, using guard-post system, established Linhai and Guanhai two guards, Lihai and Sanjiang two posts.
translations.idiomatic: The Shaoxing cooperative garrison, led by a deputy commander, numbered 1,872 sailors organized on the Ming guard-post model: the Linhai and Guanhai guards and the Lihai and Sanjiang posts.

sentences.zh: 雍正十年，設周家路水師汛，置紹字一、二號巡船二艘。

translations.literal: Yongzheng 10: established Zhoujialu naval post, placed Shao-character numbers one and two patrol boats two.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 10 the Zhoujialu naval station was opened with two patrol boats, Shao No. 1 and Shao No. 2.

sentences.zh: 寧波府，順治三年，設水師營參將二人，分左右二營，水戰兵四百人，守兵四百人。

translations.literal: Ningbo prefecture: Shunzhi 3, established two naval-camp regimental commanders, divided left and right two camps, combat sailors four hundred, garrison soldiers four hundred.
translations.idiomatic: At Ningbo prefecture, Shunzhi 3 (1646), two regimental commanders were appointed over left and right naval camps, mustering 400 combat sailors and 400 garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 十四年，設寧台溫水師總兵官及以下各官。

translations.literal: Year 14: established Ning-Tai-Wen naval commander and lower officers.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 14 a commander was placed over the Ningbo, Taizhou, and Wenzhou naval forces with subordinates below.

sentences.zh: 康熙九年，設水師提督及左右二路總兵官，七年罷之。

translations.literal: Kangxi 9: established naval regional commander and left-right two-route commanders; abolished seven years later.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 9 (1670) a naval regional commander and wing commanders were appointed; seven years later the post was abolished.

sentences.zh: 設總兵官一人，轄中左右水師三營，兵三千人。

translations.literal: Established one commander, commanding center-left-right naval three camps, three thousand soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: A single commander was then appointed over center, left, and right naval camps totaling three thousand men.

sentences.zh: 春秋二汛，率戰船出洋巡緝。

translations.literal: Spring and autumn two seasons, leading war boats out to sea to patrol and suppress.
translations.idiomatic: Each spring and autumn season he led the warships to sea for patrol and pursuit.

sentences.zh: 其戰船之數，隨時增改。

translations.literal: Its war-boat count, increased and changed according to the times.
translations.idiomatic: The number of warships in service was adjusted from time to time as needs changed.

sentences.zh: 順治三年，水師左右二營，大小戰船五十二艘。

translations.literal: Shunzhi 3, naval left and right two camps, large and small war boats fifty-two.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 3 (1646) the left and right naval camps together mustered fifty-two large and small warships.

sentences.zh: 九年，定海鎮左右二營，戰船四十九艘。

translations.literal: Year 9, Dinghai brigade left and right two camps, war boats forty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 9 the left and right camps of the Dinghai brigade held forty-nine warships.

sentences.zh: 十四年，水師左右前後四營，戰船二百二艘。

translations.literal: Year 14, naval left-right-front-rear four camps, war boats two hundred two.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 14 four naval camps—left, right, front, and rear—fielded 202 warships.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，水師前左右三營，戰船一百七十三艘。

translations.literal: Kangxi 1, naval front-left-right three camps, war boats one hundred seventy-three.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 1 (1662) the front, left, and right naval camps numbered 173 warships.

sentences.zh: 九年，定海鎮中左右三營，戰船八十艘，增設哨船二十艘。

translations.literal: Year 9, Dinghai brigade center-left-right three camps, war boats eighty, added patrol boats twenty.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 9 the Dinghai brigade's center, left, and right camps had eighty warships, with twenty patrol craft added.

sentences.zh: 歷年裁汰，定為水艍船十二艘，犁繒船七號水艘中艍船一艘，中號犁繒船五艘，沙船七艘，雙篷艍船十三艘，唬船二艘，哨船二十艘。

translations.literal: Over the years cut and reduced, fixed as armed junks twelve, li-zeng boats seven, numbered water craft medium armed junk one, medium li-zeng boats five, sand junks seven, double-sail armed junks thirteen, display boats two, patrol boats twenty.
translations.idiomatic: After successive reductions the fleet was fixed at twelve armed junks, seven li-zeng boats, one medium armed junk among the numbered water vessels, five medium li-zeng boats, seven sand junks, thirteen double-sail armed junks, two display boats, and twenty patrol craft.

sentences.zh: 象山城守營，設副將各官，哨船四艘，海口汛兵一百五十人，哨船十艘。

translations.literal: Xiangshan city-defense camp, established deputy commander and officers, patrol boats four, estuary post soldiers one hundred fifty, patrol boats ten.
translations.idiomatic: The Xiangshan city-defense garrison, led by a deputy commander, kept four patrol boats; the estuary station had 150 men and ten patrol craft.

sentences.zh: 雍正四年，裁存四艘。

translations.literal: Yongzheng 4, cut and retained four.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 4 (1726) only four boats were kept after reductions.

sentences.zh: 昌石營，設都司等官，汛兵五百六十五人，戰船六艘。

translations.literal: Changshi camp, established battalion commander and other officers, post soldiers five hundred sixty-five, war boats six.
translations.idiomatic: Changshi garrison, under a battalion commander, mustered 565 post troops and six warships.

sentences.zh: 鎮海營，原設定海水師左右二營。

translations.literal: Zhenhai camp, originally established Dinghai naval left and right two camps.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenhai garrison had originally been organized as the left and right camps of the Dinghai naval force.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年，改設鎮海營參將各官，汛兵二百三十五人，哨船八艘。

translations.literal: Yongzheng 2, changed to establish Zhenhai camp regimental commander and officers, post soldiers two hundred thirty-five, patrol boats eight.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 2 it was reorganized as the Zhenhai garrison under a regimental commander, with 235 post troops and eight patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 台州府，順治十四年，設寧台總鎮。

translations.literal: Taizhou prefecture, Shunzhi 14, established Ning-Tai overall brigade commander.
translations.idiomatic: At Taizhou prefecture, Shunzhi 14 (1657), a commander was appointed over the Ningbo-Taizhou district.

sentences.zh: 十五年，改水師提督。

translations.literal: Year 15, changed to naval regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the post was raised to naval regional commander.

sentences.zh: 尋改總兵。

translations.literal: Soon changed to brigade commander.
translations.idiomatic: It was soon reduced again to brigade commander.

sentences.zh: 設黃岩鎮標三營，水師二千七百七十五人，戰哨船二十五艘。

translations.literal: Established Huangyan brigade banner three camps, navy two thousand seven hundred seventy-five men, war and patrol boats twenty-five.
translations.idiomatic: The Huangyan brigade banner was organized in three camps with 2,775 sailors and twenty-five war and patrol craft.

sentences.zh: 海門駐游擊等官。

translations.literal: Haimen stationed mobile brigade commander and other officers.
translations.idiomatic: A mobile brigade commander was posted at Haimen.

sentences.zh: 前所駐都司等官。

translations.literal: Qiansuo stationed battalion commander and other officers.
translations.idiomatic: A battalion commander was posted at Qiansuo.

sentences.zh: 右營分防海洋七汛：玉環山、干江、雞齊山、標桃嶼、石塘、龍王堂、沙護。

translations.literal: Right camp divided defense of open sea seven posts: Yuhuanshan, Ganjiang, Jiqishan, Biaotaoyu, Shitang, Longwangtang, Shahu.
translations.idiomatic: The right camp patrolled seven open-sea stations: Yuhuanshan, Ganjiang, Jiqishan, Biaotaoyu, Shitang, Longwangtang, and Shahu.

sentences.zh: 中營分防海洋六汛：郎幾山、黃礁門、深門、三山、老鼠嶼、川礁。

translations.literal: Center camp divided defense of open sea six posts: Langjishan, Huangjiaomen, Shenmen, Sanshan, Laoshuyu, Chuanjiao.
translations.idiomatic: The center camp covered six open-sea stations: Langjishan, Huangjiaomen, Shenmen, Sanshan, Laoshuyu, and Chuanjiao.

sentences.zh: 左營分防海洋八汛：聖堂門、米篩門、白岱門、牛頭門、靖寇門、狗頭門山、茶盤山、迷江山。

translations.literal: Left camp divided defense of open sea eight posts: Shengtangmen, Mishaimen, Baidaimen, Niutoumen, Jingkoumen, Goutoumenshan, Chapanshan, Mijiangshan.
translations.idiomatic: The left camp guarded eight open-sea stations: Shengtangmen, Mishaimen, Baidaimen, Niutoumen, Jingkoumen, Goutoumenshan, Chapanshan, and Mijiangshan.

sentences.zh: 溫州府，順治三年，設副將各官。

translations.literal: Wenzhou prefecture, Shunzhi 3, established deputy commander and officers.
translations.idiomatic: At Wenzhou prefecture, Shunzhi 3, a deputy commander was appointed with subordinates.

sentences.zh: 十三年，改總兵官，設鎮標中左右水師三營，戰哨船二十二艘。

translations.literal: Year 13, changed to brigade commander, established brigade banner center-left-right naval three camps, war and patrol boats twenty-two.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 13 the post became brigade commander; the brigade banner's center, left, and right naval camps fielded twenty-two war and patrol craft.

sentences.zh: 中營水戰兵六十五人，守兵一百五十二人，戰船九艘，快哨船二艘，釣船三艘。

translations.literal: Center camp combat sailors sixty-five, garrison soldiers one hundred fifty-two, war boats nine, fast patrol boats two, fishing boats three.
translations.idiomatic: The center camp had 65 combat sailors and 152 garrison troops, with nine warships, two fast patrol boats, and three fishing craft.

sentences.zh: 分巡二處：一專防三盤口，水師百六十二人，戰船二艘；

translations.literal: Divided patrol two places: one specially defending Sanpankou, navy one hundred sixty-two men, war boats two.
translations.idiomatic: Patrol was split between two sectors: one devoted to Sanpankou with 162 sailors and two warships;

sentences.zh: 一專防長沙海洋，水師一百二十八人，沙戰船二艘。

translations.literal: One specially defending Changsha open sea, navy one hundred twenty-eight men, sand war boats two.
translations.idiomatic: the other to the Changsha open sea with 128 sailors and two sand-hulled warships.

sentences.zh: 分防汛地凡七：曰霓嶴、黃大嶴、三盤、大門、長沙、鹿西、雙排。

translations.literal: Divided defense post places in all seven: namely Ni'ao, Huangda'ao, Sanpan, Damen, Changsha, Luxi, Shuangpai.
translations.idiomatic: Seven garrison posts were assigned: Ni'ao, Huangda'ao, Sanpan, Damen, Changsha, Luxi, and Shuangpai.

sentences.zh: 左營水戰兵六十八人，守兵一百七十三人，戰船九艘，快哨船二艘。

translations.literal: Left camp combat sailors sixty-eight, garrison soldiers one hundred seventy-three, war boats nine, fast patrol boats two.
translations.idiomatic: The left camp mustered 68 combat sailors and 173 garrison troops, with nine warships and two fast patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 分巡二處：一專防鳳山汛，一專防南龍海洋。

translations.literal: Divided patrol two places: one specially defending Fengshan post, one specially defending Nanlong open sea.
translations.idiomatic: Patrol was divided between Fengshan station and the Nanlong open sea.

sentences.zh: 分防汛地凡五：曰鳳皇山、銅盤山、南龍山、大瞿山、白腦門。

translations.literal: Divided defense post places in all five: namely Fenghuangshan, Tongpanshan, Nanlongshan, Daqushan, Bainaomen.
translations.idiomatic: Five garrison posts were assigned: Fenghuangshan, Tongpanshan, Nanlongshan, Daqushan, and Bainaomen.

sentences.zh: 右營轄陸地汛兵。

translations.literal: Right camp commanded land post soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The right camp oversaw land-based garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 瑞安水師營，設副將各官，水戰兵九十八人，守兵一百四十三人，內洋巡哨戰船四艘，外洋巡哨戰船五艘，快哨船四艘，釣船二艘。

translations.literal: Ruian naval camp, established deputy commander and officers, combat sailors ninety-eight, garrison soldiers one hundred forty-three, inner-sea patrol war boats four, outer-sea patrol war boats five, fast patrol boats four, fishing boats two.
translations.idiomatic: The Ruian naval garrison, under a deputy commander, had 98 combat sailors and 143 garrison troops, with four inner-sea and five outer-sea patrol warships, four fast patrol boats, and two fishing craft.

sentences.zh: 分巡二處：一專防北關洋，水師七十人，戰船一艘；

translations.literal: Divided patrol two places: one specially defending Beiguan sea, navy seventy men, war boat one.
translations.idiomatic: Patrol was split: one detachment guarded the Beiguan sea with 70 sailors and one warship;

sentences.zh: 一專防官山洋，水師五十人，戰船一艘。

translations.literal: One specially defending Guanshan sea, navy fifty men, war boat one.
translations.idiomatic: another guarded the Guanshan sea with 50 sailors and one warship.

sentences.zh: 分防汛地凡六：曰北關、官山、金鄉嶴、琵琶山、南鹿山、四大嶼。

translations.literal: Divided defense post places in all six: namely Beiguan, Guanshan, Jinxiang'ao, Pipashan, Nanlushan, Sida'yu.
translations.idiomatic: Six garrison posts were assigned: Beiguan, Guanshan, Jinxiang'ao, Pipashan, Nanlushan, and Sida'yu.

sentences.zh: 玉環水師營，設參將等官，水戰兵一百四十五人，守兵二百五十四人，八槳船四艘，戰船四艘，快哨船四艘。

translations.literal: Yuhuan naval camp, established regimental commander and other officers, combat sailors one hundred forty-five, garrison soldiers two hundred fifty-four, eight-oar boats four, war boats four, fast patrol boats four.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuhuan naval garrison, under a regimental commander, fielded 145 combat sailors and 254 garrison troops, with four eight-oar boats, four warships, and four fast patrol craft.

sentences.zh: 左營轄陸地汛兵。

translations.literal: Left camp commanded land post soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The left camp oversaw land-based garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 右營水師一百八十四人，戰船四艘。

translations.literal: Right camp navy one hundred eighty-four men, war boats four.
translations.idiomatic: The right camp mustered 184 sailors and four warships.

sentences.zh: 分巡二處：一專防坎門，水師六十五人，戰船一艘；

translations.literal: Divided patrol two places: one specially defending Kanmen, navy sixty-five men, war boat one.
translations.idiomatic: Patrol was divided: one detachment guarded Kanmen with 65 sailors and one warship;

sentences.zh: 一專防長嶼，水師三十四人，戰船一艘。

translations.literal: One specially defending Changyu, navy thirty-four men, war boat one.
translations.idiomatic: another guarded Changyu with 34 sailors and one warship.

sentences.zh: 內洋凡三汛：曰烏洋、梁灣、黃門。

translations.literal: Inner sea in all three posts: namely Wuyang, Liangwan, Huangmen.
translations.idiomatic: Three inner-sea stations were assigned: Wuyang, Liangwan, and Huangmen.

sentences.zh: 外洋一汛，曰沙頭。

translations.literal: Outer sea one post, namely Shatou.
translations.idiomatic: One outer-sea station, Shatou, completed the line.

sentences.zh: 左右營率水師一百八十四人，戰船一艘，輪巡洋面。

translations.literal: Left and right camps leading navy one hundred eighty-four men, war boat one, rotating patrol of sea surface.
translations.idiomatic: The left and right camps together put 184 sailors and one warship on rotation to patrol the open waters.

sentences.zh: 又江口水師一百八十四人，戰船四艘。

translations.literal: Also estuary navy one hundred eighty-four men, war boats four.
translations.idiomatic: The estuary detachment added 184 sailors and four warships.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年，額定四種戰船：曰水艍船，曰趕繒船，曰雙篷船，曰快哨船。

translations.literal: Yongzheng 2, quota fixed four kinds of war boats: namely armed junk, pursuit junk, double-sail boat, fast patrol boat.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 2 four types of warship were fixed by regulation: the armed junk, pursuit junk, double-sail boat, and fast patrol craft.

sentences.zh: 其六槳船、八槳船，雍正七年後所增設也。

translations.literal: Its six-oar boats and eight-oar boats, after Yongzheng 7 newly added establishments.
translations.idiomatic: Six-oar and eight-oar boats were added after Yongzheng 7.

sentences.zh: 福建水師，順治十三年，始設福建水師三千人，唬船、哨船、趕繒船、雙篷船百餘艘。

translations.literal: Fujian navy, Shunzhi 13, first established Fujian navy three thousand men, display boats, patrol boats, pursuit junks, double-sail boats more than one hundred.
translations.idiomatic: The Fujian naval force, established in Shunzhi 13 (1656), initially mustered 3,000 men and more than a hundred display boats, patrol craft, pursuit junks, and double-sail vessels.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十四年，裁撤雙篷船八十艘，以二十艘分防颱灣及澎湖島。

translations.literal: Kangxi 24, cut and removed double-sail boats eighty, using twenty to divide defense of Taiwan and Penghu Island.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 24 (1685) eighty double-sail boats were struck from the rolls; twenty were retained to patrol Taiwan and the Penghu Islands.

sentences.zh: 雍正三年，於福州、漳州、台灣三處各設船廠，製造外海內河大小戰船。

translations.literal: Yongzheng 3, at Fuzhou, Zhangzhou, Taiwan three places each established shipyards, manufacturing outer-sea and inner-river large and small war boats.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 3 shipyards were opened at Fuzhou, Zhangzhou, and Taiwan to build large and small warships for open sea and inland waters.

sentences.zh: 七年，設泉州船廠，修造各提、鎮、協標水師戰船。

translations.literal: Year 7, established Quanzhou shipyard, repairing and building each regional, brigade, and cooperative banner naval war boats.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 7 a Quanzhou yard was added to repair and build warships for every regional, brigade, and cooperative naval command.

sentences.zh: 福州船廠承修四十六艘。

translations.literal: Fuzhou shipyard undertook repair of forty-six.
translations.idiomatic: The Fuzhou yard was responsible for forty-six vessels.

sentences.zh: 泉州船廠承修四十八艘。

translations.literal: Quanzhou shipyard undertook repair of forty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: The Quanzhou yard handled forty-eight.

sentences.zh: 漳州船廠承修五十二艘。

translations.literal: Zhangzhou shipyard undertook repair of fifty-two.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhangzhou yard maintained fifty-two.

sentences.zh: 台灣船廠承修九十六艘。

translations.literal: Taiwan shipyard undertook repair of ninety-six.
translations.idiomatic: The Taiwan yard serviced ninety-six.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十六年，令三江口戰船按季燂洗。

translations.literal: Qianlong 16, ordered Sanjiangkou war boats seasonally scraped and washed.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 16 warships at Sanjiangkou were ordered scraped and cleaned each season.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，裁撤哨船五十艘。

translations.literal: Year 33, cut and removed patrol boats fifty.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 33 fifty patrol boats were decommissioned.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年，令戰船悉改同安船式。

translations.literal: Jiaqing 4, ordered war boats all changed to Tong'an boat style.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 4 all warships were ordered converted to the Tong'an model.

sentences.zh: 五年，裁撤內地額設戰船三十艘，增造米艇船三十艘，編為勝字號。

translations.literal: Year 5, cut and removed inland quota war boats thirty, increased building rice-carrying boats thirty, organized as Sheng character numbers.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 5 thirty inland warships were struck and thirty rice barges were built, registered under the Sheng series.

sentences.zh: 七年，以福寧府陸路鎮標左營改為水師左營，駐三沙海口，編新字號戰船十二艘。

translations.literal: Year 7, using Funing prefecture land-route brigade banner left camp changed to naval left camp, stationed at Sansha estuary, organized New character number war boats twelve.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 7 the left camp of the Funing land brigade became a naval left camp at Sansha estuary, with twelve warships registered under the Xin series.

sentences.zh: 十年，增台灣水師同安梭船三十艘，編為善字號，分設台灣協標中左右三營。

translations.literal: Year 10, increased Taiwan navy Tong'an shuttle boats thirty, organized as Shan character numbers, divided establishment of Taiwan cooperative banner center-left-right three camps.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 10 thirty Tong'an shuttle boats were added for the Taiwan navy under the Shan series, and the Taiwan cooperative banner was split into center, left, and right camps.

sentences.zh: 十一年，增米艇八艘，編為捷字號，又增大橫洋梭船二十艘，分編為集字號十艘，成字號十艘，分防內地。

translations.literal: Year 11, increased rice boats eight, organized as Jie character numbers, also increased large horizontal-ocean shuttle boats twenty, divided organization as Ji character numbers ten, Cheng character numbers ten, divided defense of inland.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 11 eight rice barges were added under the Jie series, and twenty large ocean-going shuttle boats were split into ten Ji-series and ten Cheng-series craft for inland defense.

sentences.zh: 十三年，裁撤中號、小號梭船十七艘。

translations.literal: Year 13, cut and removed medium-number and small-number shuttle boats seventeen.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 13 seventeen medium and small shuttle boats were decommissioned.

sentences.zh: 十四年，增集字號、成字號大同安梭船二十艘，捷字號米艇八艘。

translations.literal: Year 14, increased Ji and Cheng character numbers large Tong'an shuttle boats twenty, Jie character number rice boats eight.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 14 twenty large Tong'an shuttle boats were added to the Ji and Cheng series, and eight Jie-series rice barges.

sentences.zh: 十五年，裁撤台灣港口善字號船二十一艘，於鹿耳門增守港師船十六艘，編為知字號，增八槳快船十六艘，編為方字號。

translations.literal: Year 15, cut and removed Taiwan harbor Shan character number boats twenty-one, at Lu'ermen increased harbor-guard command boats sixteen, organized as Zhi character numbers, increased eight-oar fast boats sixteen, organized as Fang character numbers.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 15 twenty-one Shan-series boats were removed from Taiwan harbor; sixteen harbor-guard command craft were added at Lu'ermen under the Zhi series, and sixteen fast eight-oar boats under the Fang series.

sentences.zh: 十六年，裁撤各營中號、小號梭船三十七艘。

translations.literal: Year 16, cut and removed each camp medium-number and small-number shuttle boats thirty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 16 thirty-seven medium and small shuttle boats were struck from the various camps.

sentences.zh: 道光二年，裁撤捷字號米艇、勝字號米艇共十五艘，餘改為一、二、三號同安梭船之式。

translations.literal: Daoguang 2, cut and removed Jie character number rice boats and Sheng character number rice boats in all fifteen, remainder changed to No. 1, 2, 3 Tong'an shuttle boat style.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 2 fifteen Jie- and Sheng-series rice barges were decommissioned; the rest were rebuilt to the No. 1, 2, and 3 Tong'an shuttle-boat patterns.

sentences.zh: 七年，裁撤台灣水師營知字號、方字號船共三十二艘，善字號船九艘，別造白底艍船三十二艘，編為順字號十六艘，濟字號十六艘，分撥台灣協標中左右三營，澎湖協標艋舺營。

translations.literal: Year 7, cut and removed Taiwan naval camp Zhi and Fang character number boats in all thirty-two, Shan character number boats nine, separately built white-bottom armed junks thirty-two, organized as Shun character numbers sixteen, Ji character numbers sixteen, divided and allotted to Taiwan cooperative banner center-left-right three camps, Penghu cooperative banner Mengjia camp.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 7 thirty-two Zhi- and Fang-series boats and nine Shan-series boats were struck from the Taiwan naval command; thirty-two white-bottom armed junks were built as sixteen Shun-series and sixteen Ji-series vessels and distributed to the Taiwan cooperative banner's three camps and the Penghu cooperative banner's Mengjia garrison.

sentences.zh: 其外海戰船名號凡十類：曰趕繒船，曰雙篷艍船，曰雙篷船，曰平底哨船，曰圓底雙篷船，曰白艕船，曰哨船，曰平底船，曰雙篷哨船，曰平底船。

translations.literal: Its outer-sea war boat names in all ten categories: namely pursuit junk, double-sail armed junk, double-sail boat, flat-bottom patrol boat, round-bottom double-sail boat, white fu boat, patrol boat, flat-bottom boat, double-sail patrol boat, flat-bottom boat.
translations.idiomatic: Open-sea warships fell into ten registered types: pursuit junk, double-sail armed junk, double-sail boat, flat-bottom patrol craft, round-bottom double-sail boat, white fu boat, patrol boat, flat-bottom boat, double-sail patrol boat, and flat-bottom boat.

sentences.zh: 內河戰船名號凡九類：曰八槳船，曰六槳平底小巡船，曰花駕座船，曰八槳哨船，曰小八槳船，曰中八槳船，曰大八槳船，曰花官座船，曰哨艍船。

translations.literal: Inner-river war boat names in all nine categories: namely eight-oar boat, six-oar flat-bottom small patrol boat, decorated command boat, eight-oar patrol boat, small eight-oar boat, medium eight-oar boat, large eight-oar boat, decorated official command boat, patrol armed junk.
translations.idiomatic: Inland warships were classified in nine types: eight-oar boat, six-oar flat-bottom patrol skiff, decorated command boat, eight-oar patrol boat, small, medium, and large eight-oar boats, decorated official command boat, and patrol armed junk.

sentences.zh: 各船水師多寡之數，以船之大小為衡。

translations.literal: Each boat's navy more-or-less count, using boat's size as measure.
translations.idiomatic: The complement assigned to each vessel depended on its size.

sentences.zh: 提督標分中、左、右、前、後五營，中營戰船九艘，左營八艘，右營八艘，前營十艘，後營十艘。

translations.literal: Regional commander's banner divided into center, left, right, front, rear five camps, center camp war boats nine, left camp eight, right camp eight, front camp ten, rear camp ten.
translations.idiomatic: The regional commander's banner was split into center, left, right, front, and rear camps with nine, eight, eight, ten, and ten warships respectively.

sentences.zh: 總督標水師左營戰船二艘。

translations.literal: Governor's banner naval left camp war boats two.
translations.idiomatic: The governor's banner naval left camp kept two warships.

sentences.zh: 金門協標後改鎮標，左營戰船九艘，右營九艘，改鎮標後，增戰船二艘。

translations.literal: Kinmen cooperative banner later changed to brigade banner, left camp war boats nine, right camp nine, after changing to brigade banner, increased war boats two.
translations.idiomatic: The Kinmen cooperative banner, later raised to a brigade banner, had nine warships in each wing; two more were added after the upgrade.

sentences.zh: 海壇協標後改鎮標，左營戰船十艘，右營八艘。

translations.literal: Haitan cooperative banner later changed to brigade banner, left camp war boats ten, right camp eight.
translations.idiomatic: The Haitan cooperative banner, likewise raised to brigade status, fielded ten warships in the left camp and eight in the right.

sentences.zh: 閩安協標左營戰船七艘，右營七艘。

translations.literal: Min'an cooperative banner left camp war boats seven, right camp seven.
translations.idiomatic: The Min'an cooperative banner had seven warships in each camp.

sentences.zh: 福寧鎮標左營戰船十艘。

translations.literal: Funing brigade banner left camp war boats ten.
translations.idiomatic: The Funing brigade banner's left camp kept ten warships.

sentences.zh: 烽火營戰船十一艘。

translations.literal: Fenghuo camp war boats eleven.
translations.idiomatic: Fenghuo garrison maintained eleven warships.

sentences.zh: 南澳鎮標戰船十艘。

translations.literal: Nan'ao brigade banner war boats ten.
translations.idiomatic: The Nan'ao brigade banner had ten warships.

sentences.zh: 銅山營戰船十一艘。

translations.literal: Tongshan camp war boats eleven.
translations.idiomatic: Tongshan garrison fielded eleven warships.

sentences.zh: 台灣協標中營戰船十九艘，左營十四艘，右營十六艘。

translations.literal: Taiwan cooperative banner center camp war boats nineteen, left camp fourteen, right camp sixteen.
translations.idiomatic: The Taiwan cooperative banner mustered nineteen warships in the center camp, fourteen in the left, and sixteen in the right.

sentences.zh: 澎湖協標左營戰十七艘，右營十六艘，艋舺營十四艘。

translations.literal: Penghu cooperative banner left camp war seventeen, right camp sixteen, Mengjia camp fourteen.
translations.idiomatic: The Penghu cooperative banner had seventeen warships in the left camp, sixteen in the right, and fourteen at the Mengjia garrison.

sentences.zh: 廣東水師，自順治九年設官弁千人，嗣設總督標水師，駐肇慶府，分為中、左、右、前、後五營。

translations.literal: Guangdong navy, from Shunzhi 9 established officers one thousand men, thereafter established governor's banner navy, stationed at Zhaoqing prefecture, divided into center, left, right, front, rear five camps.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangdong naval force, first mustered in Shunzhi 9 with a thousand officers and men, later gained a governor's-banner fleet based at Zhaoqing and organized into center, left, right, front, and rear camps.

sentences.zh: 中營二櫓槳船一艘，急跳船一艘。

translations.literal: Center camp two-scull oared boats one, rapid-leap boats one.
translations.idiomatic: The center camp had one two-scull oared boat and one rapid-leap craft.

sentences.zh: 左營槳船二艘，急跳船一艘，舢板船三艘。

translations.literal: Left camp oared boats two, rapid-leap boats one, sampan boats three.
translations.idiomatic: The left camp kept two oared boats, one rapid-leap craft, and three sampans.

sentences.zh: 右營槳船二艘，急跳船二艘。

translations.literal: Right camp oared boats two, rapid-leap boats two.
translations.idiomatic: The right camp had two oared boats and two rapid-leap craft.

sentences.zh: 前營急跳船二艘，舢板船四艘。

translations.literal: Front camp rapid-leap boats two, sampan boats four.
translations.idiomatic: The front camp fielded two rapid-leap boats and four sampans.

sentences.zh: 後營槳船一艘，急跳船一艘，舢板船三艘。

translations.literal: Rear camp oared boats one, rapid-leap boats one, sampan boats three.
translations.idiomatic: The rear camp had one oared boat, one rapid-leap craft, and three sampans.

sentences.zh: 水師營二櫓槳船十四艘，四櫓槳船六艘，急跳船六艘。

translations.literal: Naval camp two-scull oared boats fourteen, four-scull oared boats six, rapid-leap boats six.
translations.idiomatic: The naval garrison added fourteen two-scull oared boats, six four-scull oared boats, and six rapid-leap craft.

sentences.zh: 四會營四字號槳船三艘。

translations.literal: Sihui camp Si character number oared boats three.
translations.idiomatic: Sihui garrison kept three oared boats of the Si series.

sentences.zh: 新會營急跳船一艘，急跳槳船一艘，小舢板船二艘。

translations.literal: Xinhui camp rapid-leap boats one, rapid-leap oared boats one, small sampan boats two.
translations.idiomatic: Xinhui garrison had one rapid-leap boat, one rapid-leap oared craft, and two small sampans.

sentences.zh: 後改肇慶城守協標，轄左右營、四會營、那扶營、永安營。

translations.literal: Later changed to Zhaoqing city-defense cooperative banner, commanding left-right camps, Sihui camp, Nafu camp, Yong'an camp.
translations.idiomatic: It was later reorganized as the Zhaoqing city-defense cooperative banner, overseeing the left and right camps plus the Sihui, Nafu, and Yong'an garrisons.

sentences.zh: 以新會營改隸提標水師之順德協。

translations.literal: Using Xinhui camp changed to subordinate to regional banner navy's Shunde cooperative.
translations.idiomatic: The Xinhui garrison was transferred to the Shunde cooperative under the regional naval command.

sentences.zh: 巡撫標轄水師左右營、廣州協左右營、三水營、前山營、順德協左右營、新會左右營、增城左右營、大鵬營、永靖營。

translations.literal: Governor-general's banner commanded naval left-right camps, Guangzhou cooperative left-right camps, Sanshui camp, Qianshan camp, Shunde cooperative left-right camps, Xinhui left-right camps, Zengcheng left-right camps, Dapeng camp, Yongjing camp.
translations.idiomatic: The governor-general's banner oversaw the naval left and right camps, the Guangzhou cooperative's two wings, and the Sanshui, Qianshan, Shunde cooperative, Xinhui, Zengcheng, Dapeng, and Yongjing garrisons.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十九年，裁廣東巡撫，以各營分隸提督標及廣州城守協。

translations.literal: Guangxu 29, abolished Guangdong governor-general, using each camp divided to subordinate to regional commander's banner and Guangzhou city-defense cooperative.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 29 (1903) the Guangdong governorship was abolished and its garrisons were reassigned to the regional commander's banner and the Guangzhou city-defense cooperative.

sentences.zh: 水師提督標，康熙元年設，駐惠州府，轄四營。

translations.literal: Naval regional commander's banner, Kangxi 1 established, stationed at Huizhou prefecture, commanding four camps.
translations.idiomatic: The naval regional commander's banner, established in Kangxi 1, was based at Huizhou and commanded four camps.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶後移駐虎門，分中、左、右、前、後五營，香山協左右營，順德協左右營，新會左右營，大鵬左右營，赤溪協左右營，清遠右營，廣海寨營，永靖營。

translations.literal: After Jiaqing moved station to Humen, divided center-left-right-front-rear five camps, Xiangshan cooperative left-right camps, Shunde cooperative left-right camps, Xinhui left-right camps, Dapeng left-right camps, Chixi cooperative left-right camps, Qingyuan right camp, Guanghai stockade camp, Yongjing camp.
translations.idiomatic: After the Jiaqing reign it moved to Humen, with center, left, right, front, and rear camps plus the Xiangshan, Shunde, Xinhui, Dapeng, and Chixi cooperatives, the Qingyuan right camp, Guanghai stockade, and Yongjing garrison.

sentences.zh: 凡六櫓船十一艘，八櫓船四艘，十櫓船二艘，十二櫓船二艘，米艇十一艘，撈繒船六艘，快槳船二十七艘，淺水槳船十二艘，巡船十四艘，二櫓船六艘，四櫓船十二艘，艍船四艘。

translations.literal: In all six-scull boats eleven, eight-scull boats four, ten-scull boats two, twelve-scull boats two, rice barges eleven, net-dragging boats six, fast oared boats twenty-seven, shallow-water oared boats twelve, patrol boats fourteen, two-scull boats six, four-scull boats twelve, armed junks four.
translations.idiomatic: Its fleet comprised eleven six-scull boats, four eight-scull, two ten-scull, and two twelve-scull craft, eleven rice barges, six net-dragging boats, twenty-seven fast oared boats, twelve shallow-water oared craft, fourteen patrol boats, six two-scull and twelve four-scull boats, and four armed junks.

sentences.zh: 嗣後裁廣海寨營，以清遠左右營隸三江口協標，以永靖營改隸撫標，又改隸城守協標，增設赤溪左右營。

translations.literal: Thereafter cut Guanghai stockade camp, using Qingyuan left-right camps subordinate to Sanjiangkou cooperative banner, using Yongjing camp changed to subordinate to governor-general's banner, again changed to subordinate to city-defense cooperative banner, increased establishment of Chixi left-right camps.
translations.idiomatic: Later the Guanghai stockade was abolished; Qingyuan's left and right camps passed to the Sanjiangkou cooperative banner; Yongjing was reassigned first to the governor-general's banner and then to the city-defense cooperative; and the Chixi left and right camps were added.

sentences.zh: 南澳水師鎮標，左營戰船十艘，屬福建省，右營趕繒船九艘，仔船六艘，八槳船二艘。

translations.literal: Nan'ao naval brigade banner, left camp war boats ten, belonging to Fujian province, right camp pursuit junks nine, tender boats six, eight-oar boats two.
translations.idiomatic: The Nan'ao naval brigade banner's left camp, under Fujian province, had ten warships; the right camp kept nine pursuit junks, six tender craft, and two eight-oar boats.

sentences.zh: 澄海協，左營艍船二艘，膨仔船二艘，烏船一艘，快槳船三艘；

translations.literal: Chenghai cooperative, left camp armed junks two, Pengzai boats two, Wu boats one, fast oared boats three.
translations.idiomatic: The Chenghai cooperative's left camp had two armed junks, two Pengzai tenders, one Wu boat, and three fast oared craft;

sentences.zh: 右營趕繒船一艘，艍船二艘，仔船一艘，烏船一艘，快槳船二艘。

translations.literal: Right camp pursuit junks one, armed junks two, tender boats one, Wu boats one, fast oared boats two.
translations.idiomatic: the right camp had one pursuit junk, two armed junks, one tender, one Wu boat, and two fast oared craft.

sentences.zh: 海門營趕繒船二艘，艍船二艘，仔船四艘，快槳船四艘。

translations.literal: Haimen camp pursuit junks two, armed junks two, tender boats four, fast oared boats four.
translations.idiomatic: Haimen garrison kept two pursuit junks, two armed junks, four tenders, and four fast oared boats.

sentences.zh: 達濠營艍船二艘，仔船一艘，快槳船一艘。

translations.literal: Dahao camp armed junks two, tender boats one, fast oared boats one.
translations.idiomatic: Dahao garrison had two armed junks, one tender, and one fast oared boat.

sentences.zh: 碣石水師鎮標，康熙八年展界，分中左右三營，米艇十艘，哨船一艘。

translations.literal: Jieshi naval brigade banner, Kangxi 8 expanded boundaries, divided center-left-right three camps, rice barges ten, patrol boats one.
translations.idiomatic: The Jieshi naval brigade banner, after the coastal boundary was restored in Kangxi 8 (1669), was organized into center, left, and right camps with ten rice barges and one patrol boat.

sentences.zh: 平海營，康熙元年，以惠州協右營駐平海所，雍正四年，設平海營，隸鎮標，一號趕繒船一艘，二、三、四號艍船三艘，五、六、七、八號拖風船四艘，一號快船一艘。

translations.literal: Pinghai camp, Kangxi 1, using Huizhou cooperative right camp stationed at Pinghai post, Yongzheng 4, established Pinghai camp, subordinate to brigade banner, No. 1 pursuit junk one, Nos. 2-3-4 armed junks three, Nos. 5-6-7-8 tow-sail boats four, No. 1 fast boat one.
translations.idiomatic: Pinghai garrison: in Kangxi 1 the Huizhou cooperative's right camp was posted at Pinghai; in Yongzheng 4 (1726) a Pinghai camp was established under the brigade banner, with one No. 1 pursuit junk, three armed junks (Nos. 2–4), four tow-sail boats (Nos. 5–8), and one No. 1 fast boat.

sentences.zh: 歸善城守營，舢板哨船十三艘。

translations.literal: Guishan city-defense camp, sampan patrol boats thirteen.
translations.idiomatic: The Guishan city-defense garrison kept thirteen sampan patrol craft.

sentences.zh: 惠來營，屬陸路。

translations.literal: Huilai camp, belonged to land route.
translations.idiomatic: Huilai garrison was an army, not naval, unit.

sentences.zh: 潮州鎮標，分中左右三營。

translations.literal: Chaozhou brigade banner, divided center-left-right three camps.
translations.idiomatic: The Chaozhou brigade banner was divided into center, left, and right camps.

sentences.zh: 城守營快船五艘。

translations.literal: City-defense camp fast boats five.
translations.idiomatic: The city-defense garrison had five fast boats.

sentences.zh: 饒平營快船四艘。

translations.literal: Raoping camp fast boats four.
translations.idiomatic: Raoping garrison kept four fast boats.

sentences.zh: 黃岡協左右營，左營哨船二艘，右營哨船二艘。

translations.literal: Huanggang cooperative left-right camps, left camp patrol boats two, right camp patrol boats two.
translations.idiomatic: The Huanggang cooperative's left and right camps each had two patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 北海鎮標及城守營，康熙初年設。

translations.literal: Beihai brigade banner and city-defense camp, Kangxi early years established.
translations.idiomatic: The Beihai brigade banner and its city-defense garrison were established in the early Kangxi reign.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，改設龍門水師協標，分左右二營，左營水師八百二十三人，右營八百十一人，共大米艇三艘，中米艇四艘，小米艇一艘，撈繒船三艘，艍船一艘。

translations.literal: Year 23, changed to establish Longmen naval cooperative banner, divided left-right two camps, left camp naval force eight hundred twenty-three, right camp eight hundred eleven, in all large rice barges three, medium rice barges four, small rice barges one, net-dragging boats three, armed junks one.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 23 (1684) it was reorganized as the Longmen naval cooperative banner with left and right camps—823 sailors in the left, 811 in the right—together fielding three large rice barges, four medium rice barges, one small rice barge, three net-dragging boats, and one armed junk.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十年後，實存趕繒船二艘，艍船四艘，拖風船一艘，快馬船三艘。

translations.literal: After Qianlong 20, actually retained pursuit junks two, armed junks four, tow-sail boats one, fast horse boats three.
translations.idiomatic: After Qianlong 20 (1755) the fleet on hand comprised two pursuit junks, four armed junks, one tow-sail boat, and three fast horse boats.

sentences.zh: 舊轄有硇州營，大小戰船二十七艘，後改隸高廉水師鎮標。

translations.literal: Formerly commanded Naozhou camp, large and small war boats twenty-seven, later changed to subordinate to Gaolian naval brigade banner.
translations.idiomatic: It had formerly overseen Naozhou garrison with twenty-seven large and small warships; later that unit was reassigned to the Gaolian naval brigade banner.

sentences.zh: 高廉鎮標陽江營，嘉慶十五年，以南韶連鎮標左翼兵移駐陽江，設陽江鎮標，左營大米艇五艘，撈繒船二艘，右營大米艇三艘，撈繒船一艘，後改隸高廉鎮標。

translations.literal: Gaolian brigade banner Yangjiang camp, Jiaqing 15, using Nanshaolian brigade banner left-wing troops moved to station at Yangjiang, established Yangjiang brigade banner, left camp large rice barges five, net-dragging boats two, right camp large rice barges three, net-dragging boats one, later changed to subordinate to Gaolian brigade banner.
translations.idiomatic: Yangjiang garrison under the Gaolian brigade banner: in Jiaqing 15 (1810) troops from the left wing of the Nanshaolian brigade banner were posted to Yangjiang and a Yangjiang brigade banner was created—the left camp with five large rice barges and two net-dragging boats, the right with three large rice barges and one net-dragging boat—later reassigned to the Gaolian brigade banner.

sentences.zh: 電白營雙篷艍船七艘。

translations.literal: Dianbai camp double-sail armed junks seven.
translations.idiomatic: Dianbai garrison kept seven double-sail armed junks.

sentences.zh: 吳川營外海雙篷艍船二艘，外海拖風船三艘，槳船二艘。

translations.literal: Wuchuan camp outer-sea double-sail armed junks two, outer-sea tow-sail boats three, oared boats two.
translations.idiomatic: Wuchuan garrison had two double-sail armed junks for open sea, three tow-sail boats for open sea, and two oared craft.

sentences.zh: 硇州營舊為乾體營，大戰船十三艘，龍艇六艘，哨船五艘。

translations.literal: Naozhou camp formerly was Ganti camp, large war boats thirteen, dragon tenders six, patrol boats five.
translations.idiomatic: Naozhou garrison had originally been Ganti garrison, with thirteen large warships, six dragon tenders, and five patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 康熙四十二年，改為硇州營，存趕繒船三艘，艍船六艘，拖風船十二艘，外海雙篷船四艘，快槳船七艘。

translations.literal: Kangxi 42, changed to Naozhou camp, retained pursuit junks three, armed junks six, tow-sail boats twelve, outer-sea double-sail boats four, fast oared boats seven.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 42 (1703) it was renamed Naozhou garrison, retaining three pursuit junks, six armed junks, twelve tow-sail boats, four open-sea double-sail craft, and seven fast oared boats.

sentences.zh: 東山營大米艇一艘，撈繒船二艘。

translations.literal: Dongshan camp large rice barge one, net-dragging boats two.
translations.idiomatic: Dongshan garrison had one large rice barge and two net-dragging boats.

sentences.zh: 雷瓊鎮標，康熙二十七年設，分左右二營，趕繒船二艘，艍船六艘，快哨船六艘。

translations.literal: Lei-Qiong brigade banner, Kangxi 27 established, divided left-right two camps, pursuit junks two, armed junks six, fast patrol boats six.
translations.idiomatic: The Lei-Qiong brigade banner, established in Kangxi 27 (1688), had left and right camps with two pursuit junks, six armed junks, and six fast patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 雍正間，增快哨船十艘。

translations.literal: During Yongzheng, increased fast patrol boats ten.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongzheng reign ten fast patrol boats were added.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十五年，改稱水師營，左營水師八百七十六人，右營水師八百八十八人。

translations.literal: Jiaqing 15, changed name to naval camp, left camp naval force eight hundred seventy-six, right camp naval force eight hundred eighty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 15 (1810) it was renamed the naval camp, with 876 sailors in the left camp and 888 in the right.

sentences.zh: 海安營，康熙初年，設副將各官。

translations.literal: Haian camp, Kangxi early years, established deputy commander and officers.
translations.idiomatic: Haian garrison, in the early Kangxi reign, was led by a deputy commander and his staff.

sentences.zh: 八年，改設游擊，隸鎮標，大小哨船凡二十艘。

translations.literal: Year 8, changed to establish brigade commander, subordinate to brigade banner, large and small patrol boats in all twenty.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 8 it was reorganized under a brigade commander subordinate to the brigade banner, with twenty large and small patrol boats in all.

sentences.zh: 白鴿寨營，順治初年，設參將各官，大小哨船九艘。

translations.literal: Baigezhai camp, Shunzhi early years, established regimental commander and officers, large and small patrol boats nine.
translations.idiomatic: Baigezhai garrison, established in the early Shunzhi reign under a regimental commander, had nine large and small patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 康熙間裁撤，存哨船三艘。

translations.literal: During Kangxi cut and abolished, retained patrol boats three.
translations.idiomatic: During the Kangxi reign it was reduced; only three patrol boats remained.

sentences.zh: 海口營，嘉慶十五年，設水師協標，左營水師四百九十二人，右營四百八十五人，後改參將，並左右營為一營。

translations.literal: Haikou camp, Jiaqing 15, established naval cooperative banner, left camp naval force four hundred ninety-two, right camp four hundred eighty-five, later changed to regimental commander, merged left-right camps into one camp.
translations.idiomatic: Haikou garrison: in Jiaqing 15 (1810) a naval cooperative banner was created—the left camp with 492 sailors, the right with 485—later placed under a regimental commander with the two camps merged into one.

sentences.zh: 崖州水師協標，中營屬陸路，右營水師一、二、三號拖風哨船三艘，四、五、六號艍船三艘。

translations.literal: Yazhou naval cooperative banner, center camp belonged to land route, right camp naval force Nos. 1-2-3 tow-sail patrol boats three, Nos. 4-5-6 armed junks three.
translations.idiomatic: The Yazhou naval cooperative banner's center camp was an army unit; the right camp's naval force had three tow-sail patrol boats (Nos. 1–3) and three armed junks (Nos. 4–6).

sentences.zh: 又廣東駐防八旗營水師，乾隆十年，設領催等三十人，水師四百七十人，分左右二營，匠役十二人，教習副工兵百人。

translations.literal: Also Guangdong garrison Eight Banners camp naval force, Qianlong 10, established lead-pressers and others thirty, naval force four hundred seventy, divided left-right two camps, artisans twelve, instructors and assistant labor troops one hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong's garrison Eight Banners also maintained a naval force: in Qianlong 10 (1745) thirty lead-pressers and similar personnel were appointed, with 470 sailors in left and right camps, twelve artisans, and a hundred instructor-assistant labor troops.

sentences.zh: 廣西水師，舊設駐柳州，後移駐龍州。

translations.literal: Guangxi naval force, formerly established stationed at Liuzhou, later moved station to Longzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi's naval force was originally based at Liuzhou and later moved to Longzhou.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十一年，以梧州地居兩廣之中，扼三江之要，分額設弁兵之半，於潯、南一帶，設哨船巡防。

translations.literal: Kangxi 21, because Wuzhou's location lay in the middle of the two Guang provinces, straddling the vital point of the three rivers, divided quota and established half of the officers and troops, in the Xun-Nan region, established patrol boats for patrol defense.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 21 (1682), because Wuzhou stood midway between the two Guang provinces and commanded the junction of three rivers, half the allotted officers and men were posted along the Xun and Nan reaches with patrol boats for river defense.

sentences.zh: 其後惟梧州、潯州、平樂、南寧、慶遠各府有經制水師，為數無多。

translations.literal: Thereafter only Wuzhou, Xunzhou, Pingle, Nanning, Qingyuan each prefecture had regular-establishment naval force, in number not many.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter only the prefectures of Wuzhou, Xunzhou, Pingle, Nanning, and Qingyuan maintained regular naval forces, and these were few in number.

sentences.zh: 至光緒初年，以灕江、左江、右江水程綿亙，盜賊充斥，設水師五營。

translations.literal: By Guangxu early years, because Li River, Left River, Right River water routes extended continuously, bandits filled everywhere, established naval force five camps.
translations.idiomatic: By the early Guangxu reign (1870s), with bandits rampant along the long stretches of the Li, Left, and Right rivers, five naval camps were established.

sentences.zh: 嗣因餉絀，並為三營。

translations.literal: Thereafter because pay was short, merged into three camps.
translations.idiomatic: Later, pay shortages forced a consolidation to three camps.

sentences.zh: 旋增募勇丁，凡巡哨船一百四十艘，兵丁一千三百餘人。

translations.literal: Soon increased recruitment of brave troops, in all patrol boats one hundred forty, soldiers one thousand three hundred plus.
translations.idiomatic: Brave recruits were soon added, bringing the force to 140 patrol craft and more than 1,300 men.

sentences.zh: 仍苦不敷分佈，乃復設水師五軍，以水程之長短，定師船之多少。

translations.literal: Still suffered from insufficient distribution, then again established naval force five armies, using water route length to fix number of command boats.
translations.idiomatic: Still spread too thin, the force was reorganized into five naval armies, with the number of command vessels set according to the length of each river stretch.

sentences.zh: 自桂林府至平樂府，為中軍汛地，設將領四人，巡船四十艘，兵五百人。

translations.literal: From Guilin prefecture to Pingle prefecture, was center army post territory, established commanders four, patrol boats forty, troops five hundred.
translations.idiomatic: From Guilin to Pingle was the center army's sector, with four commanders, forty patrol boats, and 500 troops.

sentences.zh: 自梧州府至潯州府，為前軍汛地，設將領二人，巡船二十艘，兵三百五十二人。

translations.literal: From Wuzhou prefecture to Xunzhou prefecture, was front army post territory, established commanders two, patrol boats twenty, troops three hundred fifty-two.
translations.idiomatic: From Wuzhou to Xunzhou was the front army's sector, with two commanders, twenty patrol boats, and 352 troops.

sentences.zh: 自太平府至南寧府，為左軍汛地，設將領三人，巡船三十艘，兵三百七十六人。

translations.literal: From Taiping prefecture to Nanning prefecture, was left army post territory, established commanders three, patrol boats thirty, troops three hundred seventy-six.
translations.idiomatic: From Taiping to Nanning was the left army's sector, with three commanders, thirty patrol boats, and 376 troops.

sentences.zh: 自慶遠府至武宣，為右軍汛地，設將領四人，撥車扒船四艘，巡船三十六艘，兵五百三十六人。

translations.literal: From Qingyuan prefecture to Wuxuan, was right army post territory, established commanders four, allocated cart scoop boats four, patrol boats thirty-six, troops five hundred thirty-six.
translations.idiomatic: From Qingyuan to Wuxuan was the right army's sector, with four commanders, four cart scoop boats assigned, thirty-six patrol boats, and 536 troops.

sentences.zh: 自南寧府至百色等廳河面，為後軍汛地，設將領三人，扒船八艘，巡船二十艘，兵四百二十四人。

translations.literal: From Nanning prefecture to Baise and other subprefectures river surface, was rear army post territory, established commanders three, scoop boats eight, patrol boats twenty, troops four hundred twenty-four.
translations.idiomatic: From Nanning to the waters of Baise and other subprefectures was the rear army's sector, with three commanders, eight scoop boats, twenty patrol boats, and 424 troops.

sentences.zh: 此光緒季年之制也。

translations.literal: This was the Guangxu late-years system.
translations.idiomatic: Such was the system of the late Guangxu period.

sentences.zh: 其舊設水師弁兵船數列後：梧州府水師三營，設副將各官，水師千人，塘船十三艘，快船六艘，舢板船三十八艘。

translations.literal: Its formerly established naval force officers troops boat numbers listed below: Wuzhou prefecture naval force three camps, established deputy commander and officers, naval force one thousand, station boats thirteen, fast boats six, sampan boats thirty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: The earlier establishment of naval officers, men, and vessels is listed below: Wuzhou prefecture's three naval camps, under a deputy commander, mustered 1,000 sailors with thirteen station boats, six fast boats, and thirty-eight sampans.

sentences.zh: 慶遠府協標左營，兼轄水師哨船二艘。

translations.literal: Qingyuan prefecture cooperative banner left camp, also commanded naval patrol boats two.
translations.idiomatic: The Qingyuan cooperative banner's left camp also oversaw two naval patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 平樂府水師哨船四十七艘。

translations.literal: Pingle prefecture naval patrol boats forty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: Pingle prefecture had forty-seven naval patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 廣運營八槳哨船七艘，柳兵哨船七艘。

translations.literal: Guangyun camp eight-oar patrol boats seven, willow-soldier patrol boats seven.
translations.idiomatic: Guangyun garrison had seven eight-oar patrol boats and seven willow-troop patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 大亮營八槳哨船一艘，柳兵哨船一艘。

translations.literal: Daliang camp eight-oar patrol boats one, willow-soldier patrol boats one.
translations.idiomatic: Daliang garrison had one eight-oar patrol boat and one willow-troop patrol boat.

sentences.zh: 大定營八槳哨船一艘，柳兵哨船二艘。

translations.literal: Dading camp eight-oar patrol boats one, willow-soldier patrol boats two.
translations.idiomatic: Dading garrison had one eight-oar patrol boat and two willow-troop patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 足灘營柳兵哨船十二艘。

translations.literal: Zutan camp willow-soldier patrol boats twelve.
translations.idiomatic: Zutan garrison kept twelve willow-troop patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 潯州府左營，兼轄來賓江口水師哨船，勒馬汛水師哨船。

translations.literal: Xunzhou prefecture left camp, also commanded Laibin river mouth naval patrol boats, Lema post naval patrol boats.
translations.idiomatic: Xunzhou prefecture's left camp also oversaw naval patrol boats at the Laibin river mouth and at the Lema post.

sentences.zh: 南寧府隆安縣水塘十八處，哨船十五艘，水師一百四十人，橫州水塘二十處，哨船三艘，水師三十四人。

translations.literal: Nanning prefecture Long'an county water posts eighteen places, patrol boats fifteen, naval force one hundred forty, Hengzhou water posts twenty places, patrol boats three, naval force thirty-four.
translations.idiomatic: In Nanning prefecture, Long'an county had eighteen water posts with fifteen patrol boats and 140 sailors; Hengzhou had twenty water posts with three patrol boats and 34 sailors.

sentences.zh: 永淳縣水塘九處，哨船一艘，水師十人。

translations.literal: Yongchun county water posts nine places, patrol boats one, naval force ten.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchun county had nine water posts with one patrol boat and ten sailors.

sentences.zh: 湖北水師，武昌府城守營，舊有水師營，設守備以下各官。

translations.literal: Hubei naval force, Wuchang prefecture city-defense camp, formerly had naval camp, established battalion commander and subordinate officers.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei's naval force: Wuchang prefecture's city-defense garrison had formerly maintained a naval camp under a battalion commander and his staff.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二年，撥入漢陽營，任江、漢巡防之責。

translations.literal: Qianlong 2, transferred into Hanyang camp, undertook Yangtze and Han patrol-defense duty.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 2 (1737) it was transferred to Hanyang garrison to patrol the Yangtze and Han rivers.

sentences.zh: 武昌省城，存城守營內河巡哨船五艘，下游道士洑營巡江船三艘。

translations.literal: Wuchang provincial city, retained city-defense camp inner-river patrol boats five, downstream Daoshifu camp river-patrol boats three.
translations.idiomatic: At the Wuchang provincial capital the city-defense garrison kept five inner-river patrol boats; downstream, Daoshifu garrison had three river-patrol craft.

sentences.zh: 漢陽城守營兼轄水師營，戰船三艘，虎戰船一艘，漢川虎戰船二艘。

translations.literal: Hanyang city-defense camp also commanded naval camp, war boats three, tiger war boats one, Hanchuan tiger war boats two.
translations.idiomatic: Hanyang city-defense garrison also oversaw the naval camp, with three warships, one tiger war boat, and two tiger war boats at Hanchuan.

sentences.zh: 黃州協營，巡江船三艘。
