translations.literal: Huangzhou cooperative camp, river-patrol boats three.
translations.idiomatic: Huangzhou cooperative garrison had three river-patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 蘄州城守營，巡江船二艘。

translations.literal: Qizhou city-defense camp, river-patrol boats two.
translations.idiomatic: Qizhou city-defense garrison kept two river-patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 荊州水師營，設守備以下各官，戰船二十五艘，巡江船二艘。

translations.literal: Jingzhou naval camp, established battalion commander and subordinate officers, war boats twenty-five, river-patrol boats two.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhou naval camp, under a battalion commander, fielded twenty-five warships and two river-patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 宜昌府水師，順治十三年設彝陵鎮，轄水師前後二營。

translations.literal: Yichang prefecture naval force, Shunzhi 13 established Yiling brigade, commanded naval front-rear two camps.
translations.idiomatic: Yichang's naval force: in Shunzhi 13 (1656) the Yiling brigade was established, commanding front and rear naval camps.

sentences.zh: 康熙十九年，改為彝陵水師協標。

translations.literal: Kangxi 19, changed to Yiling naval cooperative banner.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 19 (1680) it became the Yiling naval cooperative banner.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，改為宜昌鎮標，仍設水師前後二營，戰船三十艘，小船十一艘。

translations.literal: Qianlong 1, changed to Yichang brigade banner, still established naval front-rear two camps, war boats thirty, small boats eleven.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 (1736) it was renamed the Yichang brigade banner, still with front and rear naval camps, thirty warships, and eleven small boats.

sentences.zh: 經粵寇之亂，舊制無存。

translations.literal: Passed through Taiping Rebellion turmoil, old system nothing remained.
translations.idiomatic: The Taiping Rebellion destroyed the old establishment entirely.

sentences.zh: 同治間，設長江水師。

translations.literal: During Tongzhi, established Yangtze naval force.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tongzhi reign the Yangtze naval force was created.

sentences.zh: 其屬湖北省者，為漢陽水師鎮標，轄漢陽營、田鎮營、簰洲營、巴河營。

translations.literal: Its belonging to Hubei province, was Hanyang naval brigade banner, commanded Hanyang camp, Tianzhen camp, Paizhou camp, Bahe camp.
translations.idiomatic: The Hubei component was the Hanyang naval brigade banner, commanding the Hanyang, Tianzhen, Paizhou, and Bahe garrisons.

sentences.zh: 其戰船、兵額，與各省長江水師同制。

translations.literal: Its war boats, troop quotas, with each province Yangtze naval force same system.
translations.idiomatic: Its warships and troop quotas followed the same system as the Yangtze naval forces of the other provinces.

sentences.zh: 江西水師，清初設九江鎮標水師營，南湖水師營、鄱湖水師營，唬船二十艘，分防水巡，各營設塘船一艘。

translations.literal: Jiangxi naval force, early Qing established Jiujiang brigade banner naval camp, Nanhu naval camp, Pohu naval camp, display boats twenty, divided defense water patrol, each camp established station boat one.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi's naval force: in the early Qing the Jiujiang brigade banner naval camp and the Nanhu and Pohu naval camps were established, with twenty display boats for divided water patrol; each camp had one station boat.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，改九江鎮標為九江協標，水師七百七十三人，增設沙船三十艘，水汛巡哨船十七艘。

translations.literal: Kangxi 1, changed Jiujiang brigade banner to Jiujiang cooperative banner, naval force seven hundred seventy-three, increased establishment sand junks thirty, water-post patrol boats seventeen.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 1 (1662) the Jiujiang brigade banner became a cooperative banner with 773 sailors, thirty sand junks added, and seventeen water-post patrol boats.

sentences.zh: 乾隆間，實存沙船八艘，唬船二十三艘。

translations.literal: During Qianlong, actually retained sand junks eight, display boats twenty-three.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qianlong reign the fleet on hand comprised eight sand junks and twenty-three display boats.

sentences.zh: 後改為城守營。

translations.literal: Later changed to city-defense camp.
translations.idiomatic: Later it was reorganized as a city-defense garrison.

sentences.zh: 同治八年，裁撤城守營。

translations.literal: Tongzhi 8, abolished city-defense camp.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 8 (1869) the city-defense garrison was abolished.

sentences.zh: 其南湖水師營、鄱湖水師營，自設長江水師後，亦皆裁撤。

translations.literal: Its Nanhu naval camp, Pohu naval camp, since establishing Yangtze naval force afterward, also all abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Nanhu and Pohu naval camps were also abolished after the Yangtze naval force was established.

sentences.zh: 長江水師之屬於江西省者，為湖口水師鎮標，轄湖口營、吳城營、饒州營、華陽營、安慶營，戰船、兵額，與各省長江水師同制。

translations.literal: Yangtze naval force belonging to Jiangxi province, was Hukou naval brigade banner, commanded Hukou camp, Wucheng camp, Raozhou camp, Huayang camp, Anqing camp, war boats, troop quotas, with each province Yangtze naval force same system.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi's Yangtze naval component was the Hukou naval brigade banner, commanding the Hukou, Wucheng, Raozhou, Huayang, and Anqing garrisons, with warships and troop quotas matching the other provincial Yangtze forces.

sentences.zh: 安徽省水師，安慶鎮標、壽春鎮標及游兵營、泗州營，均有戰船。

translations.literal: Anhui province naval force, Anqing brigade banner, Shouchun brigade banner and mobile-troop camp, Sizhou camp, all had war boats.
translations.idiomatic: Anhui's naval forces—the Anqing and Shouchun brigade banners and the mobile-troop and Sizhou garrisons—all maintained warships.

sentences.zh: 順治初年，安慶鎮標游兵營隸操江巡撫標。

translations.literal: Shunzhi early years, Anqing brigade banner mobile-troop camp subordinate to Caojiang governor-general's banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Shunzhi reign the Anqing brigade banner's mobile-troop camp was under the Caojiang governor-general's banner.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，改隸江南總督標。

translations.literal: Kangxi 1, changed to subordinate to Jiangnan governor-general's banner.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 1 (1662) it was reassigned to the Jiangnan governor-general's banner.

sentences.zh: 泗州營舊隸江南提督標，後改隸安徽巡撫標。

translations.literal: Sizhou camp formerly subordinate to Jiangnan regional commander's banner, later changed to subordinate to Anhui governor-general's banner.
translations.idiomatic: Sizhou garrison had originally been under the Jiangnan regional commander's banner and was later transferred to the Anhui governor-general's banner.

sentences.zh: 安慶鎮標，分防懷寧、桐城、望江、東流、貴池、銅陵及江西彭澤縣等處，大唬船一艘，小唬船二十二艘。

translations.literal: Anqing brigade banner, divided defense Huaining, Tongcheng, Wangjiang, Dongliu, Guichi, Tongling and Jiangxi Pengze county and other places, large display boats one, small display boats twenty-two.
translations.idiomatic: The Anqing brigade banner patrolled Huaining, Tongcheng, Wangjiang, Dongliu, Guichi, Tongling, and Pengze county in Jiangxi, with one large display boat and twenty-two small display boats.

sentences.zh: 游兵營，分防和州、無為、含山、銅城、繁昌、蕪湖、當塗等處及江蘇之江寧縣，大唬船一艘，小唬船二十七艘。

translations.literal: Mobile-troop camp, divided defense Hezhou, Wuwei, Hanshan, Tongcheng, Fanchang, Wuhu, Dangtu and other places and Jiangsu's Jiangning county, large display boats one, small display boats twenty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: The mobile-troop camp patrolled Hezhou, Wuwei, Hanshan, Tongcheng, Fanchang, Wuhu, Dangtu, and Jiangning county in Jiangsu, with one large display boat and twenty-seven small display boats.

sentences.zh: 壽春鎮標，潁州營哨船二艘，泗州營扒唬船四艘。

translations.literal: Shouchun brigade banner, Yingzhou camp patrol boats two, Sizhou camp scoop-display boats four.
translations.idiomatic: The Shouchun brigade banner's Yingzhou garrison had two patrol boats; Sizhou garrison had four scoop-display boats.

sentences.zh: 經粵寇之亂，師船盡毀。

translations.literal: Passed through Taiping Rebellion turmoil, command boats all destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: The Taiping Rebellion destroyed every command vessel.

sentences.zh: 同治間，設長江水師，屬安徽省者，為長江提督標中營，駐太平府，轄裕溪營、蕪湖營、大通營、金陵營，戰船、兵額，與各省長江水師同制。

translations.literal: During Tongzhi, established Yangtze naval force, belonging to Anhui province, was Yangtze regional commander's banner center camp, stationed at Taiping prefecture, commanded Yuxi camp, Wuhu camp, Datong camp, Jinling camp, war boats, troop quotas, with each province Yangtze naval force same system.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tongzhi reign the Yangtze naval force was established; Anhui's component was the center camp of the Yangtze regional commander's banner, based at Taiping prefecture and commanding the Yuxi, Wuhu, Datong, and Jinling garrisons, with warships and troop quotas matching the other provinces.

sentences.zh: 湖南水師，清初設辰州、洞庭二營。

translations.literal: Hunan naval force, early Qing established Chenzhou, Dongting two camps.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan's naval force: in the early Qing the Chenzhou and Dongting camps were established.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十八年，裁辰州水師，改設岳州水師營，歸岳州營參將兼轄，設守備各官，頭舵戰兵六十八人，水步戰兵六十五人，水守兵一百四十八人，分防岳州府城及東西湖、上下江二汛。

translations.literal: Kangxi 28, abolished Chenzhou naval force, changed to establish Yuezhou naval camp, returned to Yuezhou camp regimental commander also commanded, established battalion commander and officers, head-steer combat troops sixty-eight, water-infantry combat troops sixty-five, water garrison troops one hundred forty-eight, divided defense Yuezhou prefecture city and East-West lakes, upper-lower river two posts.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 28 (1689) the Chenzhou naval force was abolished and a Yuezhou naval camp created under the Yuezhou garrison's regimental commander, with a battalion commander and staff—68 head-steer combat troops, 65 water-infantry combat troops, and 148 water garrison troops—patrolling Yuezhou city, the East and West lakes, and the upper and lower river posts.

sentences.zh: 自雍正至嘉慶，迭有增減，存頭舵戰兵三十四人，水步戰兵三十九人，水守兵一百四十二人，戰船十八艘。

translations.literal: From Yongzheng to Jiaqing, repeatedly had increases and decreases, retained head-steer combat troops thirty-four, water-infantry combat troops thirty-nine, water garrison troops one hundred forty-two, war boats eighteen.
translations.idiomatic: From Yongzheng through Jiaqing the force was repeatedly adjusted, settling at 34 head-steer combat troops, 39 water-infantry combat troops, 142 water garrison troops, and eighteen warships.

sentences.zh: 洞庭水師營，原設洞庭協標。

translations.literal: Dongting naval camp, originally established Dongting cooperative banner.
translations.idiomatic: The Dongting naval camp had originally been organized as the Dongting cooperative banner.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二年，以洞庭副將、都司移駐常德，改常德為協。

translations.literal: Jiaqing 2, using Dongting deputy commander, battalion commander moved to station at Changde, changed Changde to cooperative.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 2 (1797) the Dongting deputy commander and battalion commander were posted to Changde, and Changde was made a cooperative banner.

sentences.zh: 以常德游擊、守備移駐洞庭，改洞庭協為水師營，設游擊各官，戰兵一百九人，守兵四百三十六人，戰船十二艘，分防小船、游巡小船各十艘，分駐龍陽縣及東西湖各汛。

translations.literal: Using Changde brigade commander, battalion commander moved to station at Dongting, changed Dongting cooperative to naval camp, established brigade commander and officers, combat troops one hundred nine, garrison troops four hundred thirty-six, war boats twelve, divided defense small boats, patrol small boats each ten, divided stationed Longyang county and East-West lakes each posts.
translations.idiomatic: The Changde brigade commander and battalion commander were posted to Dongting; the Dongting cooperative became a naval camp under a brigade commander, with 109 combat troops, 436 garrison troops, twelve warships, ten small boats and ten patrol small boats each, stationed at Longyang county and the East and West lake posts.

sentences.zh: 承平日久，將弁兵丁，咸居陸地，船敝不修，舊制浸廢。

translations.literal: Long peace daily extended, officers and troops all lived on land, boats worn not repaired, old system gradually abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: After long years of peace officers and men all lived ashore; boats rotted unrepaired, and the old system fell into disuse.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年，曾國籓治水師於湖南，造船練兵，以長龍船、舢板船尤為便利。

translations.literal: Xianfeng 3, Zeng Guofan managed naval force in Hunan, built boats trained troops, using long-dragon boats, sampan boats especially convenient.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 3 (1853) Zeng Guofan built a naval force in Hunan, constructing vessels and drilling troops; long-dragon boats and sampans proved especially effective.

sentences.zh: 粵寇定後，至同治八年，裁撤水勇，設長江水師。

translations.literal: After Taiping rebels settled, by Tongzhi 8, abolished water braves, established Yangtze naval force.
translations.idiomatic: After the Taiping rebels were suppressed, by Tongzhi 8 (1869) the water braves were disbanded and the Yangtze naval force was established.

sentences.zh: 在湖南境者，設岳州鎮標四營，為岳州營、沅江營、荊州協標營、陸溪營。

translations.literal: Within Hunan territory, established Yuezhou brigade banner four camps, as Yuezhou camp, Yuanjiang camp, Jingzhou cooperative banner camp, Luxi camp.
translations.idiomatic: Within Hunan, the Yuezhou brigade banner was organized into four camps: Yuezhou, Yuanjiang, Jingzhou cooperative banner, and Luxi.

sentences.zh: 原設之岳州水師，歸併岳州城守營。

translations.literal: Originally established Yuezhou naval force, merged into Yuezhou city-defense camp.
translations.idiomatic: The original Yuezhou naval force was absorbed into the Yuezhou city-defense garrison.

sentences.zh: 原設洞庭水師，歸併龍陽城守營。

translations.literal: Originally established Dongting naval force, merged into Longyang city-defense camp.
translations.idiomatic: The original Dongting naval force was absorbed into the Longyang city-defense garrison.

sentences.zh: 咸豐軍興以後，常於省城駐水師二營，湘潭駐水師一營，衡州駐水師一營，益陽縣則由省城撥師船駐防，常德駐水師一營，辰州駐一營，靖州之洪江駐一營，澧州則由常德撥師船駐防，又於岳州、安鄉合駐水師一營，不在經制水師之列，而分地駐巡，參錯布置，實與經制水師相輔雲。

translations.literal: After Xianfeng military rise, often at provincial city stationed naval force two camps, Xiangtan stationed naval force one camp, Hengzhou stationed naval force one camp, Yiyang county then from provincial city allocated command boats stationed defense, Changde stationed naval force one camp, Chenzhou stationed one camp, Jingzhou's Hongjiang stationed one camp, Lizhou then from Changde allocated command boats stationed defense, also at Yuezhou, Anxiang jointly stationed naval force one camp, not within regular-establishment naval force list, but divided territory stationed patrol, interwoven deployment, actually with regular-establishment naval force mutually assisted.
translations.idiomatic: After the Xianfeng military mobilization, two naval camps were usually posted at the provincial capital, one each at Xiangtan and Hengzhou; Yiyang county received command vessels from the capital; Changde, Chenzhou, and Hongjiang in Jingzhou each had a camp; Lizhou received boats from Changde; and Yuezhou and Anxiang jointly hosted one camp. Though outside the regular establishment, these dispersed postings interlocked with the regular naval forces in mutual support.

sentences.zh: 長江水師，道光季年，各省內河水師及沿江水師，船多朽敝，值操練之期，虛衍儀式。

translations.literal: Yangtze naval force, Daoguang late years, each province inner-river naval force and along-river naval force, boats mostly rotten worn, at drill-training period, empty show ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: By the late Daoguang reign, inner-river and Yangtze naval forces in every province had mostly rotting vessels; when drill season came, the exercises were empty ceremony.

sentences.zh: 粵寇東犯，無以制之。

translations.literal: Taiping rebels eastward invaded, no means to control them.
translations.idiomatic: When the Taiping rebels swept eastward, there was nothing to stop them.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年，江忠源始建制艦練兵之議。

translations.literal: Xianfeng 3, Jiang Zhongyuan first proposed building warships training troops plan.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 3 (1853) Jiang Zhongyuan first proposed building proper warships and drilling a naval force.

sentences.zh: 四年，命侍郎曾國籓治水師于衡州，造拖罟、快解、長龍、舢板各船，惟舢板船尤為輕捷制勝，長龍船次之。

translations.literal: Year 4, ordered Vice Minister Zeng Guofan to manage naval force at Hengzhou, built tow-net, fast-courier, long-dragon, sampan each boats, only sampan boats especially light swift victorious, long-dragon boats next.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year (1854) Vice Minister Zeng Guofan was ordered to build a naval force at Hengzhou, constructing tow-net boats, fast couriers, long-dragon vessels, and sampans; the sampans proved lightest and swiftest in battle, with long-dragons a close second.

sentences.zh: 大率水師一營，設長龍船一、二艘，舢板船或十餘艘，或二十餘艘，以拖罟船、快解船守營，不以出戰。

translations.literal: Generally naval force one camp, established long-dragon boats one or two, sampan boats perhaps ten-plus or twenty-plus, using tow-net boats, fast-courier boats guard camp, not used for going out to battle.
translations.idiomatic: As a rule each naval camp fielded one or two long-dragons and ten to twenty sampans, while tow-net and fast-courier boats guarded the base and did not sortie for combat.

sentences.zh: 其後水師日增，悉廢拖罟、快蟹舊式之船，專以舢板船摧敵。

translations.literal: Thereafter naval force daily increased, all abolished tow-net, fast-crab old-style boats, exclusively used sampan boats to destroy enemy.
translations.idiomatic: As the fleet grew, the old tow-net and fast-crab designs were scrapped entirely; sampans alone carried the fight.

sentences.zh: 任彭玉麟、楊岳斌為水師統帥，循長江轉戰東下，克名城以百計，踣巨憝於金陵。

translations.literal: Appointed Peng Yulin, Yang Yuebin as naval force supreme commanders, followed Yangtze turning battle eastward down, captured famous cities by the hundreds, felled great villain at Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Yulin and Yang Yuebin were placed in overall command; fighting down the Yangtze they took scores of great cities and brought down the arch-rebel at Jinling.

sentences.zh: 同治三年，東南底定，曾國籓、彭玉麟以江防重要，疏請設立長江經制水師。

translations.literal: Tongzhi 3, southeast settled, Zeng Guofan, Peng Yulin because river defense important, memorial requested establish Yangtze regular-establishment naval force.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 3 (1864), with the southeast pacified, Zeng Guofan and Peng Yulin memorialized the throne on the vital importance of river defense and asked to create a regular Yangtze naval establishment.

sentences.zh: 簡授長江水師提督一人，得專摺奏事，隸兩江、湖廣總督節制，率提標五營駐安徽太平府。

translations.literal: Selected appointed Yangtze naval force provincial admiral one person, could exclusively memorial report affairs, subordinate to Two Jiangs, Huguang governors-general control, led command banner five camps stationed Anhui Taiping prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Yangtze naval commander-in-chief was appointed with the privilege of direct memorials to the throne, under the Two Jiangs and Huguang governors-general, commanding five banner camps from headquarters at Taiping in Anhui.

sentences.zh: 每歲於所轄湖南、湖北、江西、安徽、江南五省江面巡閱。

translations.literal: Each year at governed Hunan, Hubei, Jiangxi, Anhui, Jiangnan five provinces river surface inspected.
translations.idiomatic: Each year he inspected the river surface across his five provinces: Hunan, Hubei, Jiangxi, Anhui, and Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 設岳州、漢陽、瓜洲、湖口四總兵官。

translations.literal: Established Yuezhou, Hanyang, Guazhou, Hukou four brigade generals.
translations.idiomatic: Brigade generals were posted at Yuezhou, Hanyang, Guazhou, and Hukou.

sentences.zh: 每鎮標各統水師四營，惟湖口鎮標五營，以狼山鎮標水師二營並隸之，凡二十四營。

translations.literal: Each brigade banner each commanded naval force four camps, only Hukou brigade banner five camps, with Langshan brigade banner naval force two camps also subordinated, altogether twenty-four camps.
translations.idiomatic: Each brigade banner normally commanded four naval camps; Hukou had five, with two Langshan brigade camps attached, twenty-four camps in all.

sentences.zh: 總兵及參將、游擊，於收泊戰艦處所立汛建署，為營汛治事之地。

translations.literal: Brigade generals and deputy generals, brigade commanders, established river posts built offices at moored warship places, as camp-post places for conducting affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Brigade generals, deputy generals, and brigade commanders established river posts and offices where their warships moored—these were the camp stations for administration.

sentences.zh: 以船為家，不得在署常居。

translations.literal: Taking boat as home, not permitted to dwell permanently in office.
translations.idiomatic: They made their boats their homes and might not live ashore in the offices.

sentences.zh: 都司、守備各官以至兵丁，不得陸居。

translations.literal: Division commanders, battalion commanders each officer down to troops, not permitted to live on land.
translations.idiomatic: Division and battalion commanders and all ranks down to the common sailors were forbidden to live on land.

sentences.zh: 總兵座船三艘，督陣舢板二艘，親兵十二人。

translations.literal: Brigade general command boats three, battle-direction sampans two, personal guard twelve men.
translations.idiomatic: A brigade general had three command boats, two battle-direction sampans, and twelve bodyguards.

sentences.zh: 副將座船二艘，督陣舢板一艘，長龍二艘，親兵十二人。

translations.literal: Deputy general command boats two, battle-direction sampan one, long-dragon two, personal guard twelve men.
translations.idiomatic: A deputy general had two command boats, one battle-direction sampan, two long-dragons, and twelve bodyguards.

sentences.zh: 游擊座船二艘，督陣舢板一艘，長龍一艘，親兵十二人。

translations.literal: Brigade commander command boats two, battle-direction sampan one, long-dragon one, personal guard twelve men.
translations.idiomatic: A brigade commander had two command boats, one battle-direction sampan, one long-dragon, and twelve bodyguards.

sentences.zh: 都司二人，各座船一艘，長龍一艘。

translations.literal: Division commanders two men, each command boat one, long-dragon one.
translations.idiomatic: Two division commanders each had one command boat and one long-dragon.

sentences.zh: 守備二人，各座船一艘，舢板一艘，飛劃一艘。

translations.literal: Battalion commanders two men, each command boat one, sampan one, flying-oar boat one.
translations.idiomatic: Two battalion commanders each had one command boat, one sampan, and one flying-oar craft.

sentences.zh: 四哨千總八人，各座船一艘，舢板一艘，飛劃一艘。

translations.literal: Four squadrons company commanders eight men, each command boat one, sampan one, flying-oar boat one.
translations.idiomatic: Eight company commanders of the four squadrons each had one command boat, one sampan, and one flying-oar craft.

sentences.zh: 四哨把總九人，各座船一艘，舢板一艘，飛劃一艘。

translations.literal: Four squadrons platoon commanders nine men, each command boat one, sampan one, flying-oar boat one.
translations.idiomatic: Nine platoon commanders of the four squadrons each had one command boat, one sampan, and one flying-oar craft.

sentences.zh: 四哨外委十一人，各座船一艘，舢板一艘，飛劃一艘。

translations.literal: Four squadrons sub-officers eleven men, each command boat one, sampan one, flying-oar boat one.
translations.idiomatic: Eleven sub-officers of the four squadrons each had one command boat, one sampan, and one flying-oar craft.

sentences.zh: 又外委一人，管帶督陣舢板，有座船一艘，無舢板。

translations.literal: Also one sub-officer, commanded battle-direction sampan, had command boat one, no sampan.
translations.idiomatic: One additional sub-officer commanded the battle-direction sampan; he had a command boat but no sampan of his own.

sentences.zh: 戰船之大者，每艘或設兵二十人，為舵兵一人，頭兵一人，砲兵二人，槳兵十六人；

translations.literal: Large war boats, each boat perhaps established troops twenty men, as helmsman one, bowman one, gunners two, oarsmen sixteen;
translations.idiomatic: The larger warships carried twenty men each: one helmsman, one bowman, two gunners, and sixteen oarsmen;

sentences.zh: 或設兵二十五人，為舵兵一人，艙兵一人，頭兵一人，砲兵四人，槳兵十八人。

translations.literal: Or established troops twenty-five men, as helmsman one, hold-man one, bowman one, gunners four, oarsmen eighteen.
translations.idiomatic: or twenty-five: one helmsman, one hold-man, one bowman, four gunners, and eighteen oarsmen.

sentences.zh: 舢板船每艘設兵十四人。

translations.literal: Sampan boats each boat established troops fourteen men.
translations.idiomatic: Each sampan carried fourteen men.

sentences.zh: 總兵以下各官，設稿書、書識，自七人至一人不等。

translations.literal: Brigade general and below each officer, established drafting clerks, record clerks, from seven men to one man unequal.
translations.idiomatic: Officers from brigade general downward were allotted drafting and record clerks, from seven down to one according to rank.

sentences.zh: 以都司一人管駕長龍船為領哨，守備為副領哨。

translations.literal: Using one division commander to command long-dragon boat as squadron leader, battalion commander as assistant squadron leader.
translations.idiomatic: One division commander commanding the long-dragon served as squadron leader, with the battalion commander as assistant squadron leader.

sentences.zh: 每哨戰船十艘。

translations.literal: Each squadron war boats ten.
translations.idiomatic: Each squadron had ten warships.

sentences.zh: 惟岳州、漢陽系游擊營制，而統戰船三十三艘，視參將例。

translations.literal: Only Yuezhou, Hanyang followed brigade commander camp system, yet commanded war boats thirty-three, viewed as deputy general example.
translations.idiomatic: Yuezhou and Hanyang, though organized on the brigade-commander camp model, each controlled thirty-three warships on the deputy-general scale.

sentences.zh: 左哨都司專任錢糧，右哨都司專任船砲軍械及巡查諸務。

translations.literal: Left squadron division commander exclusively charged pay and grain, right squadron division commander exclusively charged boats, guns, weapons and patrol duties.
translations.idiomatic: The left-squadron division commander handled pay and provisions; the right-squadron division commander handled vessels, ordnance, arms, and patrol duties.

sentences.zh: 大小戰船咸設砲位。

translations.literal: Large and small war boats all established gun positions.
translations.idiomatic: All warships large and small carried gun mounts.

sentences.zh: 長龍船千斤頭砲二位，七百斤邊砲四位，艘砲一位。

translations.literal: Long-dragon boat thousand-jin bow guns two, seven-hundred-jin flank guns four, stern gun one.
translations.idiomatic: A long-dragon mounted two thousand-jin bow guns, four seven-hundred-jin broadside guns, and one stern gun.

sentences.zh: 舢板船八百斤頭砲一位，六、七百斤哨砲一位，船邊五十斤轉珠小砲二位。

translations.literal: Sampan boat eight-hundred-jin bow gun one, six- or seven-hundred-jin sentry gun one, boat flank fifty-jin revolving-bead small guns two.
translations.idiomatic: A sampan carried one eight-hundred-jin bow gun, one six- or seven-hundred-jin sentry gun, and two fifty-jin swivel guns along the rails.

sentences.zh: 洋槍刀矛之屬，隨宜分配。

translations.literal: Foreign muskets, spears and such, as appropriate allocated.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign muskets, spears, and the like were distributed as needed.

sentences.zh: 旗幟以桅旗為主，懸方式長龍旗，凡長一丈二尺。

translations.literal: Banners and flags with mast flag as main, suspended square long-dragon flag, altogether length one zhang two chi.
translations.idiomatic: The mast flag was paramount: a square long-dragon flag, twelve chi in length.

sentences.zh: 舢板船旗長九尺，船艄懸尖式龍旗，書某標某營某哨。

translations.literal: Sampan boat flag length nine chi, boat stern suspended pointed dragon flag, inscribed such banner such camp such squadron.
translations.idiomatic: Sampan flags were nine chi long; a pointed dragon flag at the stern bore the banner, camp, and squadron designation.

sentences.zh: 桅上小旗，或船首立旗，書駕船將弁之姓，以示區別。

translations.literal: Mast small flags, or boat bow standing flags, inscribed commanding officer's surname, to show distinction.
translations.idiomatic: Small flags on the mast or a flag at the bow bore the commanding officer's surname for identification.

sentences.zh: 凡駐師之處，漁船由水師編號稽查，以清盜源。

translations.literal: Wherever troops stationed, fishing boats by naval force numbered and inspected, to clear bandit sources.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever the fleet was stationed, fishing boats were registered and inspected by the navy to cut off bandit supply lines.

sentences.zh: 其疏防之責，以哨官為專汛，營官為本轄，遇有盜劫，視汛地所轄題參。

translations.literal: Neglect-of-defense responsibility, squadron officer as dedicated post, camp officer as home jurisdiction; encountering robbery, according to post territory governed reported and impeached.
translations.idiomatic: Responsibility for lax defense fell on the squadron officer at the post and the camp commander in overall charge; robberies were reported and officials impeached according to the territory.

sentences.zh: 江、鄂各營，半年更調一次。

translations.literal: Jiang, E each camps, half-year rotated once.
translations.idiomatic: Camps on the Jiang and E sections rotated every half year.

sentences.zh: 副將與副將之營互調，參將、游擊與參將、游擊之營互調。

translations.literal: Deputy generals with deputy generals' camps mutually rotated, brigadier generals, brigade commanders with brigadier generals', brigade commanders' camps mutually rotated.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy generals rotated with other deputy generals' camps; brigadier generals and brigade commanders rotated among camps of their rank.

sentences.zh: 每營調居客汛二次，又調回本汛一次，如承緝盜案未獲，則不得更調。

translations.literal: Each camp rotated to guest post twice, also rotated back to home post once; if undertaking pursuit of bandit case not captured, then not permitted rotation.
translations.idiomatic: Each camp served two tours on detached posts and one return to home station; if a bandit case remained unsolved, rotation was withheld.

sentences.zh: 凡副將、參將以下，由本境巡撫節制，總兵由總督節制。

translations.literal: All deputy generals, brigadier generals and below, by home-province governor controlled, brigade generals by governor-general controlled.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy and brigadier generals and all officers below them answered to the provincial governor; brigade generals to the governor-general.

sentences.zh: 土匪猝發，須用戰船，由督撫檄調境內水師往剿。

translations.literal: Bandits suddenly erupted, must use war boats, by governor-general, governor official dispatch mobilized within-territory naval force to go suppress.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits broke out suddenly and warships were needed, the governor-general or governor ordered the local naval force to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 總兵奉檄即發兵。

translations.literal: Brigade general receiving order immediately dispatched troops.
translations.idiomatic: On receipt of the order the brigade general sailed at once.

sentences.zh: 督撫調水師操練，亦奉檄即行。

translations.literal: Governor-general, governor ordered naval force drill training, also receiving order immediately proceeded.
translations.idiomatic: When governors ordered naval drills, the fleet likewise moved on command.

sentences.zh: 其事涉重大者，督撫會同長江提督疏陳。

translations.literal: Matters involving major importance, governor-general, governor jointly with Yangtze provincial admiral memorial submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Major affairs were jointly memorialized by the governors and the Yangtze commander.

sentences.zh: 其餘水營政務，由長江提督主持。

translations.literal: Remaining water-camp government affairs, by Yangtze provincial admiral presided.
translations.idiomatic: Other naval administration rested with the Yangtze commander.

sentences.zh: 餉糈之制，將弁則視其職以定廉養公費。

translations.literal: Pay and provisions system, officers then viewed their office to fix stipend and public expense.
translations.idiomatic: Officers' pay followed rank, with fixed stipends and office allowances.

sentences.zh: 兵丁月餉，每名銀三兩有差。

translations.literal: Troops monthly pay, each man silver three liang plus.
translations.idiomatic: Common sailors drew a monthly wage of a little over three taels of silver each.

sentences.zh: 全軍餉糈，由沿江釐捐局指定支撥。

translations.literal: Whole army pay and provisions, by along-river transit-levy bureau designated disbursed.
translations.idiomatic: The fleet's entire payroll was disbursed from designated Yangtze transit-levy offices.

sentences.zh: 設火藥局於湖北、安徽，購硝斤於江蘇、江西、湖南。

translations.literal: Established gunpowder bureaus at Hubei, Anhui, purchased saltpeter from Jiangsu, Jiangxi, Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Gunpowder works were set up in Hubei and Anhui; saltpeter was bought from Jiangsu, Jiangxi, and Hunan.

sentences.zh: 設子彈局於湖南之長沙。

translations.literal: Established bullet bureau at Hunan's Changsha.
translations.idiomatic: A bullet factory was established at Changsha in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 設造船廠於湖北之漢陽，江西之吳城，江南之草鞋夾。

translations.literal: Established shipbuilding yards at Hubei's Hanyang, Jiangxi's Wucheng, Jiangnan's Caoxiejia.
translations.idiomatic: Shipyards were built at Hanyang in Hubei, Wucheng in Jiangxi, and Caoxiejia in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 戰船均三年一修，十二年更換。

translations.literal: War boats all three years one repair, twelve years replaced.
translations.idiomatic: Warships were overhauled every three years and replaced every twelve.

sentences.zh: 定水師事宜三十條，未盡者續定十條。

translations.literal: Fixed naval force matters thirty articles, not exhausted continued fixed ten articles.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty regulations governing the navy were promulgated, with ten supplementary articles where the first set fell short.

sentences.zh: 銀米有稽，銓補有章，訓練有規。

translations.literal: Silver and grain had audit, appointment and filling had rules, training had standards.
translations.idiomatic: Pay and rations were audited, appointments governed by rule, and training held to standard.

sentences.zh: 鄭重江防，嚴申禁約，有犯必懲。

translations.literal: Solemnly valued river defense, strictly announced prohibitions, violators surely punished.
translations.idiomatic: River defense was treated with utmost seriousness; prohibitions were strictly enforced and violations punished without exception.

sentences.zh: 自荊州以達海門，沿江數千里，稱天塹雄師。

translations.literal: From Jingzhou reaching Haimen, along river several thousand li, called heaven's moat mighty army.
translations.idiomatic: From Jingzhou to Haimen, thousands of li of river were guarded by what was hailed as an army behind heaven's moat.

sentences.zh: 至光緒季年，特命大臣查閱長江營伍，實存長龍、舢板戰船七百六十二艘，飛划船六百四十二艘，水師弁兵一萬有七十九人。

translations.literal: To Guangxu late years, specially ordered great minister inspect Yangtze camps and troops, actually existing long-dragon, sampan war boats seven hundred sixty-two, flying-oar boats six hundred forty-two, naval force officers and troops ten thousand seventy-nine men.
translations.idiomatic: By the late Guangxu reign an imperial commissioner inspecting Yangtze garrisons found 762 long-dragon and sampan warships, 642 flying-oar craft, and 10,079 naval officers and men actually on the rolls.

sentences.zh: 其自荊州以上，溯江至宜昌、巴東，漢陽以上，溯江至襄陽、鄖陽，湖南之湘江、沅江，江西之吳城，以上諸河，各疆吏自設防營。

translations.literal: From Jingzhou upward, upstream to Yichang, Badong, above Hanyang upstream to Xiangyang, Yunyang, Hunan's Xiang River, Yuan River, Jiangxi's Wucheng, above rivers each, border officials themselves established defense camps.
translations.idiomatic: Above Jingzhou, upstream to Yichang and Badong; above Hanyang to Xiangyang and Yunyang; the Xiang and Yuan in Hunan; Wucheng in Jiangxi—these rivers were patrolled by defense camps raised separately by the provincial authorities.

sentences.zh: 其淮河一帶，自正陽關至洪澤湖，及江蘇境各支河水師，隸淮陽鎮標，光緒間，改設江北提督。

translations.literal: Huai River region, from Zhengyang Pass to Hongze Lake, and Jiangsu territory each branch-river naval force, subordinate to Huaiyang brigade banner; Guangxu period, changed established Jiangbei provincial admiral.
translations.idiomatic: The Huai River sector from Zhengyang Pass to Hongze Lake, with Jiangsu's tributary fleets, fell under the Huaiyang brigade banner; in the Guangxu era this became the Jiangbei commander's jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 凡清江營、洋河營、廟灣營、佃湖營、洪湖營、葦盪營咸隸之。

translations.literal: All Qingjiang camp, Yanghe camp, Miaowan camp, Dianhu camp, Honghu camp, Weidang camp all subordinated.
translations.idiomatic: The Qingjiang, Yanghe, Miaowan, Dianhu, Honghu, and Weidang camps all reported to it.

sentences.zh: 自鎮江以東，內河各汛及太湖水師五營，則統以江南提督。

translations.literal: From Zhenjiang eastward, inner-river each post and Tai Lake naval force five camps, then commanded by Jiangnan provincial admiral.
translations.idiomatic: East of Zhenjiang, inner-river posts and the five Tai Lake naval camps came under the Jiangnan commander.

sentences.zh: 凡各省內河有水師者，悉改舊式，一準長江水師。

translations.literal: All each province inner-river where naval force existed, all changed old style, uniformly followed Yangtze naval force.
translations.idiomatic: Every provincial inner-river navy was reorganized on the Yangtze model.

sentences.zh: 其海口原有之狼山鎮、福山鎮，仍如前制，由鎮將督率大號戰船，巡防內海。

translations.literal: Sea mouths originally existing Langshan brigade, Fushan brigade, still as before system, by brigade generals supervised led large war boats, patrolled defended inner sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Langshan and Fushan brigades at the sea mouths kept their old establishments; brigade generals led large warships in patrol of the inner seas.

sentences.zh: 惟狼山鎮兼隸長江水師提督，每營設大舢板船二十艘，並仿紅單、拖罟船式，設大號戰船數艘，多置砲位，為巡緝內洋之用。

translations.literal: Only Langshan brigade also subordinate to Yangtze naval force provincial admiral, each camp established large sampan boats twenty, and copied red-sail, tow-net boat style, established large war boats several, many gun positions, for patrol suppress inner coastal use.
translations.idiomatic: Langshan also answered to the Yangtze commander; each camp added twenty large sampans and several big gun-decked warships modeled on red-sail junks and tow-net boats for inner-coast patrol.

sentences.zh: 其長江水師營制防汛列後：

translations.literal: Its Yangtze naval force camp system flood-defense listed below:
translations.idiomatic: The Yangtze naval establishment and its flood-defense dispositions are listed below:

sentences.zh: 岳州設總兵官，置中軍中營游擊，戰船三十三艘，仿參將營之例，分防自城陵磯至鹿角、壘石、瀘陵潭、湘陰一帶。

translations.literal: Yuezhou established brigade general, placed headquarters middle-camp brigade commander, war boats thirty-three, copied deputy general camp example, divided defense from Chenglingji to Lujiao, Leishi, Lulingtan, Xiangyin region.
translations.idiomatic: Yuezhou: a brigade general and headquarters brigade commander, thirty-three warships on the deputy-general scale, patrolling from Chenglingji through Lujiao, Leishi, Lulingtan, and Xiangyin.

sentences.zh: 沅江設參將，屬岳州鎮左營，分防君山、西湖及常德、龍陽、華容等河通洞庭湖之處。

translations.literal: Yuan River established deputy general, subordinate to Yuezhou brigade left camp, divided defense Junshan, West Lake and Changde, Longyang, Huarong etc. rivers connecting Dongting Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan River: a deputy general of the Yuezhou left camp, covering Junshan, West Lake, and the Changde, Longyang, and Huarong waterways into Dongting.

sentences.zh: 其沅、湘等水汛，由湖南省別行設防。

translations.literal: Its Yuan, Xiang etc. water posts, by Hunan province separately established defense.
translations.idiomatic: Other Yuan and Xiang river posts were garrisoned separately by Hunan.

sentences.zh: 荊州設副將，屬岳州鎮後營，分防自荊州以下江面，石首、監利一帶，至荊河口止。

translations.literal: Jingzhou established deputy general, subordinate to Yuezhou brigade rear camp, divided defense from Jingzhou downward river surface, Shishou, Jianli region, to Jinghe mouth stop.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhou: a deputy general of the Yuezhou rear camp, from Jingzhou downstream through Shishou and Jianli to the Jinghe estuary.

sentences.zh: 陸溪口設游擊，屬岳州鎮前營，分防自荊州河以下江面，螺山、新堤及倒口內之黃蓋湖。

translations.literal: Luxikou established brigade commander, subordinate to Yuezhou brigade front camp, divided defense from Jingzhou River downward river surface, Luoshan, Xindi and Daokou inner Huanggalake.
translations.idiomatic: Luxikou: a brigade commander of the Yuezhou front camp, from the Jingzhou river downstream through Luoshan and Xindi, including Huanggalake inside Daokou.

sentences.zh: 漢陽設總兵官，置中軍中營游擊，戰船三十三艘，仿參將營之例，分防自沌口以下江面，至團風等處，並防省城兩岸，後湖、青林湖。

translations.literal: Hanyang established brigade general, placed headquarters middle-camp brigade commander, war boats thirty-three, copied deputy general camp example, divided defense from Zhuankou downward river surface to Tuanfeng etc., and defended provincial capital both banks, Hou Lake, Qinglin Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Hanyang: a brigade general and headquarters brigade commander, thirty-three warships on the deputy-general scale, from Zhuankou downstream to Tuanfeng, including both banks of the provincial capital, Hou Lake, and Qinglin Lake.

sentences.zh: 其漢水上通樊城千餘里及各河汊，由湖北省別行設防。

translations.literal: Its Han River upward connects Fancheng thousand-plus li and each river branch, by Hubei province separately established defense.
translations.idiomatic: The Han River above, more than a thousand li to Fancheng and its branches, was garrisoned separately by Hubei.

sentences.zh: 簰洲設參將，屬漢陽鎮後營，分防自倒口以下江面至沌口，兼防金口以內之斧頭湖。

translations.literal: Paizhou established deputy general, subordinate to Hanyang brigade rear camp, divided defense from Daokou downward river surface to Zhuankou, also defended Jinkou inner Futou Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Paizhou: a deputy general of the Hanyang rear camp, from Daokou downstream to Zhuankou, including Futou Lake inside Jinkou.

sentences.zh: 巴河設游擊，屬漢陽鎮右營，分防自團風以下江面，黃州、蘭溪至道士洑，兼樊口以內之梁子湖。

translations.literal: Bahe established brigade commander, subordinate to Hanyang brigade right camp, divided defense from Tuanfeng downward river surface, Huangzhou, Lanxi to Daoshifu, also Fan mouth inner Liangzi Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Bahe: a brigade commander of the Hanyang right camp, from Tuanfeng downstream through Huangzhou and Lanxi to Daoshifu, including Liangzi Lake above Fan mouth.

sentences.zh: 田家鎮設副將，屬漢陽鎮前營，分防自道士洑以下江面，湋源口、蘄州、武穴至陸家嘴，兼防湋源口及隆平以內之湖。

translations.literal: Tianjiazhen established deputy general, subordinate to Hanyang brigade front camp, divided defense from Daoshifu downward river surface, Weiyuankou, Qizhou, Wuxue to Lujiazui, also defended Weiyuankou and Longping inner lakes.
translations.idiomatic: Tianjiazhen: a deputy general of the Hanyang front camp, from Daoshifu downstream through Weiyuankou, Qizhou, and Wuxue to Lujiazui, including the lakes above Weiyuankou and Longping.

sentences.zh: 湖口設總兵官，置中軍中營游擊，分防自陸家嘴以下江面，至九江老洲頭。

translations.literal: Hukou established brigade general, placed headquarters middle-camp brigade commander, divided defense from Lujiazui downward river surface to Jiujiang Laozhoutou.
translations.idiomatic: Hukou: a brigade general and headquarters brigade commander, from Lujiazui downstream to Laozhoutou at Jiujiang.

sentences.zh: 吳城設參將，屬湖口鎮左營，分防自湖口以內姑塘、南唐、渚磯一帶。

translations.literal: Wucheng established deputy general, subordinate to Hukou brigade left camp, divided defense from Hukou inner Gutang, Nantang, Zhuji region.
translations.idiomatic: Wucheng: a deputy general of the Hukou left camp, covering Gutang, Nantang, and Zhuji inside Hukou.

sentences.zh: 饒州設參將，屬湖口鎮後營，分防都昌、鄱陽、康山一帶。

translations.literal: Raozhou established deputy general, subordinate to Hukou brigade rear camp, divided defense Duchang, Poyang, Kangshan region.
translations.idiomatic: Raozhou: a deputy general of the Hukou rear camp, patrolling Duchang, Poyang, and Kangshan.

sentences.zh: 其彭蠡湖東境各湖，南達省城贛江，由江西省別行設防。

translations.literal: Its Poyang Lake east territory each lake, south reaching provincial capital Gan River, by Jiangxi province separately established defense.
translations.idiomatic: Lakes on the east shore of Poyang and the Gan River south to the provincial capital were garrisoned separately by Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 華陽鎮設游擊，屬湖口鎮右營，分防自老洲頭以下江面，彭澤縣、香口至東流等處，兼防吉水溝以內各湖。

translations.literal: Huayang town established brigade commander, subordinate to Hukou brigade right camp, divided defense from Laozhoutou downward river surface, Pengze county, Xiangkou to Dongliu etc., also defended Jishuigou inner each lake.
translations.idiomatic: Huayang: a brigade commander of the Hukou right camp, from Laozhoutou downstream through Pengze and Xiangkou to Dongliu, including lakes inside Jishuigou.

sentences.zh: 安慶府設副將，屬湖口鎮前營，分防自東流以下江面，黃石磯、李陽河至樅陽，兼防北岸鹽河及樅陽以下，南岸通殷家匯之河。

translations.literal: Anqing prefecture established deputy general, subordinate to Hukou brigade front camp, divided defense from Dongliu downward river surface, Huangshiji, Liyang River to Zongyang, also defended north bank salt river and below Zongyang, south bank connecting Yinjiashui river.
translations.idiomatic: Anqing: a deputy general of the Hukou front camp, from Dongliu downstream through Huangshiji and Liyang River to Zongyang, including the north-bank salt river and the south-bank waterway to Yinjiashui below Zongyang.

sentences.zh: 太平府設長江水師提督衙署，置中軍中營副將，分防金柱關以下江面至烏江。

translations.literal: Taiping prefecture established Yangtze naval force provincial admiral yamen, placed headquarters middle-camp deputy general, divided defense from Jinzhuguan downward river surface to Wujiang.
translations.idiomatic: Taiping: headquarters of the Yangtze commander with a deputy general of the command banner, from Jinzhuguan downstream to Wujiang.

sentences.zh: 大通設參將，屬提標後營，分防自樅陽以下江面，池州土橋至荻港。

translations.literal: Datong established deputy general, subordinate to command banner rear camp, divided defense from Zongyang downward river surface, Chizhou Tuqiao to Dihgang.
translations.idiomatic: Datong: a deputy general of the command rear camp, from Zongyang downstream through Chizhou Tuqiao to Dihgang.

sentences.zh: 蕪湖設游擊，屬提標右營，分防自荻港以下江面至裕溪口，並灣沚、青弋江等處。

translations.literal: Wuhu established brigade commander, subordinate to command banner right camp, divided defense from Dihgang downward river surface to Yuxikou, and Wanzhi, Qingyi River etc.
translations.idiomatic: Wuhu: a brigade commander of the command right camp, from Dihgang downstream to Yuxikou, including Wanzhi and the Qingyi River.

sentences.zh: 裕溪口設參將，屬提標左營，分防東西梁山江面至金柱關，兼防運漕、無為州各內河，及巢湖百餘里水汛。

translations.literal: Yuxikou established deputy general, subordinate to command banner left camp, divided defense east-west Liangshan river surface to Jinzhuguan, also defended transport canal, Wuwei prefecture each inner river, and Chaohu hundred-plus li water posts.
translations.idiomatic: Yuxikou: a deputy general of the command left camp, from the Liangshan narrows to Jinzhuguan, including the transport canal, Wuwei inner rivers, and a hundred li of Chaohu posts.

sentences.zh: 金陵草鞋夾設參將，屬提標前營，分防烏江以下江面至通江集，兼防江浦、六合內河。

translations.literal: Jinling Caoxiejia established deputy general, subordinate to command banner front camp, divided defense from Wujiang downward river surface to Tongjiangji, also defended Jiangpu, Liuhe inner rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Caoxiejia at Jinling: a deputy general of the command front camp, from Wujiang downstream to Tongjiangji, including Jiangpu and Liuhe inner rivers.

sentences.zh: 瓜洲設總兵官，置中軍中營游擊，分防通江集以下江面至焦山，兼防內河至揚州。

translations.literal: Guazhou established brigade general, placed headquarters middle-camp brigade commander, divided defense from Tongjiangji downward river surface to Jiaoshan, also defended inner river to Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Guazhou: a brigade general and headquarters brigade commander, from Tongjiangji downstream to Jiaoshan, including the inner river to Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 自揚州以上，高郵等湖，由淮揚鎮別行設防。

translations.literal: From Yangzhou upward, Gaoyou etc. lakes, by Huai-Yang brigade separately established defense.
translations.idiomatic: Lakes above Yangzhou, including Gaoyou, were garrisoned by the Huai-Yang brigade.

sentences.zh: 孟河營設游擊，屬瓜洲鎮右營，分防南岸各夾江，自焦山至江陰口。

translations.literal: Menghe camp established brigade commander, subordinate to Guazhou brigade right camp, divided defense south bank each channel river, from Jiaoshan to Jiangyin mouth.
translations.idiomatic: Menghe camp: a brigade commander of the Guazhou right camp, patrolling south-bank channels from Jiaoshan to Jiangyin.

sentences.zh: 其南岸內河，由松江提標別行設防。

translations.literal: Its south bank inner river, by Songjiang provincial admiral separately established defense.
translations.idiomatic: South-bank inner rivers were garrisoned by the Songjiang commander.

sentences.zh: 三江營設游擊，屬瓜洲鎮左營，分防北岸各夾江，自焦山至靖江口。

translations.literal: Sanjiang camp established brigade commander, subordinate to Guazhou brigade left camp, divided defense north bank each channel river, from Jiaoshan to Jingjiang mouth.
translations.idiomatic: Sanjiang camp: a brigade commander of the Guazhou left camp, patrolling north-bank channels from Jiaoshan to Jingjiang.

sentences.zh: 其北岸內河，由淮揚鎮別行設防。

translations.literal: Its north bank inner river, by Huai-Yang brigade separately established defense.
translations.idiomatic: North-bank inner rivers were garrisoned by the Huai-Yang brigade.

sentences.zh: 江陰設副將，屬瓜洲鎮前營，分防自江陰以下江面，而至鹿苑港及壽興等河。

translations.literal: Jiangyin established deputy general, subordinate to Guazhou brigade front camp, divided defense from Jiangyin downward river surface to Luyuan Harbor and Shouxing etc. rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangyin: a deputy general of the Guazhou front camp, from Jiangyin downstream to Luyuan Harbor and the Shouxing waterways.

sentences.zh: 其鹿苑港以下，由福山鎮標接防。

translations.literal: Its below Luyuan Harbor, by Fushan brigade banner received defense.
translations.idiomatic: Below Luyuan Harbor the Fushan brigade took over.

sentences.zh: 狼山鎮總兵，循舊日之制，增水師二營，兼隸長江提督。

translations.literal: Langshan brigade general, followed old day system, increased naval force two camps, also subordinate to Yangtze provincial admiral.
translations.idiomatic: The Langshan brigade general kept the old establishment but added two naval camps under the Yangtze commander.

sentences.zh: 原統中左右三營，鹽捕、揚州、三江、泰州、泰興、掘港各營，悉仍其舊。

translations.literal: Originally commanded middle, left, right three camps, salt patrol, Yangzhou, Sanjiang, Taizhou, Taixing, Juegang each camps, all still their old.
translations.idiomatic: He still commanded the original middle, left, and right camps plus the salt patrol, Yangzhou, Sanjiang, Taizhou, Taixing, and Juegang garrisons unchanged.

sentences.zh: 惟通州設綏通營，置游擊各官，分防自靖江八團港以下江面至通州，凡長龍戰船二艘，督陣舢板一艘，舢板十艘，大舢板十艘，仍酌增紅單、拖罟等船。

translations.literal: Only Tongzhou established Sui-Tong camp, placed brigade commander and officers, divided defense from Jingjiang Ba Tuan Harbor downward river surface to Tongzhou, altogether long-dragon war boats two, battle-direction sampan one, sampans ten, large sampans ten, still appropriately increased red-sail, tow-net etc. boats.
translations.idiomatic: At Tongzhou the Sui-Tong camp was added under a brigade commander, patrolling from Ba Tuan Harbor at Jingjiang to Tongzhou with two long-dragons, one battle-direction sampan, ten sampans, ten large sampans, and additional red-sail junks and tow-net boats as needed.

sentences.zh: 海門廳設綏海營，置副將各官，分防自狼山至海門北岸江口海汊，凡長龍戰船二艘，督陣舢板二艘，大舢板二十艘，仍酌增兵輪船，及紅單、拖罟等船。

translations.literal: Haimen department established Sui-Hai camp, placed deputy general and officers, divided defense from Langshan to Haimen north bank river mouth sea channels, altogether long-dragon war boats two, battle-direction sampans two, large sampans twenty, still appropriately increased steam gunboats, and red-sail, tow-net etc. boats.
translations.idiomatic: At Haimen the Sui-Hai camp under a deputy general patrolled from Langshan to the north-bank estuary at Haimen with two long-dragons, two battle-direction sampans, twenty large sampans, and such steam gunboats, red-sail junks, and tow-net boats as were deemed necessary.

sentences.zh: 其崇明南岸海汊，由江南提督別行設防。

translations.literal: The sea channels on Chongming's south bank were separately garrisoned by the Jiangnan regional commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: The sea channels along Chongming's south shore were defended separately by the Jiangnan naval regional commander.

sentences.zh: 綜長江經制水師，副將六營，參將七營，游擊十一營，凡二十四營。

translations.literal: In sum, the regular Yangtze naval forces comprised six deputy-commander camps, seven regimental-commander camps, and eleven mobile-brigadier camps—twenty-four camps in all.
translations.idiomatic: Taken together, the regular Yangtze navy fielded twenty-four camps: six under deputy commanders, seven under regimental commanders, and eleven under mobile brigadiers.
